title: ServiceNow QA Engineer
description:
**Job Title: ServiceNow QA Engineer**
**Experience:**
3–5 Years
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad, India
  
  
**OSI Digital**
is looking for experienced ServiceNow QA Engineers in functional testing of ServiceNow-based applications, preferably within the IT Service Management (ITSM) domain.
  
  
The ideal candidates should have strong knowledge of Incident Management and Service Request Management, along with hands-on experience in test strategy development, test planning, test design, test execution, defect management, and regression testing.
  
  
The candidates will work closely with Business Analysts, Developers, Product Owners, and other QA team members to ensure the quality, functionality, and reliability of ServiceNow solutions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Analyze business requirements, functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria for ServiceNow implementations and enhancements.
* Create test strategies and detailed test plans based on project scope, business requirements, risks, and release timelines.
* Design and maintain test scenarios, test cases, test data, and traceability matrices.
* Perform functional testing of ServiceNow ITSM modules, particularly Incident Management and Service Request Management.
* Validate incident lifecycle workflows, priority and assignment rules, SLA configurations, notifications, escalations, and resolution processes.
* Test service catalog items, request submission, approvals, fulfillment workflows, task assignments, and request closure.
* Execute integration, end-to-end, smoke, and regression testing for ServiceNow changes and releases.
* Validate role-based access, form behavior, mandatory fields, business rules, UI policies, and workflow behavior.
* Identify, document, track, and retest defects using defect management tools.
* Collaborate with development teams to investigate issues, clarify requirements, and ensure timely defect resolution.
* Prepare test execution reports, defect summaries, test completion reports, and release quality assessments.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), release validation, and post-deployment smoke testing.
* Identify opportunities to improve test coverage, test efficiency, and overall QA processes.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* 3–5 years of experience in software quality assurance and functional testing.
* Hands-on experience testing ServiceNow applications, preferably ServiceNow ITSM.
* Strong functional knowledge of Incident Management and Service Request Management.
* Experience creating test strategies, test plans, test scenarios, and detailed test cases.
* Strong understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
* Experience in defect reporting, tracking, root-cause discussions, and retesting.
* Ability to interpret business requirements and translate them into comprehensive test coverage.
* Good analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

Basic understanding of REST APIs and integration testing.
  
  
**Preferred Skills**

* Exposure to ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF) or other test automation tools.
* Experience using Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar test and defect management tools.
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification or relevant ServiceNow training.

title: Services Specialist - Automation (C#)- Hyderabad
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Services Specialist – Automation Test Engineering (Playwright)**
Are you a hands-on automation engineer who builds test frameworks from the ground up? Do you enjoy owning quality for a product area, coaching analysts, and partnering closely with developers and product owners? Are you ready to make Playwright the backbone of a fast, reliable, engineering-led quality practice?
  
  
**Work You’ll Do**
Own quality engineering for enterprise web applications and Deloitte’s Tax & Legal technology solutions delivered through the Global Tools Delivery Center. Design test strategy, build and maintain Playwright automation frameworks for UI and API testing, integrate them into CI/CD pipelines, and drive defect resolution to release-ready quality.
  
  
You will also mentor Associates, coordinate UAT, and act as the quality point of contact for tools and solutions built using modern GTDC technologies, championing an automation-first, shift-left approach across the team.
  
  
**Test Automation and Playwright**

* Design, build, and maintain Playwright automation frameworks (page objects, fixtures, reusable libraries) for UI and API testing from scratch.
* Develop data-driven and parameterised tests to cover multiple input combinations efficiently.
* Build and maintain Playwright API acceptance suites with authentication, chained requests, and assertions.
* Integrate automated suites into CI/CD pipelines so they trigger on every code merge, and keep them green.
* Track and grow automation coverage each sprint; refactor and stabilise flaky tests.
* Establish and promote automation best practices and reusable components across the team.

**UAT Coordination and Stakeholder Management**

* Produce a test plan before testing starts and get it reviewed and approved.
* Plan, coordinate, and drive user acceptance testing cycles; design UAT scenarios, facilitate sessions with business users, and document sign-off.
* Communicate test progress, defect metrics, risks, and quality gates to stakeholders.
* Build strong working relationships across developers, product owners, business analysts, and delivery leads.

**Testing and Execution**

* Own end-to-end testing for assigned modules – functional, regression, integration, and cross-browser.
* Lead daily defect triage with developers and track every defect to closure.
* Analyse defect trends by severity, module, and root cause, and share findings with the development team.
* Enforce entry and exit criteria – do not approve a release that does not meet the quality bar.

**Mentoring and Team Development**

* Review Analyst test cases and automation scripts before execution and give specific, constructive feedback.
* Mentor Analysts on Playwright, framework design, and testing best practices.
* Run knowledge-sharing sessions and support onboarding of new team members.

**Compliance and Documentation**

* Apply Deloitte standards (e.g., copyright, visual identity) and guidelines (e.g., style guide, checklists) to all testing deliverables.
* Maintain the test artefact library – plans, cases, results, and traceability – correctly stored and labelled.
* Develop and maintain internal documentation to facilitate compliance and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications And Skills**
**Required**
**Education:**
Master’s degree, graduate degree, or B.Tech (IT/CSE/ECE) or equivalent.
  
  

* 3–5 years of QA experience with a strong focus on test automation.
* Strong hands-on Playwright expertise for UI and API automation (TypeScript or JavaScript), including framework design and maintenance.
* Proven experience building and maintaining test automation frameworks and reusable components.
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).
* Proven experience leading or coordinating UAT cycles.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Solid knowledge of SDLC, STLC, and Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Experience with defect-tracking tools and quality reporting.
* ISTQB Advanced Level – Test Analyst certification (or equivalent, or in progress).

**Preferred / Good To Have**

* Tricentis Tosca for enterprise regression automation.
* API testing with Postman (collections, environments, assertions).
* Applying AI-assisted test automation tools and practices (e.g., test generation, self-healing locators).
* Test data management design and tooling.
* Performance testing (e.g., JMeter, k6) and accessibility testing exposure.
* Broader DevOps tooling and containerised test execution.

**What We Look For**

* An automation-first, shift-left mindset and a drive for engineering excellence.
* Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving.
* Leadership instinct – able to guide and mentor analysts.
* Excellent stakeholder relationship management and communication.
* Eagerness to adopt new tools, including AI-assisted testing, and drive process improvement.

**Location and Shift**

* Location: Hyderabad
* Shift: 11:00 a.m. – 8:00 p.m. (some projects may require 2:00 p.m. – 11:00 p.m.)

**The team**
At Deloitte, Shared Services center improves overall efficiency and control while giving every business unit access to the company’s best and brightest resources. description:

Ray Business Technologies is a CMMI Level 3 and ISO 27001:2022 certified IT services company with over 17 years of experience delivering technology solutions to global enterprises. With operations in the USA, Canada, Australia, Philippines, and India, the organization focuses on helping businesses improve efficiency, reduce complexity, and drive growth. The team of programmers, designers, testers, and architects specializes in AI and Machine Learning, Boomi, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 (ERP and CRM), Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, CMS platforms, and custom development. Ray Business Technologies is recognized for tailored solutions, quality, and a strong track record of successful implementations in integration, analytics, and digital experience platforms.
  
  
  
**Role Description**
The Senior Boomi Integration Specialist will design, develop, and maintain integration solutions using Boomi to connect enterprise applications and data sources. Day-to-day responsibilities include gathering and analyzing integration requirements, building and configuring Boomi processes, performing unit and integration testing, and ensuring performance, reliability, and security of integrations. The role involves troubleshooting complex integration issues, optimizing existing workflows, collaborating with cross-functional teams (architects, developers, business analysts) and documenting solution designs and technical specifications. The specialist will also contribute to best practices, integration standards, and mentoring team members on Boomi and integration patterns. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Hyderabad.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Develop, enhance, and support Salesforce applications using established engineering standards and architectural guidance.
* Design and implement Salesforce solutions using declarative capabilities such as objects, fields, page layouts, validation rules, Flows, approval processes, security settings, and user access.
* Evaluate business and technical requirements to determine appropriate implementation approaches, including Salesforce declarative capabilities, custom Salesforce development, integrations, and custom full-stack components when needed.
* Develop user experiences on the Salesforce Lightning Platform using Lightning Web Components and other supported Salesforce technologies.
* Enhance and maintain Salesforce products and solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, and platform configuration within capabilities such as Service Cloud and Experience Cloud.
* Translate user stories, wireframes, and design specifications into high-quality, reusable Salesforce components and user experiences.
* Develop and maintain integrations between Salesforce and enterprise APIs, databases, data services, and other business applications.
* Integrate Salesforce and supporting applications with governed enterprise data platforms, relational databases, cloud services, and approved internal or external APIs.
* Develop and contribute to appropriate unit, integration, API, UI, accessibility, security, and data-validation testing as part of the software development lifecycle.
* Create rapid prototypes and proofs of concept using Salesforce and, where appropriate, custom web technologies to validate technical approaches and translate approved concepts into production-ready solutions.
* Use source control, code reviews, CI/CD, Salesforce deployment tooling, monitoring, rollback, and incident-management practices to support reliable application delivery.
* Write clean, reusable, well-documented, secure, and testable Apex, Lightning Web Components, JavaScript/TypeScript, and integration code.

* Monitor and troubleshoot production applications across Salesforce, APIs, data integrations, databases, cloud, and AI-enabled components; support defect resolution and root-cause analysis.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, including solution designs, data models, integration/API documentation, deployment procedures, configuration documentation, and runbooks.
* Contribute reusable Salesforce components, engineering standards, and continuous improvements that strengthen the broader Commercialization Technology ecosystem.
* Work closely with product owners, business stakeholders, UX/design teams, data engineers, QA engineers, and other technology teams.
* Follow Agile practices, contribute to sprint planning and effort estimation, and provide timely status updates.
* Continuously build knowledge of Salesforce platform capabilities, full-stack technologies, cloud, AI, integration, and DevOps practices.

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is a person with these qualifications.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications and Experience:**

* Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field
* Approximately 5 to 9 years of relevant software development or software engineering experience
* Demonstrated experience serving as a Salesforce developer or software engineer delivering enterprise software or data solutions
* Ability to independently deliver moderately complex technical assignments while collaborating effectively within a cross-functional team
* Ability to quickly learn unfamiliar technologies, platforms, and business processes
* Eagerness to learn and grow in a software development environment

**Functional Skills:**
**Must-Have Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience developing solutions on the Salesforce platform using declarative capabilities such as Flow, data modeling, validation rules, security configuration, and custom development technologies such as Apex and Lightning Web Components
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce application architecture, data models, security and sharing, integrations, and platform development best practices
* Experience developing and integrating Salesforce solutions with enterprise APIs and external systems using REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, or comparable integration patterns
* Working knowledge of relational databases, data modeling, SOQL, and SQL
* Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript and custom web development; experience with React or another modern front-end framework is a plus
* Experience with application security concepts, including authentication, authorization, Salesforce access controls, profiles/permission sets, and sharing models
* Strong problem solving and analytical skills; ability to learn quickly; excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Experience working within Agile or Scrum delivery methodologies
* Ability to create clear technical documentation, including designs, diagrams, configuration instructions, and operational support procedures
* Ability to communicate effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders and collaborate across global, virtual, and cross-functional teams

title: Senior QA Engineer, AI
description:

* Lead and mentor a QA team, setting AI testing standards across projects.
* Translate AI feature requirements into test scenarios and quality gates.
* Monitor production of AI behavior and evolve test coverage based on real world failures.

* 8+ years of QA/test engineering experience, including 3+ years testing AI, ML, or data driven applications.

* Experience testing REST/GraphQL APIs: functional, contract, and schema validation, auth testing, negative/boundary testing, and load testing.
* Experience testing AI applications for infosec: prompt injection resistance, data leakage/PII exposure prevention, access control, and secure endpoint authentication, per organizational security policy.

* **Problem-Solving**
  : Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, particularly in complex Bluetooth connectivity and performance issues.
* **Communication**
  : Excellent communication skills to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams, document test results, and present findings clearly to stakeholders.

* Experience with wireless communication technologies beyond Bluetooth (e.g., Wi-Fi, Zigbee) is a plus.
* Expertise in Python, Gen AI tool and Linux environment is expected
* **Additional Skills**
  : Experience with

title: Builder QA II
description:
**Job Description**
You are an engineer who specialises in proving things work. The distinction between “dev” and “QA” work is not one we maintain: you read the application code, you write production-grade Python, and you build agents. The difference is what you point them at.
  
  

* Core DNA
* AI-Native Workflow. You use AI to accelerate everything you do as a default, not an experiment. You have opinions about which tools earn their place.
* Agentic Implementation. You build, debug and deploy autonomous agents — LLM-driven test generation, Playwright browser-use agents, self-healing locator strategies — against complex ERP screens and workflows.
* Legacy-to-Modern Bridge. Some of what you’ll test is a modern web rewrite. Some is a desktop application older than your career. Both are puzzles.
* Evidence Over Confidence. A generated test that has never been executed is not a test. You know your own false-positive and flake rates rather than claiming there aren’t any.
* What You Own

**The ticket-to-test pipeline.**
An agent that reads a requirement or defect, understands the affected area, and produces a real test — grounded in the actual application, not in what the model imagines the application looks like. Hallucinated locators are the failure mode that kills these systems; preventing them is your problem.
  
  
**Execution and stabilization.**
Generation is the easy half. Your pipeline isn’t done when a test file exists or a ticket gets created — it’s done when the test has run against a real build, passed repeatedly, and earned its place in the suite. Flake is the enemy, because a suite nobody trusts is worse than no suite.
  
  
**Coverage that means something.**
You can tell the difference between a suite that covers the code and a suite that covers the risk. You use mutation testing and real defect history rather than counting tests, and you argue for the edge cases that actually bite: fiscal calendars, multi-currency, partial shipments, period-end adjustments.
  
  

* Where You Might Lean In
* Test Generation & Grounding — the retrieval and context problem. How does an agent know what the screen really contains, what the business rule really is, and what changed in this release?
* Adversarial & Red-Team — you build agents whose job is to break things. Programmatic prompt optimization (DSPy), fuzzing business logic, hunting the input nobody thought of.
* Test Infrastructure & Agent-Ops — the factory the test agents run in: parallel execution, environment and data management, tracing, and the observability to know why a run went sideways.
* Legacy Surface Automation — desktop and thick-client applications where modern tooling doesn’t reach and the automation has to be built rather than installed.

What You’ll Actually Do
  
  

* Build test-generation agents that take a ticket and produce an executable test grounded in the live application.
* Close the loop. Make generation, execution, stabilization and reporting one pipeline rather than four disconnected steps with a human carrying work between them.
* Automate the untestable. Wrap legacy business logic — the modules everyone has avoided because there’s no spec — in characterization tests that capture what the system actually does today.
* Kill flake. Find the root cause rather than adding a retry. Retries are how suites die.
* Red-team the financial logic. Build the agents that go looking for the case where the ledger doesn’t balance.
* Fix your own agents in production. Read the traces, find why it went sideways, make it not happen again.

What Good Looks Like
  
  
*(Illustrative — real targets agreed with the hiring manager.)*

* 30 days: Shipped your first agent-generated test into a running suite — generated, executed, stable.
* 90 days: Owning the ticket-to-test pipeline for a product area end to end, with a measured flake rate and a real coverage picture.
* 6 months: Other Builders reuse what you built. Escaped defects in your area are measurably down, and you can show why.

The Stack
  
  
Python, pytest, Playwright, SQL (Postgres/SQL Server), TypeScript, OpenAI/Anthropic, LangChain/LangGraph, DSPy, pgvector/Qdrant, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, OpenTelemetry, eval and tracing platforms (LangSmith / Langfuse / Braintrust or equivalent), desktop automation frameworks where the application demands it. And any other tool that helps us achieve greatness.
  
  
Who You Are
  
  

* You’ve shipped one. You have built at least one autonomous agent or complex LLM workflow that real people used for real work — not a weekend demo. You know how it failed, because it did.
* You write real code. Python that goes to production and gets reviewed like anyone else’s. If your automation experience stops at a record-and-playback tool, this isn’t the role.
* The manual-task hater. You have a physical reaction to repetitive work. If you do it twice, you’ve already started drafting the automation.
* Technically fearless. A 500-table undocumented legacy schema isn’t complexity, it’s a puzzle about to get solved. You aren’t intimidated by spaghetti code — you’re the one who brings the sauce.
* Rigor over hype. You love the new models and you still ask for the numbers. You know the difference between a cool demo and a pipeline people rely on every release.
* Suspicious by instinct. Your first question about any green build is what it didn’t check.

Why Join Us
  
  

* Quality is engineering here, not a stage gate. You are a Builder on the same ladder, with the same levels and the same expectations as everyone else in the squad. You build; you don’t sign off on other people’s work.
* The Final Boss of complexity. ERPs are the ultimate challenge for AI. If you can build agents that validate a General Ledger, you’ve solved the hardest version of this problem.
* Agentic autonomy. We don’t do tickets. We do missions. You’ll have real freedom over the models, frameworks and agent architectures you think will win.
* No red tape. If the agent works and the evals pass, we ship. No Change Management Committee — a “Does It Work?” policy.
* The Builder Tribe. You won’t be the only AI person in the room. You’ll be part of a small squad equally obsessed with moving faster, where your automation hacks are your biggest contribution rather than a hidden side project.

title: Application Engineer
description:
**Job Title**
– Application Engineer

**Location**
– Leanwatts HQ, Hyderabad, India

**About us:**

At Leanwatts, we develop innovative power electronic solutions for electric mobility and energy applications through continuous research, engineering, and manufacturing. Our “Designed and Made in India” approach drives us to build reliable, high-performance products for the future of transportation and energy.

**What is this role about?**

We are looking for an Application Engineer to help customers integrate and validate Leanwatts’ EV chargers and power electronic products. You will translate application requirements into clear specifications, support sample trials, and resolve integration issues with customers and our engineering teams. This is a hands-on, customer-facing engineering role covering product selection, charger–battery integration, testing, troubleshooting, and production handover. You will work with hardware, firmware, quality, production, and sales teams to take customer applications from requirements to technical acceptance.

What you will do at Leanwatts:

● Customer Requirements: Capture battery chemistry, pack voltage, charging current, CAN requirements, connectors, installation constraints, and acceptance criteria. Maintain an agreed statement of requirements and clarify gaps before samples are prepared.

● Product Selection & Configuration: Match customer needs to suitable charger models and variants. Coordinate approved charging parameters, firmware versions, cable assemblies, and connector details with the responsible engineering teams.

● Charger & BMS Integration: Support CAN and non-CAN charger integration with battery packs and customer systems. Check protocol definitions, command and feedback signals, charging limits, and start/stop behaviour against agreed requirements.

● Sample Preparation & Trials: Coordinate sample readiness and configuration checks, support customer evaluation, and record test conditions and feedback. Track each application through open issues, retesting, and technical acceptance.

● Testing & Validation: Plan and execute application tests for charging behaviour, output regulation, protection responses, and thermal performance. Capture measurements, CAN logs, and waveforms using approved procedures and safe test practices.

● Troubleshooting & Issue Closure: Reproduce customer issues, analyse test data, and distinguish configuration, communication, hardware, and firmware causes. Escalate with clear evidence and verify corrective actions before closure.

● Technical Documentation: Prepare application notes, customer-specific datasheets, test reports, configuration records, and integration guidance. Keep specifications, approved versions, and customer acceptance evidence traceable.

● Production Handover: Transfer approved application requirements, firmware and hardware versions, test criteria, and variant details to production and quality. Support first-batch checks and resolve handover gaps.

● Customer & Engineering Coordination: Explain technical findings clearly, track commitments and blockers, and coordinate with customers, suppliers, and internal teams. Feed recurring field issues and application needs into product improvements.

**Must have requirements:**

1. Education & Required Experience

● Education: B.E. or B.Tech in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant practical experience may also be considered.

● Experience: Hands-on experience in application engineering, product testing, integration, or technical support for electrical or electronic products, with the ability to work systematically through technical problems.

● Relevant Work: Ability to explain a practical integration or troubleshooting project, including the requirements, measurements, root cause, corrective action, and verification.

**2. Chargers & Battery Integration**

● Electrical Fundamentals: Practical understanding of voltage, current, power, charging profiles, battery limits, and AC-DC or DC-DC conversion. Ability to read datasheets, wiring diagrams, and basic schematics. ● Application Compatibility: Ability to assess charger and battery compatibility, connector pinouts, cable requirements, and operating limits. Recognise electrical and thermal risks and escalate unsafe or unclear conditions.

**3. Test Tools & Communication Protocols**

You should be comfortable setting up tests, collecting reliable evidence, and using it to explain product behaviour to customers and engineering teams.

● Test Equipment: Working ability with oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, and electronic loads or battery test setups. Select suitable instruments and follow approved electrical safety procedures.

● CAN Communication: Ability to interpret CAN specifications and logs, check message IDs, scaling, timing, and basic bus configuration, and troubleshoot charger–BMS communication with firmware engineers.

**4. Customer Support & Release Discipline**

● Technical Communication: Clear written and verbal communication with customers and cross-functional teams. Explain test results, ask precise questions, and set expectations without making unapproved technical commitments.

● Verification & Documentation: Ability to write reproducible test procedures and concise reports, maintain application records, and distinguish confirmed findings from assumptions or issues still under investigation.

● Delivery & Change Control: Track multiple customer applications, prioritise open issues, and communicate risks. Maintain approved configuration and revision records and obtain sign-off before changes reach customers or production.

**5. Preferred Advantages**

● Relevant Products & Technologies: Direct experience with EV chargers, battery packs, BMS integration, automotive electronics, or power converters. Exposure to customer-site trials and product qualification is an advantage.

● Data Analysis & Improvement: Familiarity with test-data analysis, basic scripting or test automation, and structured root-cause methods. Experience turning field feedback into validated product or process improvements is an advantage.

title: QC Labs Ops & LIMS Process Expert
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
**About Lilly**
At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients. We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. We bring our best to this work because people depend on it. If you're driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly.
  
  
**About Technology@Lilly**
At Lilly, technology is not a support function. It is how a global medicine company operates, innovates, and delivers. Lilly in Hyderabad builds the capabilities that make this possible, cloud platforms, AI systems, and automation at enterprise scale, all in service of a purpose that makes this technology work genuinely distinctive, from advancing drug discovery to enabling connected clinical trials to keeping a global medicine company running at the standard patients deserve.
  
  
**About The Business Function**
The Global Manufacturing & Quality Labs - Lab Systems team delivers and sustains lab informatics platforms enabling GMP-compliant laboratory operations across Lilly's global manufacturing network. We build, implement, and support coordinated digital lab solutions that ensure data integrity, regulatory compliance, and efficient analytical and quality control processes.
  
  
**Job Role: QC Labs Ops & LIMS Process Expert**
**Role Overview**
This role is for Technology@Lilly Manufacturing & Quality and provides deep pharmaceutical Quality Control process expertise, including the scientific processes performed on laboratory equipment, to support the design, harmonization, implementation, and deployment of LabVantage and connected laboratory solutions across the manufacturing network. The role bridges laboratory users and technology delivery teams by translating scientific and quality processes into standardized LIMS workflows, master data, functional requirements, test scenarios, and sustainable global ways of working.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**QC Process Expertise & Harmonization**
Serve as a subject-matter expert for end-to-end pharmaceutical QC laboratory processes and LIMS-enabled workflows.
  
  
Lead process mapping, fit-gap assessment, harmonization, and standardization across sites; identify justified local or regulatory variations.
  
  
Promote MQ Labs standards, reusable process patterns, and best practices while challenging unnecessary customization.
  
  
Facilitate global workshops with QC scientists, laboratory SMEs, Quality, product owners, and implementation partners to drive process decisions and adoption.
  
  
**LabVantage Implementation & Functional Design**
Participate across LabVantage requirements, design, configuration review, demonstrations, testing, validation, deployment readiness, and post-deployment stabilization.
  
  
Translate QC laboratory needs into clear functional requirements, process flows, user stories, acceptance criteria, and intended-use scenarios.
  
  
Review proposed configurations and workflows for scientific fit, usability, compliance, standardization, and alignment with approved global processes.
  
  
Support fit-gap decisions, functional issue resolution, defect triage, and business acceptance throughout the implementation lifecycle.
  
  
**Laboratory Processes & Master Data**
Provide process expertise across sample receipt and lifecycle, specifications, analytical methods, tests, parameters, limits, result entry and review, approval, and release-support workflows.
  
  
Define and harmonize requirements for stability programs, sterility testing, environmental monitoring, exceptions, investigations, retesting or resampling, and related QC workflows.
  
  
Apply practical understanding of laboratory equipment processes, analytical data generation, review controls, instrument outputs, and relevant ICH expectations.
  
  
Partner on laboratory master-data design, governance, creation, migration, verification, and lifecycle maintenance to ensure accuracy, consistency, traceability, and reuse.
  
  
Ensure master-data structures and workflows reflect approved laboratory processes and support efficient global deployment.
  
  
**Connected Laboratory Process Design**
Define business-process and data requirements for connections between LabVantage and laboratory systems.
  
  
Provide process expertise for flows involving Empower/CDS, MODA-EM, ELN/LES, MES, SAP, and connected analytical instruments.
  
  
Define business ownership, source and target data expectations, exception-handling scenarios, reconciliation needs, and user workflows for integrations.
  
  
Identify opportunities to reduce manual transcription, simplify handoffs, and enable straight-through laboratory data flows.
  
  
Partner with technical integration and platform teams while remaining focused on process, data, and functional requirements rather than infrastructure or driver engineering.
  
  
**Testing, Validation & Deployment Readiness**
Develop and review business-process test scenarios and acceptance criteria; support functional testing, UAT, validation, and defect triage.
  
  
Partner with Quality and validation/CSQA teams to ensure intended use, requirements, testing, traceability, and process controls are appropriately addressed.
  
  
Support site readiness, SOP and process alignment, training content, cutover planning, adoption, and hypercare from a QC-process perspective.
  
  
Ensure deployed workflows remain aligned with approved global processes and drive feedback into continuous improvement and future releases.
  
  
**Governance, Data Integrity & Regulatory Compliance**
Apply GxP, data integrity, ALCOA+, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, applicable ICH expectations, and risk-based CSV/CSA principles to LIMS process design and use.
  
  
Ensure process requirements address appropriate review, approval, audit trail, electronic-record, traceability, and exception-management expectations.
  
  
Support inspection readiness and provide QC/LIMS process expertise during USFDA, EMA/EMEA, and other regulatory inspections and audits.
  
  
Partner with Quality to assess process impacts, address observations, and drive sustainable remediation where required.
  
  
**What You Should Bring**
Deep pharmaceutical or biotechnology QC laboratory-process expertise.
  
  
Hands-on understanding of LIMS-enabled laboratory workflows and experience participating in LabVantage or a comparable enterprise LIMS implementation.
  
  
Strong experience with process harmonization, fit-gap analysis, functional requirements, laboratory master data, testing/UAT, validation, and deployment readiness.
  
  
Practical knowledge of stability, sterility, environmental monitoring, sample management, analytical testing, specifications, results review, investigations, and release-support processes.
  
  
Understanding of the scientific processes performed on common QC laboratory equipment and how results, metadata, controls, and exceptions are managed.
  
  
Understanding of business and data flows involving Empower/CDS, MODA-EM, MES, SAP, ELN/LES, instruments, or related laboratory applications.
  
  
Strong facilitation, stakeholder management, global collaboration, problem-solving, and change-adoption skills.
  
  
Strong understanding of GxP, data integrity, CSV/CSA, ICH expectations, and regulatory inspection expectations for laboratory computerized systems.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Analytical Chemistry, Chemistry, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related discipline with relevant 6-12 years of experience.
  
  
Significant experience in pharmaceutical or biotechnology QC laboratories, laboratory systems, LIMS implementation, or laboratory digital transformation.
  
  
Demonstrated experience translating laboratory processes into LIMS requirements, workflows, master data, test scenarios, or configurations. Experience working across QC, Quality, Technology, validation, and implementation-partner teams.
  
  
**Preferred Experience**
LabVantage implementation, harmonization, deployment, or process-design experience.
  
  
Multi-site or global QC process standardization and laboratory master-data harmonization.
  
  
Experience with Empower/CDS, MODA-EM, MES, SAP, stability, sterility, or environmental-monitoring workflows.
  
  
Experience supporting USFDA, EMA/EMEA, or comparable inspections involving QC processes or laboratory computerized systems.

We believe the people who dedicate themselves to making medicines better deserve an environment that makes their lives better too, one where they are supported, respected, and given the space to do their best work. description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people.
  
  
Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. We seek hardworking, motivated, and imaginative individuals to join our High Speed IO (HSIO) post silicon validation team. As the lead engineer, you will own post-silicon validation and support new hardware bring-up. This role offers firsthand experience in developing and productizing reliable HSIO interfaces for GPU accelerated computing platforms, next generation client and automotive systems.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Own HSIO (PCIe, CXL, and NVLink) validation on FPGA/Emulator and Silicon, including test plan development, board building for validation requirements, resource planning, automation, test execution, coverage metrics, bug resolution, and release to production.
* Coordinate with internal and external logic, circuit, boards, simulation, diagnostics, firmware, driver, and marketing teams across different time zones. Ensure our products are tested against and meet specifications, are tuned for efficient workload performance. Drive the system into production.
* Participate in reviewing board schematics, PCB layouts, and making build and component suggestions. Ensure interoperability with connected devices and system components in sophisticated interconnect topologies.
* Provide engineering support during manufacturing in both NPI and MP stages of production.
* Influence pre-silicon development and verification methodologies, workflows based on issues observed and debugged on silicon to achieve outstanding HSIO products.

**What We Need To See**

* BS or B.Tech or MS or M.Tech in EE, ECE, CS, or equivalent degree with 7+ years or more experience in HSIO validation.
* Comprehensive understanding of the HSIO protocols (including PCI Express, Infiniband, Ethernet), its specifications, and its operation at a system level.
* Strong knowledge of lab instruments (DSOs, BERT, Protocol/Logic analyzers) and hands-on experience in Post-Si bring-up, functional validation, troubleshooting, and tuning of HSIO interfaces. Proficient with logic and protocol analyzers, along with protocol exercisers.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills. Proficient in collaborating across geographically distributed teams and suppliers to deliver quality products on tight schedules.
* Hands-on experience of developing workflows and coding in scripting languages like Python would be helpful.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Proven leadership experience in PCI Express physical layer and debugging LTSSM failures; familiarity with data link layer, transaction layer and CXL.
* Extensive knowledge of characterization techniques in post-silicon settings. Excellent knowledge of signal integrity concepts, silicon characteristics, and high-speed/SERDES functional validation.
* Familiarity with x86/Arm server architectures and latest accelerated computing server architecture is required. Experience with datacenter products including system management, security, networking, and storage would be a plus.
* Working exposure on working with AI tools (like Claude or Cursor) would be highly desirable

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
**About the role**

We are hiring a Senior QA Engineer with 4 to 5 years of experience to own quality for products that ship on web, iOS and Android. This is not a script-the-test-case role. You will be the person on the team who understands how real users behave, who questions requirements before a line of code is written, and who uses AI tools to test faster and deeper than a conventional QA process allows. You will work as an individual contributor with a high degree of ownership. You decide what to test, how to test it, and when a release is ready. In return, we expect you to be self-driven, to raise problems early, and to hold a high bar for the product without waiting to be asked.

**What you will do**

* Own quality across web and mobile Plan, design and execute functional, regression, exploratory,
* API and crossbrowser/cross-device testing for our web application and native mobile apps (iOS and Android).
* Build and maintain automated test suites for web (e.g. Playwright or Cypress) and mobile (e.g. Appium, Detox or Maestro), and keep them running reliably in CI/CD.
* Define the release readiness criteria for each sprint and make the go/no-go call on quality. Track defects end to end, from reproduction and root-cause analysis through to verification in production.

**Test from the user's point of view**

* Study how customers actually use the product (analytics, session recordings, support
* tickets, user feedback) and shape your test strategy around real journeys, not just
* acceptance criteria.
* Build test scenarios around edge cases users hit in practice: poor network, interrupted
* flows, device and OS fragmentation, accessibility needs, and unusual data.
* Flag usability and experience problems, not only functional bugs, and argue for the
* user when trade-offs are discussed.

**Step into a business analyst role when needed**

* Review requirements, user stories and designs before development starts; identify
* gaps, ambiguities, conflicts and missing edge cases.
* Translate business goals into clear, testable acceptance criteria together with product
* managers and designers.
* Document user flows, business rules and expected behaviour where documentation is
* missing, and keep it current.
* Act as the bridge between product, design, engineering and support on what the
* product should do and why

**Use AI to raise the bar on quality**

* Use AI assistants and agents to generate test cases, test data, and automation code, and to analyse logs, crash reports and defect patterns.
* Evaluate and introduce AI-powered testing tools (self-healing automation, visual testing, intelligent test selection) where they deliver real value.
* Build lightweight internal tooling or prompts that make the whole team faster at testing and triage.
* Where our products include AI features, design tests for non-deterministic behaviour, prompt quality, hallucination and safety.

**What we are looking for**

* 4 to 5 years of hands-on QA experience, with at least 2 years testing both web applications and native or hybrid mobile apps.
* Strong manual and exploratory testing skills; you find the bugs that scripted tests miss. Demonstrated ability to analyse requirements, spot gaps, and write clear acceptance criteria and user flows; prior exposure to business analysis or product work is a strong signal.
* Evidence of using user data (analytics, session replays, support feedback) to shape testing priorities. Active, practical use ofAI tools (such as Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot or Cursor) in day-today QA work, and an informed opinion on where they help and where they do not.
* Clear written and spoken communication; you can explain a risk to an engineer, a product manager and a founder in terms each understands.
* Comfortable working in agile teams with short release cycles.

**Nice to have**

* Working proficiency in test automation using at least one web framework (Playwright) and one mobile framework (Appium) Experience with API testing (Postman, RESTAssured or similar) and reading and writing basic SQL.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or similar) and with mobile build and distribution tools (TestFlight, Play Console, Firebase App Distribution).
* Performance or load testing (k6, JMeter, Locust) and basic security testing awareness (OWASP Top 10).
* Accessibility testing against WCAG 2.1 AA on web and mobile. Experience testing products that themselves include AI or LLM features.
* Exposure to product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA4) and session replay tools (Hotjar, FullStory, Clarity).
* Experience in a startup or small product team where you owned quality end to end. ISTQB or equivalent certification (useful, not required).

**How you work Self-motivated.**

* You do not need a ticket to start testing or a manager to tell you what matters.
* You find the highest-risk area and go there first. High-performing individual contributor.
* You deliver complete, reliable results on your own, and your work rarely needs rework.
* You raise your hand when you are blocked, not after the deadline. Curious about users.
* You want to know why someone dropped off at step three, and you go and find out.
* Opinionated but collaborative. You push back on unclear requirements and weak quality decisions, with evidence, and you accept a decision once it is made.
* Always improving the process. You see repetitive work as something to automate, delegate to AI, or remove altogether.
* Calm under release pressure. You give an honest readiness assessment even when the answer is unwelcome

title: SLIMS Technical Consultant
description:
**Job Description**
Agilent inspires and supports discoveries that advance the quality of life. We provide life science, diagnostic, and applied market laboratories worldwide with instruments, services, consumables, applications, and expertise. Agilent enables customers to gain the answers and insights they seek - so they can do what they do best: improve the world around us. Information about Agilent is available at www.agilent.com.
  
  
**OpenLab Sync (formerly SLIMS)**
is a platform that allows supervision of all stages a sample follows to the result.
**OpenLab Sync**
captures information about the sample, requests for measurements, and follows its entire workflow through the lab, supervising manual operating procedures, automated instrument steps, and calculations until the final report.
  
  
If you decide to join our team, you will be working closely with our clients. The tasks to be performed are multifaceted, and a creative mind is needed to be able to identify and implement customer solutions and improve the quality of life in the lab environment. Want to learn more about OpenLab Sync? Visit OpenLab Sync for more information and even some videos.
  
  
This role is ideal for candidates who combine hands-on laboratory experience with technical software implementation skills. Successful candidates typically have experience working in laboratory informatics, scientific software, LIMS, ELN, LES, or laboratory automation environments.
  
  
As an
**Application Engineer**
part of the Customer Success team in India, you will support our valued customers across our Lab informatics product solutions. This role offers you the opportunity to travel and explore a variety of labs, so it is vital to have an appetite for continuously learning about new software technology, instruments, applications, and consumables. In addition, applying communication skills, creativity, and a can-do approach is vital.
  
  
**Your main responsibilities will be:**

* Analyze customers' needs and translate them into OpenLab Sync workflows
* Configure the OpenLab Sync platform to match the lab's requirements
* Build plugins for connecting instruments or displaying custom forms or portals
* Act as the customer voice to influence future product design to meet customer needs
* Script a lab's in-silico tools into our integration framework

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who has a keen interest in Lab Informatics and is seeking a new challenge. A curious individual who is driven to learn and has the desire to understand and solve customer problems to deliver customer success will succeed in this position.
  
  
**Qualifications**
We are looking for motivated individuals with the following background:
  
  

* University Degree in Life Sciences, Bioinformatics, Biotechnology, Chemistry, Computer Science, Scientific Informatics, or a related discipline (or alternatively solid relevant experience in this application engineering field)
* Hands-on laboratory experience in analytical chemistry, biobanks, pharma, biopharma, genomics, NGS, Academia, etc.
* Preferred experience with LIMS, ELN, LES, SDMS, CDS, laboratory automation, scientific software, or laboratory workflow management systems.
* You have knowledge of programming languages such as Java or Python with proven coding skills
* Experience working directly with customers, stakeholders, laboratory users, or cross-functional project teams is highly desirable.
* Full proficiency in English.

On a personal level, you possess great
**problem solving**
/
**analytical skills, and**
you are
**eager to learn**
about new software technology, instruments, applications, and consumables. You have
**communication/interpersonal skills**
to interact at various levels, and you strive to provide excellent customer support. You enjoy both
**working within a team**
and
**autonomously**
.
  
  
We will make sure
**you get all the training and development opportunities you need to become the best in your field!**

This job has a full time weekly schedule.

title: Consultant - Global Employer Services Technology Center (GESTC) - Tier 2 Product Support & Technology Operations Professional
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
GESTC is building a modern, event-driven, cloud-native GlobalAdvantage (GA) platform on Amazon Web Services (AWS).
  
  
Concretely, the environment you will operate includes:
  
  

* Backend for Frontend (BFF) APIs on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS); Angular micro-frontends in the GA Portal.
* Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK)
* supported by an Amazon S3 data lake, AWS Glue, and Amazon OpenSearch Service, including the operational dashboards you will use daily.
* Azure DevOps continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), OpenTelemetry with Application Insights, and ServiceNow for IT service management (ITSM)

**Data:**
Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL and Oracle as primary relational stores backbone where modules communicate through domain topics.
  
  
**Integrations:**
external and client-system integration through Boomi iPaaS and a client API gateway
  
  
**Workflow:**
human-in-the-loop processes on Pega bridged to Kafka
  
  
**Security:**
AWS Cognito with Amazon Verified Permissions (AVP) policy-based authorization
  
  
This role does not require you to build these components. It does require sufficient understanding of how they work together to diagnose issues that cross them, coordinate the right teams, validate fixes, and improve how the platform is run.
  
  
This is an experienced position. You will work with Tier 1 support personnel and provide Tier 2 support across the platform, supporting users from both a technical and functional perspective. More than resolving tickets, you will own assigned production issues through diagnosis, resolution, validation, communication, and closure, and continuously improve the reliability and supportability of the platform.
  
  
Because the platform is event-driven and multi-layered, a single incident may span a micro-frontend, a .NET API, an Aurora/Oracle query, a Kafka message routed to a dead-letter queue (DLQ), a Boomi HRIS feed, a Pega case, an AVP authorization decision, and a dashboard. With training, you will trace issues across those layers using correlation IDs and telemetry, isolate the failing hop, and coordinate resolution with engineering, product, integration, security, and data teams without needing to build or re-architect the components yourself.
  
  
This position requires significant client contact, so you must possess excellent communication, consulting, and probing skills to manage client expectations. Our applications are used by Deloitte's Global Employer Services member firms and clients, so strong client service and the ability to deliver on time in a dynamic team environment are essential. The candidate will receive training on existing as well as next-generation tools.
  
  
Key responsibilities:
  
  

* Own assigned production issues end to end - diagnosis, resolution, validation, stakeholder communication, and closure across the compensation and payroll vertical, working with Tier 1 personnel on escalations.
* Backend for Frontend (BFF) API, relational database, Kafka topics, Boomi integrations, Pega workflow, and reporting to isolate where a transaction broke.
* Support the investigation and controlled reprocessing of event failures, including reviewing dead-letter queue messages and following approved recovery procedures.
* Investigate and validate application data across Aurora PostgreSQL, Oracle, and comparable relational databases using SQL - querying, reconciling, and correcting under change control.
* Troubleshoot APIs and integrations - REST/BFF APIs, web services, Boomi HRIS inbound and client outbound flows, and cli ent API-gateway access - interpreting request/response payloads and determining whether an issue originates in source data, the API call, authentication/authorization (AVP/Cognito), transformation logic, the destination system, workflow, or the database.
* service-level agreement (SLA) timers, and follow the Pega-to-Kafka integration bridge when a case event does not propagate.
* Manage incidents, defects, changes, and work items through their full lifecycle in ServiceNow and Azure DevOps.
* Support release readiness - perform unit and system-level testing, validate deployments through Azure DevOps pipelines, and provide post-release stabilization and production monitoring.
* To assist with diagnosis of errors, latency, and transaction failures.
* Deliver reporting and operational insight - work with business owners to define information needs and build/maintain Bold Reports (and SSRS where applicable) and dashboards; use platform operational dashboards and event data to surface recurring issues, emerging risks, and service-improvement opportunities.
* Perform root-cause analysis and recommend corrective and preventive actions rather than short-term workarounds.
* Improve supportability and automation - enhance logging, monitoring, diagnostics, runbooks, and knowledge articles; identify repetitive support activities as automation candidates; and use AI-assisted tooling to accelerate diagnosis and resolution.
* Act as a liaison between business and technology using AGILE methodologies - translating business requirements into functional specifications and test plans and ensuring they are fulfilled.
* Consistently meet client expectations and project deadlines, and provide logical, lasting solutions.

Shift Timings: 11:00 AM - 8:00 PM
  
  
Location: Hyderabad
  
  
Key skills desired
  
  
We do not expect prior experience with every technology in the platform section above. We expect the transferable skills below and the ability to apply them to the platform stack.
  
  

* Production support experience with enterprise applications, digital products, or workflow solutions, including end-to-end incident ownership — investigation, resolution, validation, communication, closure, and root-cause / problem management.
* Strong SQL and relational-database skills (querying, validating, reconciling, correcting data) on at least one enterprise platform, with the adaptability to work across the platform's data stores.
* Cross-layer troubleshooting: isolating whether an issue sits in the UI, application/API, data, integration, workflow, or reporting layer.
* Working knowledge of APIs and system integrations — reading payloads and diagnosing interface, authentication, and data-validation errors across the kinds of API and integration flows this platform uses.
* Comfort operating within ITSM and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) tools to manage incidents, defects, changes, releases, and operational reporting.

* Participate in testing activities including SIT, UAT, regression testing, and validation documentation

* Support data migration, cutover planning, and hypercare activities during deployments

****Required Qualifications:****

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or related field
* 7+ years of SAP functional consulting experience with at least 3 years focused on SAP GBT or batch traceability solutions. including full-cycle implementations
* Strong experience with SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA environments
* Hands-on expertise in SAP modules such as PP, SD, MM, QM
* Experience with SAP WM/EWM and ATTP is highly preferred
* Experience working in the pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences industry
* Strong understanding of regulated manufacturing and compliance requirements
* Experience with serialization, batch management, and product recall processes
* Experience with SAP IDocs, ALE, and RFC for data transfer between multiple SAP and non-SAP instances
* Ability to lead workshops and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Experience working in global delivery or matrixed environments

****Preferred Qualifications:****

* SAP certification in relevant logistics or supply chain modules
* Experience with SAP ATTP, SAP ICH, or other traceability and compliance platforms
* Familiarity with validation processes and CSV documentation in regulated environments
* Knowledge of Agile and SAP Activate methodologies
* Experience integrating SAP with MES, LIMS, or third-party warehouse systems

**Additional Qualifications**

* Strong collaboration and inclusion mindset, capable of resolving conflicts at the team level and fostering effective teamwork across project work-streams
* High level of self-direction and initiative, with the ability and willingness to learn in a self-directed fashion to stay informed on new technologies and concepts
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA migrations involving GBT

The Senior QA Engineer is responsible for leading test design, execution, and quality assurance across applications and technology platforms. Communicate status, risks, and decisions clearly; influence cross-functional outcomes; participate in code reviews and knowledge sharing to raise team standards. 6-8 years of experience

* Strong experience with automation testing tools such as Selenium and scalable test solutions

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
Inovalon was founded in 1998 on the belief that technology, and data specifically, would empower the transformation of the entire healthcare ecosystem for the better, improving both outcomes and economics. At Inovalon, we believe that when our customers are successful in their missions, healthcare improves. Therefore, we focus on empowering them with data-driven solutions. And the momentum is building.
  
  
Together, as ONE Inovalon, we are a united force delivering solutions that address healthcare’s greatest needs. Through our mission-based culture of inclusion and innovation, our organization brings value not just to our customers, but to the millions of patients and members they serve.
  
  
**Who You Are**
As a Senior Software Development Engineer, you help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of broadly used software capabilities by designing, executing, and improving effective testing practices. You work closely with developers and cross-functional partners to validate requirements, identify issues early, and support high-quality releases in an Agile environment. Your work helps strengthen product performance and user experience for internal teams, clients, and the people they serve.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design structured, reusable, automation-ready test cases that can be used by Quality Engineers and automated test frameworks.
* Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate test case creation, expand test coverage, identify edge cases, and improve test effectiveness while applying human judgment to validate and refine outputs.
* Analyze functional requirements and specifications to identify gaps, clarify expected behavior, and define test strategies that verify complete coverage.
* Partner with developers to troubleshoot defects, isolate complex issues involving dependent software components, and communicate findings clearly to stakeholders.
* Set up, perform, and interpret performance and load tests to evaluate product behavior under expected and stressed conditions.
* Analyze, document, and report test results, quality metrics, and testing status from an overall product perspective.
* Develop and maintain test scripts, test cases, and software test and performance measurement tools using appropriate programming languages and software applications.
* Continuously improve test plans, scripts, and cases based on quality data, production incidents, lessons learned, and team priorities.

**What You'll Need**

* 5+ years of demonstrated QA and testing experience or equivalent experience required.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Information Technology or equivalent combination of education and experience required.
* Experience developing test cases and test scripts.
* Good knowledge of basic test techniques, including positive and negative testing, interface testing, and database testing.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience across all phases of software testing, including integration, functional, API, data, regression, system, and end-to-end testing.
* Experience with test tools and source control tools such as Microsoft Azure DevOps and/or GitHub.
* Thorough understanding of the software development life cycle, quality before design, Agile software development, and current QA best practices, methodologies, standards, and testing approaches.

* Leadership: You influence through collaboration, communicate clearly with developers and peers, support shared quality goals, and help move issues to resolution when perspectives differ.
* Adaptability: You adjust quickly to changing priorities, evolving requirements, and shifting release needs while staying focused on quality and delivery outcomes.
* Creative Thinking: You develop practical, effective ways to improve test coverage, uncover edge cases, and strengthen quality processes across complex product areas.
* Analytical Skills: You interpret test results, identify patterns and root causes, break down complex issues, and use evidence to guide decisions and recommendations.

Some travel may be required, depending on the needs of the role. *If you don’t meet every qualification listed but are excited about our mission and the work described, we encourage you to apply. Inovalon is most interested in finding the best candidate for the job, and you may be just the right person for this or other roles.*
*By embracing inclusion, we enhance our work environment and drive business success. Inovalon strives to provide equal opportunities to the communities where we operate and to our clients and everyone whom we serve. We endeavor to create a culture of inclusion in which our associates feel empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work and pursue their professional goals in an equitable setting. title: Senior Digital Health Technologies Specialist
description:
**About Parexel**
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
  
  
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose – moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Senior Digital Health Technologies Specialist to join our team in a Hyderabad On-site capacity. As a Senior Digital Health Technologies Specialist, you will support clinical research activities that advance new treatments for patients. This position plays a key role in digital tool implementation, study execution, regulatory compliance, and ensuring seamless integration of digital health technologies across clinical trials. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams including Clinical Trial Management, Procurement, Legal, and Finance, follow industry-standard processes, and contribute to study operations from planning through closeout.
  
  
Responsibilities include managing digital health technology implementations, overseeing User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities, ensuring licensing compliance, and supporting vendor relationships. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior Digital Health Technologies Specialist can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research operations and digital innovation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide day-to-day digital tool and technology support, collaborating with vendors and internal cross-functional teams to ensure smooth study operations and timely resolution of technical issues
* Monitor compliance for assigned digital health technology studies and escalate compliance issues to the Digital Health Technologies Manager, contributing to compliance action plan development and implementation
* Drive User Acceptance Testing (UAT) strategy, planning, execution, and oversight by reviewing test plans, drafting UAT documentation, and directly participating in sponsor-level testing activities when applicable
* Research and determine appropriate copyright holders for clinical outcome assessment (COA) instruments and establish licensing requirements in collaboration with internal stakeholders
* Secure necessary digital tool and technology permissions and license agreements, reviewing terms and conditions to ensure alignment with study requirements and regulatory standards
* Track and communicate licensing and contract agreement status, serving as the central point of contact for internal and external stakeholders regarding licensing matters in clinical trials
* Review and coordinate payment of licensing invoices with internal finance functions to ensure timely and accurate processing
* Support end-to-end translation processes for digital tools and technologies, ensuring accurate and compliant localization for international studies
* Maintain and update database of license holders and digital tool agreements, ensuring ongoing compliance with contract terms and conditions
* Escalate operational risks and project challenges to the Digital Health Technologies Manager with proactive recommendations and action plans
* Participate in Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) revisions and departmental initiatives to drive continuous process improvement and operational excellence

**Candidate Profile**
**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**

* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple digital health technology projects simultaneously
* Experience working in clinical research, healthcare, or a regulated environment
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and with external vendors
* A patient-focused mindset and commitment to ensuring digital health technologies enhance clinical trial quality and patient safety
* Proactive problem-solving abilities with the capacity to recognize project challenges, implement action plans, and escalate risks in a timely manner
* Self-discipline and strong time management skills with the ability to meet deadlines and prioritize competing demands

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant industry experience
* Minimum of 4+ years of relevant industry experience in clinical research, study operations, or digital health technology support
* General knowledge and awareness of systems development processes and digital tool implementation
* Knowledge of ICH-GCP, regulatory requirements, and clinical trial processes
* Ability to acquire working knowledge of copyright law and licensing/permission requirements for digital tools and technologies
* Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS), electronic Trial Master Files (eTMF), or Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems
* Familiarity with digital health technologies, wearables, or mobile health applications in clinical trials
* Basic familiarity with clinical drug development processes and study phases
* Experience managing vendor relationships and contract negotiations
* Experience with User Acceptance Testing (UAT) planning and execution

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.
  
  
If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be a perfect fit, send them the link to apply!
