title: Associate IS Engineer
description:
**About Amgen**
Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases and make people’s lives easier, fuller, and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains at the cutting edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what is known today.
  
  
**Role Description**
We are seeking an Associate IS Engineer to support the delivery, operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of enterprise applications and digital solutions.
  
  
This is a blended application engineering role combining IT application support, application lifecycle management, technical troubleshooting, integration support, and software development. The successful candidate will work across both run/support activities and change/development initiatives, helping ensure applications remain reliable, secure, compliant, and fit for business needs.
  
  
Working under the guidance of senior engineers, the Associate IS Engineer will investigate and resolve application and integration issues, support application releases and upgrades, participate in incident and problem management, maintain application documentation and configurations, and work with business, infrastructure, platform, security, and vendor teams.
  
  
The role will also contribute to full-stack development and application enhancements, including front-end development, API integration, back-end development, testing, and deployment where required.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Provide day-to-day technical and operational support for enterprise applications and associated integrations which could be either of these SaaS, COTS and Custom-built application
* Monitor application health, availability, interfaces, scheduled jobs, and other operational components, and proactively identify potential issues.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve application incidents, defects, integration failures, data issues, and performance problems.
* Perform technical root-cause analysis and support implementation of corrective and preventive measures for recurring problems.
* Support incident, problem, request, and change-management processes in accordance with established IT service-management practices.
* Work with business users, application owners, infrastructure teams, security teams, integration teams, and external vendors to resolve technical issues.
* Support application configuration, upgrades, patches, releases, environment changes, and production deployments.
* Support application integrations with enterprise platforms, databases, APIs, identity and access-management solutions, and cloud services.
* Maintain application documentation including architecture and interface details, configuration information, operational procedures, troubleshooting guides, and support knowledge articles.
* Contribute to application lifecycle activities including technical assessments, upgrades, modernization, remediation, and application retirement where applicable.
* Participate in periodic operational, security, compliance, and application health activities as required.

**Software Development & Enhancement**

* Contribute to the design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of application enhancements and software solutions.
* Manage the application SDLC and supporting ITIL Lifecyle completely
* Translate business and technical requirements into maintainable and user-friendly application functionality.
* Develop or enhance front-end applications using technologies such as React, Vite, TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
* Build reusable, responsive, accessible user-interface components following enterprise design standards.
* Integrate applications with RESTful APIs, enterprise services, databases, and third-party platforms.
* Contribute to back-end development using Python and FastAPI, or comparable technologies, under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Participate in technical design discussions, peer code reviews, troubleshooting sessions, and technical walkthroughs.
* Follow coding standards, secure-development practices, reusable software-design patterns, and established engineering practices.
* Develop and maintain appropriate unit, integration, regression, and end-to-end automated tests.
* Support CI/CD processes for automated builds, testing, security scanning, and deployment.
* Analyse and remediate application vulnerabilities, software dependency issues, and technical debt in collaboration with senior engineers.

**Testing, Release & Operational Readiness**

* Create and execute functional, integration, regression, smoke, and end-to-end tests for application changes and releases.
* Support user acceptance testing and resolution of defects identified during testing.
* Validate APIs and system integrations using tools such as Postman or equivalent.
* Support release planning, deployment validation, and post-production verification.
* Ensure appropriate technical and support documentation is available before solutions transition into production.
* Work with support teams to ensure operational readiness for new applications, enhancements, integrations, and releases.

**Collaboration & Continuous Improvement**

* Collaborate with product managers, business stakeholders, application owners, developers, QA professionals, DevOps teams, infrastructure teams, cybersecurity teams, and external vendors.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, demonstrations, and retrospectives.
* Identify opportunities to improve application reliability, automate repetitive operational activities, and reduce recurring support issues.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and practices across application development, cloud, DevOps, API integration, observability, cybersecurity, automation, and AI.

**Basic Qualifications And Experience**

* Master's / Bachelor’s degree with 3–5 years of relevant experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience may include a combination of application development, application engineering, production/application support, system integration, testing, or IT operations.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Good understanding of information systems, application architecture, software-development lifecycle, and application-support lifecycle.
* Experience supporting business or enterprise applications in development, test, and/or production environments.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to investigate application incidents, software defects, integration failures, and data-related issues.
* Understanding of incident, problem, change, and release-management processes.
* Working knowledge of REST APIs and application integrations.
* Understanding of relational databases, SQL, and basic data-access concepts.
* Hands-on experience with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and/or TypeScript.
* Familiarity with React and Vite, Angular, Vue.js, or another modern front-end framework.
* Basic knowledge of Python and FastAPI, or a comparable back-end technology.
* Experience developing, testing, debugging, supporting, and deploying software applications.
* Understanding of software-testing methodologies including functional, integration, regression, smoke, end-to-end, and user acceptance testing.
* Experience creating and executing test cases and documenting test results.
* Familiarity with unit and UI testing frameworks such as Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, Playwright, Selenium, or equivalent tools.
* Familiarity with API testing using Postman or equivalent tools.
* Familiarity with defect and work-management platforms such as Jira or Azure DevOps.
* Familiarity with Git-based version control, branching, pull requests, and code reviews.
* Understanding of Agile and Scrum delivery methodologies.
* Basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment.
* Understanding of secure coding principles, OWASP guidance, authentication, authorization, dependency management, and application security.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with business users, technical teams, and external vendors.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Exposure to GxP or regulated systems and associated validation/compliance activities.
* Experience supporting enterprise applications in a production environment.
* Familiarity with IT service-management processes and tools such as ServiceNow.
* Experience working with SaaS and/or vendor-managed enterprise applications.
* Understanding of cloud platforms and cloud-hosted application architectures.
* Exposure to monitoring, logging, alerting, or application observability tools.
* Experience supporting API-based or middleware-based system integrations.
* Exposure to application lifecycle management, vulnerability remediation, upgrades, patching, and technical-debt remediation.
* Experience working in cross-functional teams involving business stakeholders, vendors, infrastructure, security, and application-development teams.

Company

Talent Systems, LLC is the leading technology solution provider for casting and auditioning to the entertainment industry. Casting directors and agents worldwide use Talent Systems’ portfolio of products to source and manage talent across film, television, commercials, theater and digital projects, powering an unparalleled, global casting software ecosystem.

Company Core Values

Job Description

We're looking for a hands-on QE engineer who can think like a tester and build like a developer. You'll own the quality for FastCast features: break down requirements into sharp test scenarios, automate them, and keep them running in CI. AI is core to how we work: you'll use AI tools at every step to generate, write and maintain tests faster than automation alone allows.

You'll sit with the developers building the product, catch issues early, and help the team ship fast without breaking things.

Responsibilities

* Understand product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria; turn them into clear test cases and scenarios covering happy paths, edge cases and negative flows
* Write and maintain E2E automation for web (Playwright preferred) and for our React Native mobile apps on iOS and Android, covering sprint stories, smoke and regression suites
* Run automated suites in CI/CD and triage failures fast: real bug, flaky test or environment issue
* Try out and adopt AI-powered QE tooling (e.g. Playwright MCP, self-healing locators, visual AI) and share what works with the team
* Do focused manual and exploratory testing where automation doesn't make sense yet
* Log clear, reproducible bugs and work with developers to get them fixed
* Test APIs and validate data with SQL where needed
* Prepare test data for sprint stories and regression runs
* Join Agile ceremonies and flag testability and quality risks early
* Help sign off releases and support production verification
* Report on test coverage and quality status for each sprint

Must-haves

* 2–3 years in QA / QE on web applications
* Strong at writing test cases and scenarios from requirements; you spot the edge cases others miss
* Hands-on test automation experience with Playwright, or other automation tools
* Good programming skills in JavaScript or TypeScript (Node.js a plus)
* Hands-on use of AI coding assistants for testing work, plus the judgment to review, verify and fix what they produce
* Understanding of test automation patterns like Page Object Model
* Experience running tests in a CI/CD pipeline (GitHub Actions, Jenkins or similar)
* API testing experience (Postman or similar)
* Working knowledge of SQL
* Comfortable with Git and Agile / Scrum
* Clear written and verbal communication; can explain a bug so a developer gets it the first time

Nice-to-haves

* Experience with Playwright specifically
* Exposure to BDD (Cucumber or similar)
* Testing native mobile apps (iOS, Android)
* Testing AI-powered features: LLM output quality, evals, prompt regressions
* Basic performance or load testing
* Experience with log tools (e.g. LogDNA) to debug failures
* Worked in a team shipping to production weekly or faster

Why join

* Own quality on a live product used by the entertainment industry
* Work side by side with the engineers building it, not in a separate QA silo
* Modern, automation-first stack with real room to grow into an SDET role

title: Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**About Us**
insightsoftware is a global provider of reporting, analytics, and performance management solutions that unlock the potential of business data and transform the way finance and data teams operate. We empower leaders from over 32,000 organizations to make timely and intelligent decisions. Our comprehensive solutions span Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Controllership, and Data and Analytics. We deliver finance teams the insights required to navigate any economic climate and drive greater financial intelligence, while increasing productivity, visibility, accuracy, and compliance. Learn more at
**insightsoftware.com.**
**Job Description**
**The Role**
insightsoftware is a global provider of comprehensive solutions for the Office of the CFO. As a Software Development Engineer in Test 2 on the Certent Disclosure Management (CDM) team, you'll be an engineer first. You'll work inside the codebase alongside developers to make CDM testable at every level, pushing coverage down the test pyramid so that most quality is proven by fast, reliable unit, component, and integration tests rather than slow end-to-end suites. Working closely with development and DevOps, you'll help ensure CDM ships reliable, high-quality releases to enterprise customers.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Refactor production C# code to improve testability: introduce dependency injection, create seams, decouple components, and remove hard-coded dependencies.
* Write characterization tests to safely bring legacy code under test before changing it.
* Pair with developers on design and on unit, component, and integration test strategy, and help them write better tests themselves.
* Use AI coding agents to write and refactor tests and production code. Own the agent rule files and tooling that govern how they write tests (e.g., AGENTS.md, MCP servers).
* Define and evolve the team's test architecture, deciding what belongs at each level of the pyramid and actively shrinking reliance on E2E tests.
* Review PRs, including agent-generated changes, for testability, test quality, and coverage, not just for whether tests exist.
* Review requirements and acceptance criteria early to shape testable designs.
* Build and maintain quality gates in CI pipelines (test stages, coverage, reporting, flaky-test detection).
* Develop reusable test libraries, fixtures, and test data builders in C#.
* Maintain a lean, targeted set of E2E and UI tests (Selenium, Ranorex) for critical user journeys across web and desktop.
* Contribute to API and performance testing.
* Participate in stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.

**What You Bring**
*Core Skills*

* Strong proficiency in C# and .NET, with experience writing and refactoring production code, not only test code.
* Deep experience with unit testing frameworks (xUnit, NUnit, or MSTest) and mocking libraries (Moq, NSubstitute, or similar).
* Solid understanding of dependency injection, SOLID principles, and techniques for breaking dependencies in legacy code.
* Hands-on experience using AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot agent mode, Cursor), the judgment to spot weak or incorrect agent output, and the ability to teach others to do the same.
* Experience writing integration and component tests (e.g., WebApplicationFactory, Testcontainers, in-memory or containerized databases).
* A clear point of view on the test pyramid and when each type of test is the right tool.
* Experience with CI/CD and source control (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Git, Bitbucket).
* Working experience with UI automation (Selenium, Ranorex, or similar).
* Experience in Agile Scrum/Kanban teams.

*Nice to Have*

* TDD experience.
* BDD experience (e.g., Reqnroll, SpecFlow, Gherkin).
* Contract testing (e.g., Pact), mutation testing (e.g., Stryker.NET), coverage tooling (e.g., Coverlet).
* Performance or load testing experience.
* Experience in financial reporting or other regulated domains.

**Experience**

* 4+ years of software development experience, including writing and refactoring production C# code.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

**Additional Information**
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Executive Manager - Data (Master + Transactional) Quality
description:
**Overview**
The Data (Master & Transactional) Quality Lead will act as a subject matter expert and individual contributor, enforcing Enterprise Data Management standards and governance practices to ensure successful business transformations across SAP S/4HANA programs.
  
  
The role will be responsible for driving end-to-end data quality, migration validation, and reconciliation activities for both Master Data and Transactional Data throughout the migration lifecycle. This includes data readiness assessments, migration quality controls, pre- and post-load validations, defect management, and business sign-off support. The individual will work closely with Data Migration, Functional, Technical, and Business teams to ensure migrated data is complete, accurate, reconciled, and aligned with Global Template standards.
  
  
Experience in SAP S/4HANA Data Migration programs, particularly in data validation and post-migration validation activities, is essential. Exposure to SNP CrystalBridge migration and validation solutions is highly desirable.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead data quality and validation activities across SAP S/4HANA migration programs.
* Define and execute validation strategies for Master Data and Transactional Data throughout mock cycles, dress rehearsals, and production cutovers.
* Partner with Data Migration and Data Validation teams to ensure completeness, accuracy, consistency, and integrity of migrated data.
* Establish and execute reconciliation frameworks including record counts, financial balancing, business process validations, and exception reporting.
* Manage questions and provide clear direction to development and validation teams during solution build, testing, and deployment phases.
* Monitor data quality metrics, identify issues, perform root cause analysis, and drive remediation activities.
* Work with Global teams to implement new validation patterns, controls, and automation opportunities.
* Maintain overall migration validation trackers, reporting dashboards, and conversion readiness statistics.
* Collaborate with business process teams (OTC, P2P, RTR, MTD, etc.) and data owners to validate business-critical data and transactions.
* Support cutover planning, mock migrations, dress rehearsals, hypercare, and post-go-live validation activities.
* Ensure global data standards, governance policies, and target-state data models are consistently adopted across deployments.
* Drive continuous improvement of migration validation processes, tools, and quality assurance methodologies.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum Bachelor’s degree is required. Computer Science or Information Systems is preferred..
* Minimum 10 years of experience in ERP transformation programs with a strong focus on Data Management, Data Migration, Data Quality, and Data Validation.
* Proven experience in at least 3 end-to-end SAP ERP/ECC to SAP S/4HANA migration programs.
* Extensive hands-on experience in migration validation and post-migration reconciliation of both Master Data and Transactional Data.
* Strong understanding of SAP data models including Customer, Vendor, Material, Finance, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing domains.
* Experience defining and executing:

+ Data Completeness Validations
+ Data Reconciliation Processes
+ Record Count Validations
+ Financial Reconciliations
+ Business Process Validations
+ Data Quality Assessments

* Experience working with large-scale datasets and enterprise migration tools.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate and resolve complex data issues.
* Experience collaborating with global business stakeholders, data owners, and functional teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

title: Copy of Lead, QA
description:
Ayr designs and manufactures critical power grid equipment including power transformers, distribution transformers, special-purpose transformers, high-voltage circuit breakers, and medium-voltage switchgear. They serve markets such as renewables, data centers, utilities, oil & gas, and industrial sectors. They position themselves as partners in power projects, offering lifecycle support and working to deliver faster than average industry timelines.
  
  
Website: https://ayr.energy
  
  
**Role Purpose**
Own in-process quality for medium and power transformers (33–400 kV), ensuring products meet applicable standards, customer specifications, and Ayr Energy's Quality Management System (QMS). Lead stage-wise quality controls across core, coil, tanking, assembly, oil processing, and final tests to achieve first-time-right builds, reduce rework, and elevate
  
  
customer satisfaction.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Quality System & Documentation
* Create and maintain Control Plans, Inspection & Test Plans (ITP), stage checklists, work instructions, and traveler/route cards; enforce hold/witness points.
* Own NCR/CAPA—facilitate structured root cause analysis (5-Why, Fishbone), implement fixes, and verify effectiveness; drive defect prevention.
* Maintain device history records, test certificates, as-built dossiers, and customer documentation packs for shipment and FAT.
* Supplier & Customer Interface
* Qualify and develop suppliers for critical items (CRGO, copper, bushings, OLTC, radiators, tanks); conduct audits and PPAP/FAI where applicable.
* Lead customer stage and final inspections (FAT), coordinate third-party inspections/test labs, and close observations promptly.
* Data, Metrics & Continuous Improvement
* Track FPY, rework/repair hours, supplier PPM, test bay failures, and COPQ; publish weekly/monthly dashboards.
* Apply 7 QC tools, MSA (GR&R), process capability (Cp/Cpk/Pp/Ppk), and SPC to stabilize and improve processes.
* Run kaizens to reduce defects (e.g., oil leaks, winding shorts, paint defects) and cycle time at critical stages.

Compliance & Standards
  
  

* ISO 9001:2015 QMS; ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 (EHS) – adhere to procedures and participate in audits.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Education: BE/B.Tech or Diploma in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering (Electrical preferred).
* Experience: 8–15 years in transformer manufacturing quality; at least 5 years hands-on in-process/stage inspection and test bay exposure for 66 kV+ class.
* Certifications (preferred): Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt, ASQ CQA/CQE, NDT Level II (VT/PT), Lead Auditor (ISO 9001).

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of transformer construction, drawings (GA, core/coil, schematic), tolerances, and insulation systems.
* Proficiency with electrical tests (TTR, WR, IR/PI, tan δ/PF, SFRA, AC withstand) and interpretation of results.
* Hands-on with metrology and torque tools; ability to set up gauges/fixtures and verify special processes.
* QMS documentation, RCA/CAPA, statistical analysis (MSA, Cp/Cpk), and SPC; working knowledge of ERP/MES and Minitab/Excel.
* Clear written/verbal communication; ability to coach operators, manage audits, and interface with customers and TPI bodies.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* First-pass yield at critical stages and final test
* Supplier PPM and on-time NCR closure
* Defect/rework reduction (%), COPQ trend
* Calibration compliance and audit scores
* On-time documentation pack readiness and shipment clearance

**Why Join Ayr Energy**
Be part of a fast-growing grid hardware company building mission-critical products. You will shape world-class manufacturing systems, work with global suppliers and utilities, and grow into leadership roles with clear impact on reliability and safety of power networks.
  
  
**Work Conditions**

* Primarily shop-floor based role with regular presence in test bay and oil processing areas.
* Shift and weekend support during critical builds or customer inspections as needed.
* Travel up to 60% for supplier audits, customer FATs, or type test witnessing.

title: Sr. BA II
description:
As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.
  
  
**Job Description**
Invesco understands data and the products created from data are the lifeblood of our business. Data-first functions work together seamlessly to enable Invesco to achieve the true value of data and data products. Invesco leverages data as a strategic asset by making quality, trusted data and content available to the right people, at the right time, in the right format, in the most efficient way possible to enable both large transformations and day-to-day operations.
  
  
This Senior Business Analyst role sits within the Product Engagement part of our Digital, Distribution and Enterprise Engineering (D2E2) organization. They maintain good relationships with internal partners and collaborate with their peers across the Distribution business domain. They develop a strong understanding of the investments and distribution data and business processes, including both how it is produced and consumed across all Distribution channels and how to apply Invesco’s Data strategy and practices to drive Distribution’s data capabilities forward.
  
  
The focus of this position is to work closely with the business units to gain in-depth understanding of customer's business strategy, processes, services, roadmap and the context in which the business operates. This role will be key to understanding and documenting capabilities needed to address business challenges. Under the general supervision, gather business and data requirements, convert the business and data requirements into technical requirements for solution development. The senior business analyst supports the product owner(s) in managing the scope of the assigned project(s), resolves any impediments from requirements perspective for development team, supports the system testing and user acceptance testing. The business analyst also performs validation of deliverables against requirements ensuring that solution is meeting the objectives.
  
  
You will be responsible for:
  

* The Senior Business Analyst is responsible for reviewing assigned business processes from end-to-end to identify and address operational, financial and technological risks.
* Analyzing and understanding the end-to-end Distribution processes and the data associated with multiple business processes having cross domain.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency.
* Responsibilities will include a full range of activities from leading small to mid-size projects to assisting product owners on larger more complex projects.
* Under the guidance of the product owners, the senior business analyst should be able to work with business stakeholders to document the functional and non-functional requirements.
* Conducts interviews to gather customer requirements via workshops, questionnaires, surveys, site visits, workflow storyboards, use cases, scenarios, and other methods.
* Translates conceptual customer requirements into functional requirements in a clear manner that is understandable to developers/project team.
* Demonstrate strong Problem-solving skills.
* Attending regular team and other required meetings daily/weekly.
* Ensuring clear and accurate communication and responding to data, business, and technology partners and peers in a timely manner.
* Provides updates to senior management, project stakeholders on the progress of the project and or assigned tasks.
* Reports weekly status to senior management and project team as applicable
* Conduct UAT testing when rolling out new regulatory filings or added data sources
* Identify, research, document and / or remediate exceptions
* Analyzes and verifies requirements for completeness, consistency, comprehensibility, feasibility, and conformity to standards.

This individual:
  

* Must be comfortable working in a scaled agile development environment
* Have an ability to handle multiple requests from varied stakeholders, in a way that maintains clear priority, and ability to adjust when needed
* Be an effective “translator” of business needs into technical requirements
* Demonstrate an ability to build relationships, collaborate, and influence internal and external teams
* Be able to work under guidance of senior team member, take initiative, and get projects completed with great attention to detail and on time.

The experience you bring:
  

* A bachelor’s degree in finance, Business Administration, Information Technology.
* Minimum 5-6 years of business and data analysis experience
* Minimum 4-7 year of experience in the Investment Management industry/Asset Management/Financial Services industry.
* Strong scripting skills in programming languages like SQL and Python, as you will be responsible for writing queries and other data transformation scripts.
* Solid knowledge of Data Life cycle, data governance, data risk, Master data management concepts, data modeling, Business intelligence and analytics concepts.
* Ability to work in a team/group setting.
* Ability to interpret complex or vague instructions and successfully produce results.
* Proactively identifies, analyzes, and resolves procedural fail points.
* Demonstrates superior judgement, reasoning, and follow-up skills.
* Demonstrates a high level of initiative, assertiveness, and self-confidence.
* Proactively identifies and analyzes procedural improvements. Initiate projects/workflow that would enhance the department's functions.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office products
* Shares information efficiently between team members.
* Promotes Teamwork.
* Effectively manages multiple responsibilities and meets deadlines.
* An understanding of the concepts related to data modelling, coding and process flow design
* Excellent analytical, mathematical, and creative problem-solving skills
* Excellent listening, interpersonal, written and oral communication skills
* Logical and efficient, with attention to detail

Full time

Employee

No
  
  
**Workplace Model**
At Invesco, our workplace model supports our culture and meets the needs of our clients while providing flexibility our employees value. As a full-time employee, compliance with the workplace policy means working with your direct manager to create a schedule where you will work in your designated office at least three days a week, with two days working outside an Invesco office.

In Invesco, we act with integrity and do meaningful work to create impact for our stakeholders. We believe our culture is stronger when we all feel we belong, and we respect each other’s identities, lives, health, and well-being. We come together to create better solutions for our clients, our business and each other by building on different voices and perspectives. We nurture and encourage each other to ensure our meaningful growth, both personally and professionally.
  
  
We believe in diverse, inclusive, and supportive workplace where everyone feels equally valued, and this starts at the top with our senior leaders having diversity and inclusion goals. Our global focus on diversity and inclusion has grown exponentially and we encourage connection and community through our many employee-led Business Resource Groups (BRGs).
  
  
**What’s in it for you?**
As an organization we support personal needs, diverse backgrounds and provide internal networks, as well as opportunities to get involved in the community and in the world.
  
  
Our benefit policy includes but not limited to:
  

* Competitive Compensation

title: Staff Manager – Bluetooth Testing and Automation
description:
**Company**
Qualcomm India Private Limited
  
  
**Job Area**
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Systems Test Engineering
  
  
**General Summary**
We are seeking a Technical Manager to lead Bluetooth validation and test automation for Qualcomm connectivity solutions. This role combines hands-on technical expertise with team leadership and ownership of test strategy, execution, and release quality across Bluetooth Classic (BR/EDR), Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), and HDT.
  
  
You will work closely with development and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality Bluetooth features for handsets, wearables, industrial IoT, and voice and music products. You will guide engineers, drive complex issue resolution, and strengthen automation and quality processes across the validation lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end Bluetooth validation, including test planning, functional and protocol testing, regression execution, and release-readiness assessment.
* Translate product and feature requirements into test strategies, coverage plans, priorities, and execution milestones.
* Manage validation priorities, resource allocation, and dependencies; communicate progress, quality risks, and mitigation plans to stakeholders.
* Provide hands-on technical leadership in debugging Bluetooth issues using protocol traces, network analyzers, and system logs; collaborate with development teams on root-cause analysis and resolution.
* Drive test automation and framework enhancements to improve coverage, repeatability, and execution efficiency.
* Lead validation of throughput, CPU utilization, battery-current consumption, and Bluetooth certification requirements.
* Mentor engineers, review test plans and technical findings, and build team capability in Bluetooth protocols, debugging, and automation.
* Maintain disciplined QA processes, clear documentation, and effective cross-functional communication to support customer deliverables.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* 8–12 years of relevant experience in Bluetooth testing and validation, with experience leading technical execution and guiding engineers.
* Strong knowledge of Bluetooth BR/EDR, BLE, and HDT, including protocol and feature testing, system-level debugging, and optimization.
* Hands-on experience with Bluetooth protocol analyzers such as Frontline and Ellisys, supported by strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Knowledge of Bluetooth profiles including AVRCP, PBAP, A2DP, HFP, OPP, PAN, and A2DP Sink.
* Familiarity with Bluetooth 5.0 features and Bluetooth certification testing.
* Experience evaluating Bluetooth throughput, CPU utilization, and battery-current consumption.
* Strong test automation and framework-development experience using one or more of Python, C++, Perl, Tcl, or shell scripting.
* Good understanding of networking concepts and TCP/IP protocols.
* Ability to own project requirements independently, prioritize competing needs, and coordinate delivery across teams.
* Strong communication, documentation, organizational, and mentoring skills.

**Preferred Experience**
Hands-on BT testing experience.
  
  

* Experience supporting Bluetooth validation for handsets, wearables, industrial IoT, or voice and music products.
* Experience improving validation processes and scaling automation across features or product programs.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Systems Test Engineering or related work experience.

OR
  
  
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3+ years of Systems Test Engineering or related work experience.
  
  
OR
  
  
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Systems Test Engineering or related work experience.

title: Teamcenter Design Analyst
description:

Specify Teamcenter enhancements required for the PLM-ERP integration and capture acceptance criteria.

Prepare and facilitate design reviews and drive customer sign-off of system requirements.

Working knowledge of Siemens Teamcenter data model (Items, BOM, BOP, Change Management).

Familiarity with SAP S/4 HANA master data (Material/Item Master, BOM, Routing).

Experience authoring functional/technical design documents and requirements traceability.

Strong analytical, documentation, and stakeholder-facing communication skills.

Preferred / Additional Skills

Exposure to T4ST / Teamcenter-for-SAP or similar PLM-ERP integration middleware.

Manufacturing / discrete or medical-device industry domain knowledge.

title: Software Test Engineer [Manual + Automation]
description:
**QA Engineer - Manual + Automation**

**Roles & Responsibilities | 4+ Years Experience**

**Core Responsibilities**

* Analyze business requirements, functional specifications, and technical documents to design effective test cases.
* Develop, maintain, and execute detailed test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for functional, integration, regression, system, and user acceptance testing (UAT).
* Perform manual testing across web applications and mobile apps on Android and iOS, including functional, regression, compatibility, usability, installation/update, and device/OS-specific scenarios.
* Validate mobile-specific scenarios such as installation/upgrade, permissions, notifications, deep links, orientation, background/foreground behavior, offline/poor-network conditions, and different screen sizes.
* Perform testing on physical devices and emulators/simulators across representative Android and iOS versions, and capture device logs/crash details when troubleshooting issues.
* Identify, log, track, and retest defects using tools such as JIRA, Bugzilla, or similar.
* Ensure comprehensive test coverage and maintain traceability between requirements and test cases.
* Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives in an Agile/Scrum environment.

**Automation Testing Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, maintain, and execute automated test scripts for web applications and, where applicable, mobile applications.
* Hands-on experience with Playwright or Selenium for web UI automation testing; exposure to Appium or a similar mobile automation framework is preferred.
* Candidate should have used Playwright and/or Selenium in previous projects and should be able to create and maintain automation test suites independently. Experience testing Android and/or iOS applications in real projects is also expected.
* Identify suitable manual test cases for automation and improve smoke and regression coverage through automation.
* Analyze automation failures and identify whether issues are related to application defects, test scripts, test data, or environment/configuration.
* Maintain reusable automation components, page objects, test fixtures, test data, and utilities.
* Integrate automated tests with CI/CD pipelines such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar.
* Generate and review automation execution reports and communicate failures clearly to the development team.

**Collaboration & Reporting**

* Work closely with developers, product managers, and business analysts to clarify requirements and resolve issues.
* Provide timely and detailed test execution status reports to the QA Lead / Project Manager.
* Support UAT by assisting business users and validating fixes.
* Work with developers to improve application testability and contribute to continuous testing practices.

**Quality Assurance Practices**

* Follow industry best practices for QA, including risk-based testing and defect management.
* Ensure compliance with organizational quality standards and processes.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of testing practices, automation coverage, and methodologies.

**Additional Expectations**

* Mentor junior testers by sharing knowledge and reviewing test cases and automation scripts.
* Take ownership of testing for assigned modules or projects with minimal supervision.
* Provide input for test effort estimation and project planning.
* Identify opportunities for test optimization and improvements in QA processes.
* Be able to explain automation framework design, locator strategy, waits, assertions, reporting, test data management, and troubleshooting of flaky tests.

**Key Skills Required**

* Strong knowledge of STLC (Software Testing Life Cycle) and SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle).
* Proficiency in writing test cases, test scenarios, and clear bug reports.
* Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA, Bugzilla, Mantis, or similar.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodology.
* Good understanding of functional, regression, integration, UAT, smoke, sanity, and exploratory testing.
* Basic knowledge of SQL for backend data validation.
* Practical experience with Playwright or Selenium WebDriver.
* Hands-on mobile app testing experience on Android and/or iOS; familiarity with Appium or a similar mobile automation framework is an added advantage.
* Good understanding of Page Object Model (POM), reusable components, assertions, waits, test fixtures, and data-driven testing.
* Experience with at least one programming/scripting language such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Python.
* Basic understanding of API testing and API automation using Postman, REST Assured, Playwright API testing, or similar.
* Familiarity with Git/version control and basic CI/CD concepts.
* Ability to troubleshoot flaky tests and improve automation reliability.
* Understanding of when a test case should be automated versus kept as a manual test.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Experience testing across multiple browsers such as Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Safari/WebKit, and across representative Android/iOS devices and OS versions.
* Experience with mobile app testing, including native/hybrid apps, WebView flows, device permissions, network conditions, app lifecycle, and release validation, is preferred.
* Familiarity with Android Studio/ADB, Xcode device logs, crash logs, or similar mobile debugging tools is an advantage.
* Experience running automation tests in CI/CD pipelines and generating test reports.
* Basic knowledge of performance, accessibility, or security testing is an added advantage.

title: Mainframe Testing Lead
description:
Education: Graduation in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  
  

* 5–20 years of hands-on experience in software testing, with significant exposure to mainframe environments.
* Strong expertise in Mainframe Testing, including test case design, execution, and defect management for COBOL/JCL-based applications.
* Solid working knowledge of VSAM file structures, utilities, and validation techniques for test data creation and verification.
* Proficiency in JCL for executing, monitoring, and troubleshooting batch jobs in test environments.
* Practical experience with DB2 for writing queries, validating data, and supporting end-to-end test scenarios.
* Exposure to CI/CD practices and tools, with the ability to integrate and execute tests within automated pipelines.
* Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders. Lead end-to-end mainframe testing initiatives across multiple projects, including test planning, design, execution, and closure for applications built on COBOL, JCL, VSAM, and DB2.
* Define and implement comprehensive test strategies for functional, regression, integration, and system testing in mainframe environments, ensuring coverage of business-critical scenarios.
* Analyze and validate complex data structures in VSAM files and DB2 databases, designing test data and queries to ensure data integrity and accurate processing.
* Review and optimize JCL used in test environments, coordinating with development and operations teams to schedule, execute, and troubleshoot batch jobs.
* Drive CI/CD-based quality practices by integrating test suites into pipelines, enabling early defect detection and continuous feedback to development teams.

* Proficient in Module based Data Analysis, Part Type Ownership Analysis and new part setup activities
* Track probe yield performance and trends to identify, characterize, and explain gaps between target and actual yields.
* Perform advanced data analysis to quantify yield issues and generate accurate yield paretos that guide fab priorities and improvement efforts.
* Apply statistical and data‑mining techniques to identify root causes and uncover opportunities for sustainable yield improvement.
* Collaborate closely with PI, Probe, PE, EFA, and PFA teams to correlate electrical signals, probe signatures, and physical findings into actionable insights for process teams.
* Partner with module, inline monitoring, and global teams to implement, monitor, and standardize yield fixes, leveraging strong semiconductor process, defect, and metrology knowledge.
* Discover yield issues in NAND development and identify unique metric or combination of metrics, such as wafer/dice/tile shading, ECATS or other custom metric for issues quantification

* Initiate data mining and correlation study on new issue seen. Initiate PFA request to identify root cause of yield issue. Perform inline correlation study to establish inline prediction to yield issue. Make yield projections based on expected improvement/downside. Conduct yield trend analysis, identify root causes in process step, conversion, algorithm change, and design, for yield shift
* Continuously develop/re-define inline detection in collaboration with metrology and RDA team
* Identify and define gaps with current test and co-develop (with product, probe, param engineering) unique parametric/probe bins to detect new fail modes as well as validate new program release
* Collaborate with module owners to identify, quantify key module deficiencies/technology gaps, and drive cross-functional teams to address. Optimize existing layout, conceptualize, and develop innovative solutions to meet product requirements and manufacturability
* Develop and innovate techniques in extracting data from different databases through various query languages and automate through scripting to improve work efficiency
* Assist and support the transfer documentation of layout/architecture fundamentals of new technology from R&D to manufacturing fab.
* Integrates AI-assisted tools and insights into daily work to improve efficiency, quality, or effectiveness, exercising sound judgment and complying with organizational standards and legal requirements.
* Contributes to a culture of continuous improvement by identifying, testing, and sharing AI-enabled enhancements within one’s scope of work.

title: Senior Technical Engineer – LabVantage Master Data
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
**About Lilly**
At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients. We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. We bring our best to this work because people depend on it. If you're driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly.
  
  
**About The Technology Organization**
At Lilly, technology is not a support function. It is how a global medicine company operates, innovates, and delivers. Lilly in Hyderabad builds the capabilities that make this possible, cloud platforms, AI systems, and automation at enterprise scale, all in service of a purpose that makes this technology work genuinely distinctive, from advancing drug discovery to enabling connected clinical trials to keeping a global medicine company running at the standard patients deserve.
  
  
**About The Business Function**
From molecule to market, Global Manufacturing plays an important role in every step along a product’s lifecycle. Most of our customers never see the scientific and technical resources behind our medicines. But customers experience, every day, the performance of our high-quality products and global supply network.
  
  
Global Manufacturing comprises a core group of functions that drives the production and supply of high-quality products: Engineering; Manufacturing Information & Control Systems (Technology@Lilly); Quality & Labs, Technology Services/Manufacturing Science; Global Health, Safety and Environment; and Supply Chain.
  
  
**Role: Senior Technical Engineer – LabVantage Master Data**
The Senior Technical Engineer will be leading designing, building, and automating analytical test methods and associated data and specifications within LabVantage LIMS, and for developing or coordinating the development of instrument drivers and integrations that enable direct data capture into LIMS from laboratory instruments.
  
  
This role combines domain expertise in laboratory processes and analytical methods with technical leadership in LIMS MD configuration & Custom development. The incumbent will play a key role in advancing the organization’s digital laboratory ecosystem, driving data integrity, automation, and compliance in GxP systems.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**What**
**you’ll**
**be doing:**
**LabVantage MD Development & Build**

* Develop the configuration, creation, and lifecycle management of analytical test methods in LabVantage LIMS (i.e. All interconnected MDs to support entire workflow for test method to work as per expectations).
* Implement test templates, specifications, and parameter lists ensuring standardization and scalability across products and sites.
* Define and maintain Test method metadata structures for automation (units, limits, calculations, result entry templates).
* Custom Script development for data transfer or verifications
* Implement Test method versioning, review, and approval workflows in accordance with organisational data governance and validation policies.
* Partner with functional SMEs to ensure test methods adhering with GxP, ALCOA+, and analytical method validation principles.
* Build test scenarios/ documents and Test method templates

**Technical Maintenance and Master Data Support**

* Triage, analyze and resolve issues through root cause analysis, harnessing both business and technical knowledge to minimize downtime.
* Driver L3 Engineering with global data team, site team and ensuring timely completion
* Develop and maintain scripts, business rules, and LabVantage SDK components to automate data processing and workflow activities.
* Enable service improvement through fixes of incidences
* Support and analyze instrument integrations (e.g.,Lab Application - Empower, Chromeleon, SmartLab, Darwin, Complex instruments) and maintain data exchange with ERP, ELN, QMS, EM and analytics systems.

**Automation & Digital Integration**

* Develop automation frameworks to reduce manual effort in test method setup and instrument data handling.
* Support initiatives for automated test method build from structured templates or upstream systems (ERP/PLM).
* Collaborate with analytics teams to make instrument and method data analytics-ready for dashboards and trending.

**Governance, Validation & Documentation**

* Support for versioned MD, and auditable as part of GxP compliance and following regulatory and Lilly IT quality standards (CSV-Computer System Validation).
* Create design documents, configuration specifications and technical SOPs for test method.
* Support QA in CSV, change control, and periodic review activities.
* Active participation in audits and ensure all automation components meet 21 CFR Part 11 and Annex 11 requirements.
* Prepare and maintain design specifications, configuration documentation, and validation test scripts for IQ/OQ/PQ activities along with installation procedures
* Support change control, release management, ensuring compliance and stability in a multi-environment setup.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Strong technical SME for LabVantage test method management
* Collaboration with site-level LabVantage data stewards to lead test methods management
* Partner with global digital, quality, and IT SMEs to define and implement standards for method and instrument onboarding.
* Enable process improvement through automation, template standardization, and adoption of new technologies

**How You Will Succeed**

* Reduced manual effort and faster development of new test methods.
* Improved data flow between LabVantage and analytical instruments in secured environment
* Compliance with global lab data governance and validation standards.
* Enablement of analytics-ready, high-quality laboratory data.

**What You Should Bring**

* Strong analytical and critical thinking.
* Technical proficiency in LIMS MD development, management and delievrables
* Understanding of analytical lab workflows and instruments.
* Excellent documentation and verbal communication

title: Domain Expert - Labelling & Scanning
description:
**Job Summary**
Are you passionate about innovation that transforms everyday products into extraordinary experiences?
  
  
IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and health & biosciences, we deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products.
  
  
Food Ingredients: Innovating improved nutritional profiles, better taste and texture and greater cost efficiency to meet the needs of global food and beverage manufacturers.
  
  
The role is based in Hyderabad, India (Hybrid role). Be part of a motivated, passionate, and open-minded team where together we can achieve greatness and make a real impact. Your potential is our inspiration.
  
  
**Where You’ll Make a Difference**

* End-to-end ownership of global labeling solutions for raw materials, semi-finished goods, finished goods, and shipping labels, with expertise in integrated labeling architectures, ERP connectivity, barcode-driven supply chains, traceability, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency.
* Expertise in SAP labeling integration (Output Partner, HTTPS, logical system-based printing), BarTender administration, print server management, and secure DMZ print infrastructure, including deployment, troubleshooting, and governance.
* Advanced knowledge of GS1 barcode standards, enterprise labeling integrations, XML/JSON/XSLT data transformations, Zebra/ZPL printing, BarOne label design, SAP Smart Forms integration, and end-to-end labeling ecosystem management.
* Administration and support of Android/Windows CE handheld devices, SOTI MobiControl, TekRF, and StayLinked environments, including barcode scanning, Zebra mobility solutions, device lifecycle management, deployments, troubleshooting, and license management.
* Scanner ecosystem administration and support, including wireless mobility infrastructure, enterprise application integration, barcode scanning operations, monitoring, troubleshooting, and end-to-end transaction processing.
* Technical ownership of enterprise labeling and mobility platforms, including solution architecture, implementation, lifecycle management, cross-functional collaboration, root cause analysis, and the development of global standards for labeling, barcode, and mobility solutions.
* Responsible for the complete lifecycle of enterprise labeling, printing, barcode, and mobility solutions, ensuring reliable integration between business systems, infrastructure, printers, scanners, and operational processes across global manufacturing and supply chain environments.

**What Makes You The Right Fit**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology or any other relevant discipline.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in architecture development and project management.
* Deep understanding of the supporting systems and connected applications, their interfaces, and data flows.
* Understanding of business architecture, processes and standards/ policies.
* Hands-on experience with enterprise labeling platforms such as BarTender, BarOne, Loftware, or equivalent labeling solutions within manufacturing and supply chain environments.
* Strong knowledge of barcode standards, labeling compliance requirements, printer technologies, and mobility solutions, including Zebra printers, handheld scanners, and wireless device management platforms.
* Experience integrating labeling and mobility solutions with SAP ERP, databases, middleware, and enterprise applications, with a solid understanding of system interfaces and data flows.
* Proven problem-solving and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to lead complex technical initiatives, drive continuous improvements, and support global business operations.

**Why Choose Us?**

* Multinational and supporting environment
* Health insurance
* Training opportunities
* Learning and development programs

**Important Information Regarding This Position**
For your awareness, IFF has announced its intention to sell its Food Ingredients Business to CVC Capital Partners. The sale is presently expected to close in the first half of 2027, pending regulatory approvals and other closing conditions. The Food Ingredient business unit will remain a part of IFF until close and, at such time, it will transition to CVC Capital Partners. In applying for this position, you acknowledge your awareness that the position is a part of the Food Ingredient business unit and has been identified to transition to CVC Capital Partners.
  
  
We are a global leader in taste, scent, and nutrition, offering our customers a broader range of natural solutions and accelerating our growth strategy. At IFF, we believe that your uniqueness unleashes our potential. We value the diverse mosaic of the ethnicity, national origin, race, age, sex, or veteran status. * Maintain and enhance audit methodologies, templates, standards, and governance processes.

* Develop dashboards and reporting to monitor audit progress, quality, and operational metrics.

* Lead the Quality Assurance & Improvement Program, ensuring compliance with audit methodology and standards.

* Support external assessments and continuous improvement initiatives across the audit function.
* Analyze quality trends, root causes, and performance insights to drive improvement actions.
* Lead, coach, and develop audit, data analytics, and IT&D team members within the COE.

* Foster a high-performance culture focused on collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.
* Partner with Audit Leaders, Domain Leads, and stakeholders to ensure consistent audit delivery.
* Communicate operational insights, QA outcomes, and recommendations to senior management.
* Support management and audit committee reporting with relevant performance and quality metrics.
* Drive adoption of analytics, automation, digital tools, and innovative audit practices.
* Pilot and implement new methodologies, technologies, and process improvements.
* Contribute to initiatives that enhance audit effectiveness, efficiency, and overall value delivery.

The experience we're looking for
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Engineering, or related field.
* Professional certifications such as CIA, CPA, CA, CISA, or Lean Six Sigma (preferred).
* 8–12 years of Internal Audit experience, with strong exposure to operational audits and audit quality reviews.
* Demonstrated experience in global or matrixed organisations, ideally within FMCG/Consumer Health or comparable industries.
* Strong understanding of IIA Standards, audit methodology, risk assessment, process evaluation, and quality principles.
* Proven ability to lead teams, coach others, and foster a high‑performance culture.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across diverse geographies.
* Comfortable working with ERP systems (SAP/JDE) and analytics/visualisation tools (Power BI desirable).

The skills for success
  
  

* Data Analytics & Insights
* Audit & Risk Management
* Data Extraction & Transformation
* Data Visualization & Reporting
* Data Governance & Quality Management
* Automation & Continuous Monitoring
* Critical Thinking & Problem Solving
* Stakeholder Management
* Communication & Data Storytelling
* Project & Delivery Management

What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way.
  
  
We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt’s potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt’s pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don’t always ‘tick all the boxes’. That’s why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don’t meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

title: Test Validation Engineer
description:
**Hiring Validation Test Engineer**

**Job Title:**
Validation Test Engineer

**Job Type:**
Full-time

**Location:**
Kokapet, Hyderabad (Work from Office only)

**Experience:**
3–5 Years

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a
**detail-oriented Validation Test Engineer**
with hands-on experience in end-to-end product testing and Computer System Validation (CSV).
**The candidate will be responsible for testing product modules, validating functionality against requirements, identifying and reporting defects, coordinating with Development teams for resolution, and performing retesting and regression testing**
. The role also involves preparing and executing validation documentation to ensure compliance with applicable GxP regulatory requirements and industry standards.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Perform end-to-end product testing across individual modules, features, workflows, and integrated functionalities.
* Understand product requirements and design comprehensive test scenarios, test cases, and test data covering positive, negative, boundary, and exception scenarios.
* Execute functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and user acceptance testing (UAT), as applicable.
* Verify application functionality, data integrity, workflow transitions, user roles and permissions, audit trails, electronic signatures, and other relevant system features.
* Identify, document, and report defects with clear steps to reproduce, expected versus actual results, screenshots, and supporting evidence.
* Log, prioritize, assign, and track defects in Jira; follow up with Development teams to ensure timely resolution.
* Perform defect retesting after fixes are deployed and conduct regression testing to ensure existing functionalities remain unaffected.
* Maintain test execution records, defect status, test evidence, and testing progress reports.
* Review URS and FRS documents to develop and execute OQ, PQ, and UAT test cases, ensuring appropriate requirement coverage and traceability.
* Author and maintain validation deliverables, including Validation Plan, URS, FRS, Functional Risk Assessment, 21 CFR Part 11 Assessment, Traceability Matrix, and Validation Summary Report.
* Ensure compliance with Good Documentation Practices (GDP), GAMP 5 guidelines, GxP requirements, and applicable regulatory standards throughout the system lifecycle.
* Collaborate with Development, QA, and Validation teams to investigate issues, clarify requirements, improve product quality, and support release readiness.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* **3–7 years of relevant experience in software/product testing and/or Computer System Validation.**
* Hands-on experience in end-to-end application
  **testing, test case design, execution, defect reporting, retesting, and regression testing.**
* Practical experience using
  **Jira for defect logging, tracking, and closure.**
* Ability to analyze requirements, identify edge cases, and validate complex workflows across multiple modules.
* Experience in
  **drafting and executing OQ/PQ protocols and validation test cases.**
* Good understanding of
  **the CSV lifecycle, risk-based validation, and requirement traceability.**
* Knowledge of
  **GAMP 5, GxP best practices, Good Documentation Practices, and 21 CFR Part 11.**
* Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively.

**Educational Qualifications**

Bachelor’s degree in Science, Engineering, or a related discipline is required.

description:

**Description**
Infor's AI Studio represents an agentic platform that enables teams to author, configure, and deploy Infor OS and ERP solutions utilizing natural language processing capabilities. We are seeking an Lead Quality Assurance Engineer to join the AI Studio team and lead the QA team to thoroughly validate the agent architecture of AI Studio. The testing will spread across components like ION, Data Fabric, Birst, EPM, RPA/IDP, CSD, and Portal. This initiative constitutes a strategic priority for Infor, designed to accelerate velocity suite sales, enhance customer experience, and facilitate more effective collaboration between Cutomers and Sevices, FDEs, Partners and SCs
  
  
We are seeking a Team Lead for Quality Assurance to lead the testing efforts to deliver high quality software solutions across our cloud product portfolio.
  
  
**A Typical Day In The Life Includes**
**A Day in the Life Typically Includes:**

* Define and own the overall QA strategy for AI Studio — covering search relevance, multi-agent coordination, schema validation, tenant isolation, and LLM output quality.
* Lead a team of QA engineers, assign test coverage areas, review test plans, and ensure quality gates are met before each release.
* Collaborate with the AI Studio architecture team, component teams, and FDEs to understand new features, contribution model changes, and agent updates — translating these into test requirements.
* Drive the design of evaluation frameworks for non-deterministic Orchestrator outputs — defining what "correct" means for gap maps, dependency graphs, and blueprint quality across varying user inputs.
* Oversee search relevance regression testing — ensuring that as the knowledge corpus grows, existing query-result quality does not degrade.
* Define and enforce tenant isolation testing standards, ensuring no cross-tenant data leakage across sessions, project history, or search results.
* Report quality metrics to engineering leadership — solution generation success rates, clarification round counts, agent failure rates, and corpus coverage gaps.

**Basic Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field. 8–10 years of experience in software quality assurance with at least 3 years in a lead or principal QA role.
* Proven experience leading QA for an AI or data-intensive product in production — not just familiarity with concepts but hands-on ownership of quality outcomes.
* Deep understanding of RAG system testing — search relevance validation, embedding quality assessment, hybrid search behaviour, and corpus quality measurement.
* Strong experience with multi-agent or distributed system testing — tracing failures across service boundaries, validating inter-agent contracts, and verifying execution ordering.
* Experience building and maintaining automated test suites in Python, with the ability to define quality frameworks from scratch rather than inheriting them.
* Solid understanding of LLM evaluation methodologies and tools such as RAGAS, DeepEval, or equivalent — with the ability to select and adapt them to non-standard evaluation problems.
* Experience with REST API contract testing and integration testing across multi-service architectures.
* Experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS (Preferred), Azure, or GCP.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills — ability to translate quality findings into clear risk assessments for engineering leadership and product teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**
**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience leading QA for agentic AI systems or LLM orchestration pipelines where output correctness is semantic rather than deterministic.
* Familiarity with OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, or other vector and hybrid search platforms — ideally with hands-on experience designing relevance test suites.
* Knowledge of prompt adversarial testing — designing inputs that expose reasoning failures, hallucinations, incorrect component selection, or silent gap map errors.
* Experience with MLOps or LLMOps observability tooling — defining monitoring standards, alert thresholds, and trace inspection processes for AI pipelines.
* Familiarity with multi-tenant SaaS security testing, particularly tenant isolation and session boundary enforcement.
* Exposure to Infor OS, ERP systems, or enterprise workflow automation products — understanding the domain context that AI Studio operates in.
* Experience establishing QA contribution processes for knowledge-driven systems where test data quality directly determines test coverage effectiveness.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices — ability to integrate quality gates into automated deployment workflows.

**About Infor**
Infor is where ambition meets impact. * Assists in other areas of the company as necessary.

Strong knowledge of SDLC and SQA methodology as well as experience testing on Agile teams.

title: Sr Quality Engineer
description:
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.
  
  
At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.
  
  
As we continue to scale our global platform, the Senior Quality Engineer will play a critical role in embedding quality across Supply Chain, FinTech/Payments, and ERP platforms throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a hands-on Senior Quality Engineer to independently own testing activities and strengthen quality across our Supply Chain, FinTech/Payments, and ERP platforms. Working closely with software engineers and product managers, this role identifies risks early, improves testability, and embeds quality into requirements, design, development, and release practices. The Senior Quality Engineer delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.
  
  
**How Will You Drive Impact**
Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.
  
  
Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)
  
  

* Partner with development and product teams during refinement and design to challenge ambiguous requirements, define testable acceptance criteria, and identify edge cases and integration risks before implementation begins.
* Contribute to shared QE standards, review automation code for test design and maintainability, and mentor teammates on continuous testing, shift-left, and AI-assisted testing practices.
* Collaborate with developers on appropriate unit, component, API, and integration coverage to drive shift-left and continuous testing practices across the team.

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)
  
  

* Build end-to-end automated tests for critical business journeys including order, fulfillment, payment, and ERP/finance posting flows to protect reliability for end customers.
* Perform focused exploratory and manual testing for complex workflows, boundary conditions, and scenarios requiring human judgment to catch issues before they reach production.
* Validate data accuracy and consistency across services, databases, and integrated systems — including reconciliation checks — to ensure customers experience accurate, trustworthy transactions.
* Define, maintain, and report quality metrics and dashboards covering defect trends, escaped defects, and release readiness to support confident delivery decisions.

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)
  
  

* Apply LLMs and AI-assisted or agent-based (including MCP-based) workflows to test scenario generation, test data creation, automation implementation, maintenance, and failure triage, reviewing generated tests for correctness and meaningful assertions.
* Test AI/LLM-powered features where applicable, validating output quality and behavior with evals and non-deterministic testing approaches, and evaluate AI self-healing and visual testing tools for fit.
* Investigate flaky tests, diagnose failures using logs, API responses, and queries, and work with developers on root causes and regression prevention to continuously improve pipeline reliability.
* Contribute experience in performance, resilience, and security testing for critical flows, bringing a proactive lens to systemic risk reduction.

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)
  
  

* Independently own test strategy, planning, estimation, test data, execution, defect triage, and quality reporting for the team — identifying dependencies and escalating risks early.
* Design, build, and maintain reusable automation frameworks and suites for APIs, web applications, integrations, and data validation, keeping coverage aligned with business risk and system changes.
* Integrate automated tests and actionable reporting into CI/CD pipelines, improving execution speed and reliability to maintain dependable regression feedback at every stage of delivery.
* Provide regular, evidence-based updates on testing progress, blockers, residual risks, and release readiness to support delivery decisions and continuous improvement.

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY
  
  
We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:
  
  

* Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
* Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
* Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
* Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

**Required Qualifications**
CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING
  
  

* 8+ years of experience in software quality engineering, with demonstrated senior-level technical depth and independent ownership of testing in an Agile engineering team.
* Hands-on experience designing and maintaining automation frameworks and reliable test suites, with strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript (Java or Go also valued) and comfort working across languages.
* Practical experience using AI in test automation workflows — including LLM-assisted test and test-data generation, agentic/MCP-based automation, testing AI/LLM-powered features, or AI self-healing and visual testing tools — with concrete examples of improved coverage, faster delivery, or reduced maintenance effort and the ability to explain how generated tests were reviewed and validated.
