title: Associate Manager GES DTS SNOW
description:
**Job title**
–
**Associate**
**Manager**
**GES DTS ServiceNow (SNOW Architect)**
**Location**
–
**Hyderabad, India**
At dsm-firmenich we strive to achieve a world where you don’t have to choose between taste, texture, or health - and can enjoy it all. Our innovative ingredients, expertise, and solutions bridge the gap between the delicious, the nutritious, and the sustainable.
  
  
In this role the ServiceNow Business Analyst/Technical Analyst/Technical Analyst is accountable for translating business needs, process requirements, and stakeholder priorities into clear, actionable requirements for the ServiceNow platform. This role ensures that ServiceNow enhancements, implementations, and platform changes are well defined, business aligned, user focused, and delivered in line with governance, SIAM operating models, and enterprise standards. Acting as a bridge between business stakeholders, process owners, platform teams, architects, and delivery partners, the Business Analyst/Technical Analyst/Technical Analyst drives requirement quality, process clarity, adoption readiness, and successful delivery of ServiceNow capabilities.
  
  
At dsm-firmenich, being a force for good is not optional. Diversity, Equity & Inclusion is a shared responsibility woven into our daily work, benefiting our People, Customers & Communities and driving business value. Equal access to opportunities is a given, belonging is a shared feeling, authenticity is celebrated.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Business Analysis & Requirements Management
* Partner with business stakeholders, process owners, product owners, and platform teams to capture and clarify business requirements for ServiceNow initiatives.
* Translate business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, functional requirements, and backlog items.
* Ensure requirements are complete, testable, prioritized, and aligned with platform standards and out-of-the-box ServiceNow capabilities wherever possible.
* Support demand intake, impact assessment, scope definition, and change prioritization across ServiceNow modules.
* Process Design & ServiceNow Solution Alignment
* Analyze current-state processes and support the design of future-state workflows on the ServiceNow platform.
* Work with architects and functional leads to ensure requirements are translated into practical, scalable, and maintainable ServiceNow solutions.
* Support solution design across modules such as ITSM, HRSD, CSM, SPM, CMDB, ITOM, GRC, Legal Service Delivery, and custom applications as applicable.
* Promote process simplification, standardization, automation, and reuse of platform capabilities.
* Backlog, Delivery & Testing Support
* Maintain and refine the product backlog in collaboration with product owners, scrum teams, and delivery partners.
* Support sprint planning, backlog grooming, requirement walkthroughs, build clarifications, and functional reviews.
* Define and support test scenarios, UAT planning, defect triage, and business validation to ensure delivered solutions meet agreed requirements.
* Track requirement traceability from demand through design, build, testing, deployment, and adoption.
* Governance, Controls & Change Readiness
* Ensure requirements and process designs comply with ServiceNow governance, security, data, audit, and compliance standards.
* Support impact assessments for platform changes, releases, integrations, and process changes.
* Prepare business stakeholders for adoption through process documentation, training inputs, communication support, and transition readiness activities.
* Identify risks, dependencies, open decisions, and requirement gaps early and drive timely resolution.
* Reporting, Insights & Continuous Improvement
* Use ServiceNow data, reports, dashboards, and stakeholder feedback to identify improvement opportunities.
* Support continual service improvement initiatives focused on user experience, automation, operational efficiency, and service quality.
* Contribute to roadmap inputs by identifying recurring pain points, process bottlenecks, and value opportunities.
* Promote data-driven decisions and measurable business outcomes from ServiceNow delivery.
* Stakeholder & Vendor Collaboration
* Build strong working relationships with business stakeholders, process owners, platform owners, architects, SIAM teams, and delivery partners.
* Facilitate workshops, requirement sessions, demos, and decision discussions with clear documentation and follow-through.
* Coordinate with system integrators and internal teams to clarify scope, resolve requirement questions, and validate delivery outputs.
* Act as a trusted functional advisor to stakeholders on ServiceNow process and requirement topics.
* Technical Architecture Requirements
* Define and maintain scalable ServiceNow technical architecture aligned with enterprise standards, platform governance, security requirements, and long-term product roadmap.
* Assess technical feasibility, solution options, integration patterns, data models, and platform impacts for new demands, enhancements, and transformation initiatives.
* Guide configuration versus customization decisions, promote reuse of out-of-the-box capabilities, and ensure solutions remain upgrade-safe, maintainable, and cost-effective.
* Provide technical oversight across integrations, workflows, automation, APIs, data quality, CMDB dependencies, access controls, and environment management.
* Review solution designs, technical specifications, release plans, and deployment readiness to manage risks, dependencies, performance, resilience, and compliance obligations.

**We bring**

* A supportive environment where you’re empowered to grow and share your ideas.
* An inclusive and multicultural team with respect for everyone
* A dynamic work environment with many challenges that give you the possibility to work autonomously and with a team in finding the right solutions.

**You bring**

* 6+ years of experience as a Business Analyst/Technical Analyst, Functional Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role in enterprise IT platforms.
* Strong experience working with ServiceNow implementations, enhancements, or platform operations.
* Good understanding of ITSM processes such as Incident, Request, Problem, Change, Knowledge, Service Catalog, and CMDB; exposure to HRSD, CSM, SPM, ITOM, GRC, or Legal Service Delivery is an advantage.
* Proven ability to write clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, business requirements, and functional specifications.
* Experience working in Agile delivery models, sprint ceremonies, backlog management, UAT, and release support.
* Strong stakeholder management, workshop facilitation, documentation, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to balance business value, user experience, process standardization, governance, and delivery practicality.

**About Dsm-firmenich**
At dsm-firmenich, we don’t just meet expectations – we go beyond them.
  
  
Join our global team powered by science, creativity, and a shared purpose: to bring progress to life.
  
  
  
  
From elevating health to making fortified food and sustainable skincare, the impact of your work here will be felt by millions – every single day. Whether it’s fragrance that helps you focus, alternative meat that’s better for the planet, or reducing sugar without losing flavor, this is where you help shape the future of nutrition, health, and beauty for everyone, everywhere.
  
  
And while you’re making a difference, we’ll make sure you’re growing too. With learning that never stops, a culture that lifts you up and the freedom to move across businesses, teams, and borders. Your voice matters here. And your ideas? They’re essential to our future.

title: CTRM - RightAngle | Sr. Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Regulatory, Risk & Forensic**
Our Regulatory, Risk & Forensic team supports client leaders translate multifaceted risk and an evolving regulatory environment into defensible actions that strengthen, protect, and transform organizations. Leverage advanced data, AI, and emerging technologies with deep domain and industry insights to help bring clarity from complexity and accelerate the path to value creation.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
**Level:**
SeniorConsultant or equivalent
  
  
As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**
Our Enterprise & Operations Risk professionals help organizations effectively navigate business risks and opportunities—from strategic, reputation, and financial risks to operational and regulatory risks—to gain competitive advantage. We apply our experience in ongoing business operations and corporate lifecycle events to help clients become stronger and more resilient. Our market-leading teams help clients embrace complexity to accelerate performance, disrupt through innovation, and lead in their industries.
  
  
We help organizations in their efforts to achieve regulatory and legal compliance and transform their departments to add greater value to the business. We combine highly specialized skills focused on process, risk and controls to produce transformative insights. Our team
  
  

* Enable profitable growth and competitive advantage by optimizing “heart of the business” operations.
* Leverage deep domain expertise to extend enterprise resilience, agility, and remediation.
* Drive enterprise- wide impact across strategy, operations, performance, and reputation.

**The team:**
Our Commodity Trading & Risk Management advisory practice solves our clients’ most complex issues and helps drive transformative changes to their supply, trading, and marketing organizations. We support our clients with advice related to physical and financial commodity market challenges through commercial & risk advisory, quantitative analysis, technology and operational advisory services.
  
  
Specifically, our service offerings address the operations, compliance, and risk management challenges prevalent across the commodities value chain. These services are organized into three capability areas - Strategic Services, Compliance, Risk & Operational Services, and Technology Services:
  
  

* Strategic Services help clients define fit-for-purpose operating models for their commodities, define the changes required to realize that vision, and develop a roadmap for execution
* Compliance, Risk & Operational Services assess the existing compliance, risk, and operational processes of our clients leveraging proprietary tools to yield insights for improvement or optimization
* Technology Services deliver custom and package technology solutions that help our clients manage their commodity business and associated risk & compliance exposures.

**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
**Functional Requirements –**

* 6 – 10 years of experience in business processes across Trading and Contract management, Physical Commodity Trading and their related financial derivatives, Scheduling, Mark to Market, Vars, Write on/Write offs, Inventory Management, Invoicing and Accounting.
* Familiarity with Pricing tools such as ZEMA
* Understanding of deal pricing and pricing strategies
* Understand End of day and End of Month processes for the month close. Understanding of the RA month close process and sequence of jobs to be run to facilitate month end.
* Familiarity with Right Angle Risk Management module. Understand hedging strategies and managed or supported Hedge/offset deals in Right Angle.
* Understanding of snapshots – intraday, end of day, weekly and monthly processes.

**Technical Requirements –**

* Good skills on SQL and .Net
* Have worked on or previously supported integration of Right Angle with other applications using.net class dll and WCF services.
* Leverage AzureDev Ops or similar deployment workflow for RA development and deployments
* Have worked on or have supported Right Angle version upgrades.
* Familiar with deployment of RightAngle enhancements and customizations.

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Familiarity with Service now ticket system
* Worked on Agile methodologies
* Worked on RightAngle version 15 or above.

**Education:**


* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university.
* MBA or related PG preferred

**Location:**

* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. We are seeking a Central Monitoring, Data Analysis to join our team. As a Central Monitoring, Data Analysis, you will lead centralized monitoring activities for global and complex clinical trials, ensuring the effective configuration, execution, and maintenance of Risk-Based Quality Management (RBQM) systems. This position plays a critical role in study execution, data accuracy, regulatory compliance, and driving innovation in clinical trial monitoring. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams, follow industry-standard processes, and contribute to study operations from planning through closeout.
  
  
Responsibilities include overseeing RBQM system configuration and execution, interpreting Key Risk Indicator (KRI) and Key Performance Indicator (KPI) data, developing advanced data analyses using programming expertise, and leading process improvement initiatives. You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through advancing patient safety, optimizing trial performance, and delivering actionable insights. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Central Monitoring, Data Analysis can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research and data analytics.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Act as a subject matter expert for the configuration, implementation, and execution of Central Monitoring RBQM systems across studies.
* Maintain Key Risk Indicator and Quality Tolerance Limit libraries within the RBQM platform to ensure standard deployment consistency and alignment with regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate with functional and cross-functional stakeholders to develop configuration specifications for Central Monitoring in RBQM systems.
* Provide operational expertise, training, and guidance as a point of escalation for Central Monitoring issues related to RBQM systems.
* Conduct central monitoring reviews in support of study central monitors, interpreting and presenting KRI and KPI data with actionable insights.
* Leverage programming expertise in languages such as R, SQL, or SAS to develop custom analyses, automate workflows, and integrate data systems.
* Participate in ongoing improvements in standardizing technologies, systems, processes, and training materials that support Central Monitoring and RBQM.
* Represent Central Monitoring in process improvement initiatives and contribute to innovation in central monitoring capabilities through collaboration with cross-functional teams.

**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**

* Technical expertise in database design, system configuration, and report development with experience managing RBQM systems or similar platforms.
* Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, SQL, or SAS, with the ability to develop scripts for data analysis, automation, and system integration.
* Strong analytical problem-solving and critical thinking abilities, with experience troubleshooting data refreshes and resolving execution errors in analytical systems.
* Experience working in clinical research, healthcare, or a regulated environment.
* The ability to collaborate across teams and communicate clearly, with effective interpersonal skills.
* A patient-focused mindset and strong attention to detail.
* Comfort working with RBQM platforms, electronic data capture systems, and clinical databases.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience in a related field.
* At least 4 years of relevant biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry experience.
* Minimum 2 years of direct experience with RBQM systems or similar centralized monitoring platforms.
* Knowledge of ICH-GCP guidelines, regulatory requirements, and clinical trial processes.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data manipulation and reporting.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's Degree in a related field such as Data Science, Biostatistics, or Clinical Research.
* Experience with CluePoints or similar centralized monitoring and risk-based quality management solutions.
* Experience in site monitoring, data management, or clinical operations.
* Demonstrated ability to identify and interpret business trends and apply them to centralized monitoring practices.

If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be a perfect fit, send them the link to apply!
  
  
We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

title: Quality Specialist - Telugu, AGI Data Services - Quality
description:
**Description**
Quality Specialists play a vital role in establishing and maintaining comprehensive quality frameworks across our operations. Their primary responsibility begins with developing robust quality strategies in collaboration with customers and CPMs, encompassing metrics, audit approaches, and specific targets for each workflow. When quality issues arise, these specialists create prescriptive actions, examining data patterns to formulate effective solutions. They maintain a continuous improvement cycle by managing a critical feedback loop between operations and customers, drawing insights from multiple sources including quality auditors, side-by-side observations, and metric analysis. Through regular side-by-side sessions, they identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements. The specialists serve as key escalation points for customer concerns, providing strategic recommendations based on their deep understanding of processes. They consistently evaluate quality tools, suggesting refinements to enhance effectiveness, while simultaneously maintaining and updating process documentation to ensure standardization and clarity across all workflows. This comprehensive approach ensures quality remains at the forefront of our operational excellence.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Define and implement quality metrics for established workflows
* Create prescriptive actions for quality issues
* Partner with customers, operations and internal support teams to optimize workflow quality
* Conduct side-by-sides to identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements
* Analyze data trends and develop solutions
* Monitor quality performance and coach operations teams
* Create and maintain quality metrics reports
* Handle customer escalations and recommendations
* Evaluate and suggest improvements for quality tools
* Support process documentation and implementation

A day in the life
  
  
Your day starts by checking quality dashboards for your assigned workflows — reviewing audit scores, appeal rates, SLA status, and any overnight escalations. You will spend approximately 30% of your time on analysis: reviewing data trends, investigating root causes of quality dips, and creating prescriptive actions for operations teams.
  
  
Another 30% goes to stakeholder communication: leading weekly customer meetings, preparing quality reports, and handling escalations. The remaining time is split between process work (updating SOPs, refining audit rubrics, conducting side-by-sides) and calibration activities (aligning audit standards with Senior Quality Auditors and operations teams).
  
  
You are measured on: SLA metrics (appeals and batch completion), customer satisfaction, quality improvement trends for your workflows, and documentation quality.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Quality Operations team within FAI Data Services ensures that labeled training data meets accuracy and consistency standards before it is used to train Amazon's AI models. Quality Specialists own the quality strategy for assigned workflows, bridging the gap between operations execution and customer expectations.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Advanced-level proficiency or C1+ in Telugu language (Strong verbal and written communication skills, with fluency in speaking, listening, and writing.)
* Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and develop prescriptive actions
* Experience in creating and maintaining process documentation, SOPs, or quality guideline

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Linguistics, Data Science, Business, or related discipline)
* Demonstrated ability to build or improve quality frameworks, audit processes, or feedback loops
* Experience coaching or providing quality feedback to operations or associate-level teams

Focus on operational tasks within the complaint handling process. Ensure to complete all training in a timely manner and guarantee continuous improvement of the knowledge according to the annual training plan. Participate in ad-hoc meetings for product-specific complaint issues and provide timely feedback to ensure all the data necessary for complaint investigation process.

Handle Quality Management system (QMS) records by applying data privacy regulations, manage any discrepancies, and ensure completion within defined timelines. Ensure the documentation of Hub-related GxP activities. Facilitate periodic governance meetings with respective stakeholders. Participate on the creation of presentations, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and training materials.

Support on audits/regulatory inspections. Strive for continuous improvement initiatives/projects related to standardization, simplification, and digitalization to achieve efficiency. Create/Review the inquiry, Translate to English (As applicable).
* Determine if the inquiry is associated with an Adverse Event, Pharmacovigilance (PV) Special Situation, customer service or Field Alert Reporting-related information (as applicable). Ensure respective teams are communicated, if required. Follow up with the complainant for additional information and complaint sample management (as applicable). Appropriate handling, review and closure (as applicable) of information considered as Non-PTC. Capture and document sample information into the proper fields of the system (as applicable). Ensure to complete all the required information
* Health authority called-in complaints, prioritized complaints, and suspected counterfeit complaints are handled with the utmost urgency and in strict compliance with both global and country-specific regulatory requirement. Ensure acknowledgement of Complaint (as applicable). Communicate with the complainant for any other request/ additional information related to complaint, if required. Maintain compliance with all relevant regulatory requirements for complaint management and reporting. Categorize Product Technical Complaint (PTC) based on its potential impact on product quality or patient safety as per defined timelines. Recording of complaint details in global system including defective quantity / verify lot number.
* Categorize and process the Fast track complaint based on defined criteria. Sample management- request for sample collection, update sample/picture information in global system. Ensure to complete all the required fields in tools and assign the complaint to respective investigation owning site. Ensure completion of the investigation. Perform final review/update the complaint record and close as per defined timelines. Ensure acknowledgement of Complaint and/or response letter to Complainant (As applicable). Maintain compliance with all relevant regulatory requirements for complaint management and reporting.

**About You**

* Experience: 6 – 10 years of related experience in the pharmaceutical industry. Knowledge of cGMPs, Code of Federal Regulations in drugs and biologics, and complaint database software and reporting tools. Should be knowledgeable in Quality functions of pharmaceutical industry. Experience working on manufacturing sites is an added advantage.
* Proficient in problem-solving, attention to detail, and good organizational skills. Work in a team-oriented, flexible, and proactive manner. Analytical skills and ability to multitask in a stressful environment.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Masters in Life Sciences/Healthcare/Pharmaceutical science.
* Languages: Excellent knowledge of English language (spoken and written).

* Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
* Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.

title: IT ERP Product Analyst III
description:
Work Model: You’ll work in a hybrid model, onsite at your designated Regal Rexnord location, with flexibility to work remotely.
  
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
**Job Description**
**Position Summary:**
The IT ERP Analyst III is responsible to design and deliver solutions to fulfill requirements of Regal’s Manufacturing business. The individual should possess comprehensive techno-functional competencies in Manufacturing (INV, BOM, WIP, and Costing) modules of Oracle EBS and working knowledge of Advanced Supply Chain Planning (ASCP), Demantra and Inventory Optimization (IO) modules of Oracle VCP. The person is responsible to deliver on-time and first-time-right for complex projects and kaizen events, to resolve production incidents within SLAs, to conduct root cause analysis to prevent recurrence or problems, to monitor and improve system performance and reliability on continuous basis and to coach team members as necessary. Gathers and analyzes requirements, designs, develops and tests enhancements, extensions and integrations (RICEW / CEMLI) for existing Oracle EBS Manufacturing / VCP modules. Maintains technical documentation (BR100s, MD50s/70s, CV40s/70s, etc). Assists in defining, reviewing and maintaining standards. Liaises and coordinates with other stakeholders including team members located in other countries. Participates in formulating and defining scope of Oracle EBS / VCP projects and own delivery of several components.
  
  
**Major Responsibilities**

* Gather and analyze business requirements; design, develop, test and implement technical solutions to fulfill requirements of supply chain, manufacturing, and planning areas; and provide post implementation maintenance and support
* Document system specifications (SSDs - high level) (MD50s), detailed design (DDDs) (MD70s), Unit Test Plan, Deployment Notes (MD120s), etc. using Oracle AIM (Application Implementation Methodology).
* Support System Functional testing, End-To-End Integration testing, Regression testing, and User Acceptance testing within defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Coordinate among onsite and offshore members of Oracle EBS Manufacturing technical developers to design, build, unit test and support solutions that are on-time, first-time-right and within budget.
* Ensure compliance to Release management, Change management and configuration management processes.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, and Extensions (including workflows) to enhance existing Oracle EBS / VCP solutions and integrate it with other applications.
* Respond, analyze and resolve production incidents within SLAs, perform routine maintenance tasks, and monitor / enhance performance of scheduled programs to ensure business continuity.
* Automate and maintain Integration of Oracle EBS / VCP modules with other internal and external systems.
* Participate in following activities:
* Analyze and plan Oracle EBS / VCP upgrades (i.e. Family Packs)
* Create and resolve service requests in collaboration with ‘My Oracle Support’
* Provide production support as per Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
* Continuously improve system performance and reliability by identifying opportunities for root cause analysis and automation
* Facilitate in establishing standards and Best Practices for software design, development and Unit Test and lead team to leverage these standards and best practices to deliver high quality and cost effective solutions.
* Use systematic techniques and process modeling tools for effective system specifications and design - like Use-case scenarios, Activity Diagrams, Data-flow Diagramming etc.

**Required Education / Experience / Skills**

* Educations:
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent related experience
* Experience
* 8+ years of experience building and supporting solutions based on Oracle EBS Manufacturing modules (INV, BOM, WIP, and Costing) in global environment – with at least 2or 3 full lifecycle implementations or 3+ years of monitoring, maintaining, enhancing, integrating and upgrading
* Awareness or Green Belt certification in Lean Six Sigma or APICS (CPIM, CIRM) certification preferred
* Technical Skills:
* Highly skilled in Oracle E-Business Suite's APIs, Open Interfaces structure, EBS / VCP data models, building RICEW (Report, Interface, Conversion, Extension, Workflow) or CEMLI (Configuration, Extension, Modification, Localization, and Integration) objects, Forms, Form Personalization, XML Publisher, OA Framework, SQL, PL/SQL (Stored procedures, packages and triggers), Bulk processing, ETL operations, REF cursors, collections, etc.
* Comprehensive knowledge in collection methods, plan parameters, Demantra and Inventory Optimization architecture
* Ability to analyze and resolve supply-demand exceptions and issues as per SLAs
* Experience with SQL\*Plus, SQL\*Loader, Data Loader, Export/Import, TKPROF, Oracle scheduler, Advanced Queues, Object management
* Proficient in tools like TOAD, PL/SQL Developer, Data Modeling tools, Version Control tools.
* UNIX shell scripting experience (desired)
* Conversant with Oracle AIM (Application Implementation Methodology)
* Professional Certification(s) like Supply Chain industry or Oracle E-Business Suite R12 (strongly desired)
* Working experience in Oracle EBS R12 Supply Chain (Discrete Manufacturing) modules (strong desired)

**About Regal Rexnord**
Regal Rexnord is a publicly held global industrial manufacturer with 30,000 associates around the world who help create a better tomorrow by providing sustainable solutions that power, transmit and control motion. The Company’s electric motors and air moving subsystems provide the power to create motion. A portfolio of highly engineered power transmission components and subsystems efficiently transmits motion to power industrial applications. title: Senior Administrator, Corporate Systems
description:
The Oracle Revenue Management and Billing (ORMB) Corporate Systems Senior Developer will be responsible for the end-to-end administration, deployment, and development of the ORMB application built on the Oracle Utilities Application Framework (OUAF). This role combines hands-on system administration — including fresh installations, environment provisioning, patch management, and release deployments — with Java-based development of enhancements, integrations, and batch processing solutions.
  
  
Working under the direction of the Technical Manager, this role requires frequent collaboration with functional business analysts, infrastructure/DBA teams, third-party vendors, and end users to ensure high availability, compliance, and continuous delivery of a quality finance/corporate systems application. The ideal candidate brings both deep administrative experience with ORMB/OUAF environments and strong Java development skills in large-volume financial systems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* System Administration & Environment Management

+ Plan, execute, and document fresh installations of ORMB/OUAF across Development, QA, UAT, and Production environments on Linux/Unix servers

- Configure WebLogic application server, Oracle database connections, batch frameworks, and OUAF environment properties (ENVIRON.INI, SPLEBASE).
- Manage multi-environment topology including environment cloning, refresh, and rollback procedures.

+ Apply Oracle-released CPU patches, SPU patches, and product fix packs to ORMB/OUAF environments following change management procedures.

- Coordinate patch testing in lower environments before promoting to Production; maintain patch inventory and compliance registers.
- Use Oracle OPatch / OUAF patch utilities (e.g., FW patch scripts) and validate post-patch environment integrity.

+ Execute and oversee application deployments and release promotions across all environments using OUAF deployment utilities.

- Manage Configuration Migration (CM) packages, migration plans, and controlled rollouts via the OUAF Migration Assistant.
- Coordinate with DBAs for schema scripts, data migrations, and post-deployment validation.

+ Monitor application health, JVM performance, batch throughput, and WebLogic thread pools; tune configurations to meet SLA targets.
+ Maintain and update installation guides, runbooks, patch procedures, and environment-specific configuration documentation.

* Development & Enhancements

+ Design and develop custom ORMB components — algorithms, service scripts, BPA scripts, business objects, business services, and portal zones — using Java and the OUAF framework.
+ Build and maintain third-party integrations (e.g., tax engines, payment gateways, e-invoicing, ticketing systems) using REST/SOAP APIs and batch file-based patterns.
+ Develop and optimize batch programs for high-volume billing and financial transaction processing, including performance profiling and JVM-level tuning.
+ Collaborate with functional analysts and business stakeholders to gather requirements, propose solutions, and deliver enhancements aligned with business capabilities.

* Production Support & Operations

+ Provide Tier 2/3 production support for ORMB including incident triage, root cause analysis, and resolution of batch failures, data anomalies, and integration errors.
+ Run and schedule production batch jobs; maintain and modify interfaces, reports (BI Publisher), and scheduled tasks.
+ Perform year-end processing support, system upgrades, and general technical modifications with minimal business disruption.
+ Liaise with Oracle Support (SR management), infrastructure, and DBA teams to resolve platform-level issues.

* Collaboration & Governance

+ Work with external vendors and internal teams to evaluate system changes; participate in design reviews, propose solutions, and document outcomes.
+ Ensure all deployments and patches comply with change management, security, and audit policies.
+ Support the ORMB V8 upgrade and other strategic migration initiatives, contributing to parallel-run testing and validation activities.

**Knowledge And Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or Information Systems required.
* 4+ years of experience with Oracle ORMB or CC&B, including hands-on administration of OUAF-based environments (installations, patching, deployments).
* 4+ years of strong Java development skills with demonstrated ability to build and extend OUAF/ORMB framework components.
* Experience installing and patching ORMB/OUAF on Linux/Unix servers; familiarity with WebLogic administration and JVM tuning.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Database / SQL; ability to write and optimize queries against ORMB billing schema.
* Experience managing OUAF Configuration Migration (CM) packages and multi-environment promotion workflows.
* Ability to work independently and thrive in a high-profile environment while maintaining high attention to detail and quality.
* Strong communication skills to collaborate effectively with technical peers, business stakeholders, and third-party vendors.

**Preferred Knowledge And Experience**

* Familiarity with Oracle patch delivery mechanisms (My Oracle Support, OPatch) and WebLogic patching procedures.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines or scripted deployment automation for Java/OUAF applications.
* BI Publisher and/or Tableau experience is a plus.
* Financial industry experience with finance and/or accounting knowledge is beneficial.
* Experience with ORMB V8 (v8.x) and knowledge of differences from legacy CC&B / ORMB v2.x.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow or Jira integrations in enterprise environments.
* Ability to liaise with and build effective relationships with global teams across time zones.

description:

We are seeking a skilled
**Test Engineer**
to join our Quality Engineering team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for validating end-to-end data pipelines, ensuring data accuracy, integrity, and reliability across enterprise data platforms. You will collaborate with data engineers, developers, and business stakeholders to test data ingestion, transformation, and reporting processes while maintaining high-quality data standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Validate end-to-end data pipelines from source systems to target databases and data warehouses.
* Design, develop, and execute test cases for ETL/ELT workflows and data transformation processes.
* Perform data validation using complex SQL queries to verify data completeness, accuracy, and consistency.
* Test REST APIs used for data ingestion and integration using tools such as Postman.
* Validate data quality, business rules, schema changes, and transformation logic.
* Perform functional, integration, regression, and production validation testing.
* Identify, document, and track defects using JIRA or Azure DevOps.
* Collaborate with Data Engineering and Development teams to troubleshoot data issues and verify fixes.
* Automate repetitive data validation tasks using SQL, Python, or automation frameworks where applicable.
* Support production releases and perform post-deployment data validation.
* Create and maintain test plans, test cases, execution reports, and test documentation.

**Required Skills**

full-time, hybrid work arrangement

AVEVA Process Simulation (APS) is an integrated platform for engineers and operators to innovate across the entire process life cycle—design, simulation, training, and operations. As an APS – Domain QA Engineer, you will use your Chemical Engineering and process simulation expertise to ensure APS capabilities meet expected process behavior, are reliable for customers, and maintain high quality across releases. * Validate simulation results against expected physical behavior, engineering heuristics, and benchmark/reference cases where applicable
* Collaborate with developers and stakeholders (product, domain experts, and support) to deliver quality software within planned timelines
* Interact with customers / primary support to address queries and concerns related to APS

Hyderabad, India

(Chemical Engineering required)

* Coursework in Modelling and Simulation is preferred

* Experience in process design is preferred; Refining / Oil & Gas background is a strong plus

* Strong fundamentals in Chemical Engineering principles
* Good understanding of process equipment and unit operations (design intent and operating behavior)
* Working knowledge of simulation tools such as HYSYS, Aspen Plus, PRO/II (APS exposure is a plus)

* Experience in testing simulation software or validating simulation models/features is an added advantage

* Experience building and maintaining automated test workflows (test data setup, execution, reporting, and regression runs)
* Familiarity with version control (Git) and collaborative development practices (code reviews, branching)
* Basic understanding of CI/CD concepts and how automated test suites are integrated into build/release pipelines (Azure DevOps or similar)

Effective communication skills for cross-functional collaboration and customer/support interactions

title: Quality Specialist - Marathi, AGI Data Services - Quality
description:
**Description**
Quality Specialists play a vital role in establishing and maintaining comprehensive quality frameworks across our operations. Their primary responsibility begins with developing robust quality strategies in collaboration with customers and CPMs, encompassing metrics, audit approaches, and specific targets for each workflow. When quality issues arise, these specialists create prescriptive actions, examining data patterns to formulate effective solutions. They maintain a continuous improvement cycle by managing a critical feedback loop between operations and customers, drawing insights from multiple sources including quality auditors, side-by-side observations, and metric analysis. Through regular side-by-side sessions, they identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements. The specialists serve as key escalation points for customer concerns, providing strategic recommendations based on their deep understanding of processes. They consistently evaluate quality tools, suggesting refinements to enhance effectiveness, while simultaneously maintaining and updating process documentation to ensure standardization and clarity across all workflows. This comprehensive approach ensures quality remains at the forefront of our operational excellence.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Define and implement quality metrics for established workflows
* Create prescriptive actions for quality issues
* Partner with customers, operations and internal support teams to optimize workflow quality
* Conduct side-by-sides to identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements
* Analyze data trends and develop solutions
* Monitor quality performance and coach operations teams
* Create and maintain quality metrics reports
* Handle customer escalations and recommendations
* Evaluate and suggest improvements for quality tools
* Support process documentation and implementation

A day in the life
  
  
Your day starts by checking quality dashboards for your assigned workflows — reviewing audit scores, appeal rates, SLA status, and any overnight escalations. You will spend approximately 30% of your time on analysis: reviewing data trends, investigating root causes of quality dips, and creating prescriptive actions for operations teams.
  
  
Another 30% goes to stakeholder communication: leading weekly customer meetings, preparing quality reports, and handling escalations. The remaining time is split between process work (updating SOPs, refining audit rubrics, conducting side-by-sides) and calibration activities (aligning audit standards with Senior Quality Auditors and operations teams).
  
  
You are measured on: SLA metrics (appeals and batch completion), customer satisfaction, quality improvement trends for your workflows, and documentation quality.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Quality Operations team within FAI Data Services ensures that labeled training data meets accuracy and consistency standards before it is used to train Amazon's AI models. Quality Specialists own the quality strategy for assigned workflows, bridging the gap between operations execution and customer expectations.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Advanced-level proficiency or C1+ in Marathi language (Strong verbal and written communication skills, with fluency in speaking, listening, and writing.)
* Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and develop prescriptive actions
* Experience in creating and maintaining process documentation, SOPs, or quality guidelines

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Linguistics, Data Science, Business, or related discipline).
* Demonstrated ability to build or improve quality frameworks, audit processes, or feedback loops.
* Experience coaching or providing quality feedback to operations or associate-level teams.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:
If you’re passionate about being part of a dynamic organization that enables a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales to drive innovation and adopt new technologies that deliver business results, then Nationwide’s Technology team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design, development, and maintenance of automated test solutions across functional, regression, integration, and release testing efforts.
* Define and manage test plans, test strategies, quality metrics, and results reporting for moderate to complex initiatives.
* Review requirements, user stories, and technical work products to identify automation opportunities and ensure appropriate test coverage.
* Apply secure software and systems engineering practices throughout the delivery lifecycle to help protect data and technology solutions from threats and vulnerabilities.
* Establish and support test data, test environment, and release testing strategies in partnership with engineering, architecture, and infrastructure teams.
* Drive defect identification, tracking, triage, and resolution for moderate to complex issues, using critical thinking to remove blockers and improve product quality.
* Align automation solutions with enterprise automated testing reference architecture and release management governance.
* Promote a quality-first mindset by proactively managing leading indicators of quality while balancing speed, efficiency, and user experience.
* Serve as a technical lead and source of direction for associates across the team, helping raise automation maturity and engineering discipline.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives for tooling, frameworks, CI/CD enablement, and quality engineering best practices.

**Job Description Summary**
If you’re enthusiastic about delivering secure technology solutions to support a company providing extraordinary care to its customers, then Nationwide Technology is the place for you. Nationwide's industry-leading technology workforce embraces an agile work environment and a collaborative culture to deliver outstanding solutions and results. If that sounds like something you aspire to, we want to hear from you!
  
  
As a Quality Engineer you will plan and conduct a wide range of software quality tests and analyses to ensure all application products and services meet organizational standards aligned to their quality management approach, as well as, end-user requirements. Quality Engineers perform our quality planning, quality design and execution.
  
  
You will focus on a blend of skills enabling efficient execution of risk-based testing, test automation, performance testing, test data management, test environment management, continuous integration and continuous deployment all improving speed to delivery for our business partners.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Oversees procedures to ensure all information systems products and services meet organization standards and end-user requirements.
* Serves as an expert in the analysis and reviews requirements, user stories and technical work products to create the automation needed.
* Responsible for applying secure software and systems engineering practices throughout the delivery lifecycle to ensure our data and technology solutions are protected from threats and vulnerabilities.
* Defines and manages multiple test plans, strategies, results reporting and metrics.
* Uses the appropriate quality engineering tools to define test data management, test automation, security/vulnerability, performance, and regression testing needs.
* Manages moderate to complex defects including identifying, tracking, and providing critical thinking for resolution.
* Considers and drives the end users’ experience during the software development life cycle.
* Is proactive in managing leading indicators of quality in test plans and approaches while ensuring speed and efficiency.
* Partners with Infrastructure & Operations and Architecture on test data and environment management plans.
* Sets the release test strategy (including all release life cycle testing phases).
* Oversees the coordination of all release testing efforts (including all phases of testing during the release life cycle).
* Aligns with the Nationwide automated testing reference architecture.
* Complies with release management process governance and timelines throughout the release.
* Acts as a source of direction for associates.
* Additional responsibilities may include collaboration across teams and adherence to company standards.

**Qualifications & Experience**
May perform other responsibilities as assigned.
  
  
**Education**
Undergraduate studies in computer science, management information systems, or a related field is preferred.
  
  
**License/Certification/Designation:**
Technology certifications including TOSCA Automated Specialist 1 (AS1), TOSCA Automated Specialist 2 (AS2), or other related designations are preferred.
  
  
**Experience**
Six to eight years of experience with using test optimization and automation processed and tools. Demonstrated experience in testing for agile teams including planning, test plan creation, maintenance and execution. Good understanding of test automation and optimization throughout a stack and the tools to support.
  
  
**Technical Skills**

* Agile Methodology
* Defect Tracking Software
* Performance Testing
* Software Testing
* Test Automation
* Test Engineering
* Test Environment Management (TEM)
* Test Planning

**Soft Skills & Attributes**

* Strong communication and collaboration skills
* Analytical and problem-solving mindset
* Ability to work in agile and global environments
* Time management and prioritization
* Ability to work on multiple projects, problem solve and set priorities needed. Insurance/financial services industry knowledge a plus.

**Additional Information**
**Reporting Structure:**
Reports to Technology Leader – India
  
  
**Working Hours**
Aligned to India business hours with flexibility for global collaboration.
  
  
**Location Flexibility:**
[Hybrid/Remote/In-office] with periodic in-office collaboration.

Nationwide is committed to diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, gender, disability, religion, or other protected categories.

title: Product Quality Engineer
description:
**Product & Supplier Quality Management**

* Ensure suppliers consistently deliver quality parts, materials, and services that meet organizational, customer, and regulatory requirements.
* Monitor supplier quality performance using established metrics and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Lead and support Supplier Corrective and Preventive Action (SCAR/CAPA) activities, including root cause analysis, corrective actions, effectiveness verification, and closure.
* Assess supplier process, material, equipment, and manufacturing changes for quality, compliance, and regulatory impact.

* Lead PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) activities for new product introductions and legacy product changes.
* Apply risk-based process validation methodologies to ensure robust product and manufacturing processes.
* Support qualification and validation activities, including protocol development, execution, reporting, and impact assessments.
* Define incoming inspection requirements and acceptance criteria for purchased components and materials.
* Develop, execute, and support validation of internal inspection and test methods as required.
* Ensure inspection, testing, and validation activities comply with applicable quality standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.

* Act as the Quality representative within NPI and Sustaining Engineering projects.
* Support ongoing project activities by coordinating Quality Plan and Quality Norm planning activities throughout the project lifecycle.
* Review and approve design and development deliverables to ensure compliance with quality and regulatory requirements.
* Provide guidance and consultation to project teams regarding process, quality, validation, risk management, and compliance-related questions.
* Participate in design reviews, risk reviews, verification and validation activities, and design transfer activities.
* Support design changes, product improvements, and sustaining engineering initiatives while ensuring product quality and compliance are maintained.

* Analyze quality trends, supplier performance metrics, non-conformance data, and process performance indicators to identify improvement opportunities.
* Drive defect prevention activities through proactive risk assessment and implementation of corrective actions.
* Support Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement initiatives across products, processes, and suppliers.
* Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, sourcing, and supplier teams to improve product quality, reliability, and operational performance.

The Product Quality Engineer collaborates extensively with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure successful product development, industrialization, commercialization, and post-market support activities. Key stakeholders include:

* R&D Engineers
* Post-Market Surveillance Investigators
* Risk Management Engineers
* Product Support Engineers
* Regulatory Affairs Specialists
* Quality Manufacturing Engineers
* Product Industrialization Engineers
* Supplier Quality Engineers
* Reliability Engineers

* Strong understanding of Quality Management Systems (QMS) and quality engineering principles.
* Knowledge of Risk Management methodologies and risk-based decision-making.

* Experience managing CAPA, non-conformances, and root cause investigations.
* Working knowledge of Production Part Approval Process (PPAP).

* Proficiency in quality tools and methodologies including:
  + PFMEA
  + MSA

  + Risk Assessments
* Knowledge of Continuous Improvement, Lean Manufacturing, and quality improvement techniques.
* Strong communication, collaboration, stakeholder management, and project coordination skills.

* 5–8 years of experience in Product Quality, Supplier Quality, Quality Engineering, or Quality Systems.
* Experience in Consumer Healthcare, Medical Devices, Healthcare Products, or other regulated manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrated experience supporting New Product Introduction (NPI), product qualification, validation, supplier quality, and sustaining engineering activities.

**System Performance Engineer**

title: QA Tester – Sitecore AI Web Testing & Automation
description:
**Job Family**
Software Application & Development (India)
  
  
**Travel Required**
None
  
  
**Clearance Required**
None
  
  
**What You Will Do**
We are seeking a QA Tester to ensure the quality, functionality, accessibility, and performance of websites built on Sitecore AI and related digital experience technologies. In this role, you will plan and execute manual and automated testing across web pages, components, forms, content workflows, APIs, integrations, and releases. You will work closely with developers, content authors, product owners, designers, and delivery partners to identify defects early, expand automated test coverage, and deliver reliable, secure, and user-friendly digital experiences across browsers, devices, and environments.
  
  

* Develop and execute test plans, test cases, test scripts, and test data for Sitecore AI websites, features, components, forms, content updates, integrations, and releases.
* Perform functional, regression, smoke, exploratory, integration, end-to-end, cross-browser, responsive, accessibility, performance, and visual testing across supported environments.
* Build, maintain, and improve automated tests for critical website journeys, reusable components, APIs, and regression scenarios using modern web test automation frameworks.
* Validate Sitecore AI authoring experiences, page and component configuration, content publishing, personalization, search, forms, analytics tagging, consent behavior, and third-party integrations.
* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines and review results to support release readiness and rapid defect detection.
* Document defects with clear reproduction steps, expected and actual results, screenshots or logs, severity, and business impact; verify fixes through retesting and regression testing.
* Partner with developers, designers, content teams, and product owners to clarify acceptance criteria, identify test risks, and improve testability early in the delivery lifecycle.
* Create and maintain reusable automation utilities, page objects, test fixtures, test data, and reporting that improve test reliability and reduce manual effort.
* Track test execution, automation coverage, defect trends, escaped defects, and release quality metrics, and communicate findings and risks clearly to stakeholders.
* Contribute to quality standards, test documentation, peer reviews, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of website testing practices.

**What You Will Need**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* At least 4 years of experience in software quality assurance, with hands-on responsibility for testing websites or web applications in enterprise environments.
* Strong knowledge of QA methods, the software development lifecycle, test design techniques, defect management, risk-based testing, and release validation.
* Hands-on experience creating and maintaining web test automation frameworks using tools such as Selenium, or equivalent technologies.
* Proficiency with JavaScript or TypeScript and working knowledge of another scripting or programming language such as Python, Java, or C#.
* Experience testing modern websites and web applications, including responsive layouts, reusable components, navigation, search, forms, content publishing, APIs, and third-party integrations.
* Experience with API testing tools and techniques, including request validation, response validation, authentication, error handling, and integration scenarios.
* Experience with Git-based workflows, pull requests, CI/CD pipelines, automated test execution, test reporting, and quality gates.
* Ability to use browser developer tools, logs, network traces, and test evidence to isolate and communicate website defects effectively.
* Experience validating cross-browser and cross-device behavior, accessibility, performance, security-related requirements, analytics tagging, and production readiness.
* Ability to write clear test cases, automation code, defect reports, test summaries, and release-quality recommendations.
* Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a hybrid, cross-functional delivery environment.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, review test assets, troubleshoot failures, and share testing and automation knowledge with team members.

**What Would Be Nice To Have**

* Hands-on testing experience with Sitecore AI, Sitecore XM Cloud, Experience Edge, or another composable digital experience platform.
* Experience testing React and Next.js websites deployed through Vercel, Microsoft Azure, or another cloud platform.
* Experience with Selenium, REST clients, accessibility testing tools, visual regression tools, and performance testing tools such as JMeter or k6.
* Experience designing maintainable automation frameworks using page objects, fixtures, data-driven testing, mocking, parallel execution, retry strategies, and actionable reporting.
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jira, test management platforms, and browser or device testing services.
* Relevant certification in Sitecore, software testing, test automation, accessibility, cloud technologies, or web quality engineering.
* Experience testing high-traffic, multilingual, personalized, or regulated enterprise websites and coordinating quality activities with distributed delivery teams.

Candidates should demonstrate strong ownership, analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to translate business requirements into comprehensive test scenarios and data quality checks.

* Functional Testing: Understand business requirements and functional workflows to design relevant test scenarios and validate expected business outcomes.
* Test Documentation: Prepare and maintain test plans, test cases, requirements traceability matrices (RTMs), test execution reports, defect reports, and test summary reports. Leverage AI for documentation as much as possible.
* Defect Management: Identify, document, track, and retest defects. Participate in defect triage and root-cause analysis with development and data engineering teams.
* Quality Checklists: Execute QA entry and exit checklists, support stage-gate reviews, and ensure testing deliverables meet defined acceptance criteria.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 3–8 years of relevant experience in QA, data testing, data validation, or quality engineering, depending on the position.
* Strong SQL skills and experience validating data across source and target systems.
* Hands-on experience with ETL/ELT testing, data integration, data reconciliation, and data quality assurance.
* Understanding of data modelling, Medallion Architecture, semantic models, and visualization testing.
* Experience in functional, API testing and end-to-end system integration testing.
* Hands-on experience with Python-based automation, Playwright, API automation, or comparable testing frameworks.
* Understanding of metadata, data lineage, transformation logic, and cross-system data flows.
* Experience using Claude or equivalent AI tools for automation development and code assistance.
* Working experience with Snowflake/ Databricks and at least one cloud platform: AWS or Microsoft Azure.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.
* Familiarity with Jira and Agile/Scrum methodologies.

Experience-Based Expectations
  
  
**QA Engineer – Mid-Level (3–5 Years)**

* Execute data validation, SQL testing, functional, API testing, and integration testing activities.
* Develop and maintain automation scripts and reusable test utilities.
* Prepare test cases, traceability documentation, execution reports, and defect records.

**Senior QA Engineer (6–8 Years)**

* Independently manage test execution, defect triage, quality reporting, and testing risks.
* Review test cases and automation scripts and mentor junior QA engineers where required.
* Coordinate with customer and cross-functional teams to resolve complex quality issues.
* Support QA stage gates, release readiness assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Preferred Domain Experience**

* Retail and Supply Chain domain experience is preferred.
* Life Sciences domain experience is an added advantage.

Ideal Candidate Profile
  
  
A detail-oriented hands-on QA professional who understands business problem, gains depth in domain/ functionality, has strong SQL and data validation skills, practical automation experience, understanding of modern cloud data platforms and hands-on with AI tools. The candidate should be comfortable working across data engineering and business teams to ensure accurate, consistent, and reliable data throughout the enterprise data lifecycle.

title: Medical Coding Quality Analyst
description:
Medical Coding Quality Analyst

**Role**

-

Medical Coding Quality Analyst (QA) / Medical Coding Auditor

**Experience**
- 3 to 5 years, with hands-on coding and auditing experience

**Location**
- Hyderabad, Telangana, India (On-site)

**Shift**
-General shift, 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM IST, Tuesday to Sunday

**Joining**
-Immediate joiners preferred

**Employment type**
- Full-time

**Reporting to**
-Quality Manager / Project Lead

About Novetum

Novetum builds AI-based products and services that help enterprises adopt intelligent automation, generative AI and data-driven decision-making. Our healthcare team delivers accurate, reliable and compliant solutions for global clients.

Role Summary

The Quality Analyst conducts pre-bill and post-bill audits on coded charts. The role ensures strict adherence to coding guidelines, minimizes error rates and drives project accuracy metrics.

Key Responsibilities

•      
**Audit and validation:**
Randomly or systematically audit charts coded by project users to verify the accuracy of ICD-10, CPT and modifier assignments.

•      
**Error tracking and root cause analysis:**
Identify coding discrepancies, document error patterns, and analyze root causes of miscoding or compliance gaps.

•      
**Feedback and mentorship:**
Give clear, constructive feedback and one-on-one coaching to coders to resolve recurring errors and bridge knowledge gaps.

•      
**Client compliance:**
Ensure all coding conforms to HIPAA regulations, project scope and client-specific contractual guidelines.

•      
**Reporting:**
Prepare daily, weekly and monthly quality metrics, defect logs and audit summary reports for management review.

•      
**Process enhancement:**
Assist project leadership in updating coding cheat sheets, workflow manuals and quality matrices based on audit trends.

Requirements and Skills

•      Minimum 3+ years of medical coding experience, with at least 1–2 years in a dedicated QA or auditing role.

•      Active professional certification (CPMA, CPC or CCS) from AAPC or AHIMA.

•      In-depth knowledge of multi-specialty coding, billing rules and compliance standards.

•      Exceptional attention to detail, analytical mindset, and data-handling proficiency (Excel, reporting tools).

•      Strong interpersonal skills to deliver constructive feedback without friction.

Preferred Qualifications

•      Graduate in Life Sciences (B.Sc, M.Sc, Nursing, Pharm.D) or equivalent.

•      Experience with audit frameworks and accuracy benchmarks (typically 95%–98% or higher).

•      Exposure to specialty coding such as risk adjustment or HCC audits is an advantage.

•      Experience with EHR systems, coding and audit tools, and dashboards or MIS reporting.

•      Prior experience training or mentoring coders.

Other Requirements

•      Strong written and verbal communication skills.

•      Ability to work independently and meet reporting deadlines.

•      Flexibility to adjust shift timings occasionally as required by the project.

•      Commitment to confidentiality of patient data and compliance.

title: Senior Quality Engineer
description:
**About NCR VOYIX**
NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end-to-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide.
  
  
**Job Summary**
As a Senior Quality Engineer at NCR VOYIX Corporation, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the delivery of high-quality software and hardware solutions. You will lead quality assurance activities throughout the product development lifecycle, from requirements gathering to deployment and maintenance, contributing to the overall excellence of our innovative products.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test plans and test cases for complex software and hardware systems.
* Lead and mentor junior quality engineers, providing guidance on best practices, tools, and methodologies.
* Collaborate closely with development, product management, and other cross-functional teams to define quality criteria and ensure adherence to quality standards.
* Identify, analyze, and report defects, working with development teams to resolve issues efficiently.
* Implement and maintain automated testing frameworks and scripts to improve testing efficiency and coverage.
* Participate in requirement reviews, design discussions, and code reviews to proactively identify potential quality risks.
* Monitor and analyze product performance in production environments, identifying trends and recommending improvements.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives within the QA process, introducing new tools, techniques, and methodologies.
* Ensure compliance with industry standards, regulations, and company quality policies.
* Develop and maintain documentation related to testing processes, test results, and quality metrics.

**Job Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Minimum of 8 years of experience in software quality assurance, with at least 2 years in a senior or lead role.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and various testing methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall).
* Proficiency in designing and executing various types of testing, including functional, performance, regression, and integration testing.
* Experience with test automation tools and frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, JUnit, Pytest, TestNG).
* Experience in Retail Domain
* Familiarity with defect tracking systems (e.g., JIRA, Azure DevOps) and test management tools.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with diverse teams.
