title: Automation Test Engineer
description:
UWorld is a worldwide leader in online test prep for college entrance, undergraduate, graduate, and professional licensing exams throughout the United States. Since 2003, over 2 million students have trusted us to help them prepare for high-stakes examinations.

We are seeking an Automation Test Engineer who is passionate about creating an excellent user experience and enjoys taking on new challenges. The Automation Test Engineer will be responsible for designing and developing test plans, unit testing, and other related bug identification tasks to support our test prep applications.

**Your Role:**

* Design, implement, and execute high-value, easily maintainable API, CLI, and GUI test automation (automation framework and test cases) that effectively verifies product quality, using Playwright as the primary automation technology
* Serve as SME for the Playwright-based Automation Framework and be accountable for its ongoing evolution, scalability, and best practices
* Build and maintain reusable Playwright test suites, page object models, and CI/CD integrations for continuous testing
* Collaborate regularly with members of Quality Engineering, Development, and Product Management to fully understand customer needs in order to design and implement optimal test automation solutions
* Estimate, plan, and coordinate automation development and product testing activities in an Agile environment
* Identify, thoroughly document, and track bugs/issues
* Develop and configure test automation scripts and execute performance tests
* Coordinate with product management and engineers to deliver on the stability of products

**Requirements:**

* Master's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
* 4- 7 years of hands-on experience in testing web applications, databases, and API testing
* Strong hands-on experience with Playwright for end-to-end test automation (required); familiarity with Selenium is a plus
* Good understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and software testing in an Agile/Scrum framework
* Experience designing and maintaining scalable Playwright automation frameworks (Page Object Model, fixtures, parallel/cross-browser execution)
* Knowledge of working with REST services and understanding of SOA architecture will be an added advantage
* Working knowledge of performance testing tools

**Soft Skills:**

* Working proficiency and communication skills in verbal and written English
* Excellent interpersonal skills with demonstrated ability to articulate ideas clearly, concisely, and persuasively
* Excellent attention to detail and organization skills
* Ability to understand direction and feedback
* Exceptional follow-through, personal drive, and desire to make a difference
* Habit of writing clean, reusable, and parameterized scripts for tests, ensuring coverage

title: Quality Engineering Lead – Data Validation & Automation Expert (AI Enabled)
description:
**Designation: QA Lead - Data Validation Expert**
**Experience:**
8–12 Years
  
  
**Job Function:**
Digital Assurance / Quality Engineering
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Job Summary**
Blumetra Solutions is looking for an experienced QA Lead – Data Validation to lead quality engineering initiatives across enterprise data integration, ETL/ELT pipelines, cloud data platforms, and analytics solutions.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in SQL, data validation, API testing, end-to-end system integration testing, and test automation. The role requires ownership of QA strategy, quality governance, customer coordination, and delivery stage gates. Experience leveraging AI-powered development tools such as Claude to build, deploy and maintain test automation utilities and QA accelerators is highly desirable.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* QA Strategy & Leadership: Define and drive end-to-end QA strategies, test plans, test coverage, capacity planning/ estimations, and quality engineering standards for complex data projects.
* Data Validation: Lead validation with hands-on across data integrations, ETL/ELT pipelines, data models, Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers), semantic models, dashboards, and visualizations.
* SQL & Data Reconciliation: Review and develop complex SQL queries to validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, integrity, transformation logic, and source-to-target reconciliation.
* API & System Integration Testing: Drive API testing, end-to-end testing, and system integration testing across interconnected applications, services, and data platforms.
* Test Automation: Design and govern scalable automation frameworks using Python, Playwright, API automation tools, and other suitable technologies.
* AI-Assisted QA Engineering: Use Claude and other AI-powered tools to build and enhance validation utilities, automation accelerators, and reusable QA components. Leverage AI where appropriate for test preparation, RCA, summary reports and other documetation. Own automation utility/ scripts maintenance, version control, and deployment.
* Data Lineage & Metadata: Ensure appropriate validation of metadata, data lineage, transformation logic, and data movement across systems and architectural layers.
* Cloud & Data Platforms: Lead testing initiatives involving AWS or Microsoft Azure and Snowflake-based data solutions.
* Quality Governance & Stage Gates: Define and enforce QA entry and exit criteria, stage-gate checklists, release readiness assessments, defect closure requirements, and quality sign-offs.
* Defect Management: Drive defect triage, root-cause analysis, prioritization, resolution tracking, and risk communication.
* QA Documentation & Reporting: Review and maintain test strategies, test cases, requirements traceability matrices (RTMs), execution reports, defect reports, and test summary reports.
* Customer & Stakeholder Management: Work closely with customer teams, business stakeholders, developers, data engineers, and project managers to manage expectations, resolve issues, and ensure successful delivery.
* Team Leadership: Mentor QA engineers, review test deliverables, improve team productivity, and promote reusable frameworks and best practices.
* Agile Delivery: Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and release planning using Jira and related tools. Ensure Story/ task detailing with right level of acceptance criteria, calling out dependencies and risks upfront.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 8–12 years of experience in QA, data testing, data validation, or quality engineering, including relevant leadership experience.
* Strong hands-on expertise in SQL and database testing.
* Proven experience in data integration testing, ETL/ELT validation, source-to-target reconciliation, reports testing.
* Strong understanding of data modelling, Medallion Architecture, semantic models, and visualization testing.
* Expertise in API testing, end-to-end testing, and system integration testing.
* Experience designing or governing automation frameworks using Python, Playwright, and API automation tools.
* Practical experience using Claude or equivalent AI-powered tools for code generation, automation development, and maintenance.
* Hands-on experience with Snowflake and at least one cloud platform: AWS or Microsoft Azure.
* Strong understanding of metadata, data lineage, and cross-system data flows.
* Experience owning QA governance, stage-gate reviews, test sign-offs, and release readiness.
* Strong customer-facing communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and team leadership skills.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and using Jira.

**Preferred Domain Experience**

* Retail and Supply Chain domain experience is preferred.
* Life Sciences domain experience is an added advantage.

Ideal Candidate Profile
  
  
A hands-on QA leader who understands business problem, has depth in domain/ functionality, combines technical depth in data validation and automation with the ability to own quality governance, lead team, engage customer, and ensure reliable data delivery across complex enterprise data ecosystems.

title: Senior Associate QA, International Distribution Quality
description:
**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**
At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
  
  
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
  
  
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
  
  
**Senior Associate QA, International Distribution Quality**
**What You Will Do**
We are seeking a highly motivated individual for our International Distribution Quality (IDQ) team. This is an incredibly exciting opportunity to join a team of quality professionals in global distribution team.
  
  
**HOW MIGHT YOU DEFY IMAGINATION?**
You’ve earned your degree. How will you use that achievement to reach your goals? Do more with the knowledge you’ve worked hard to acquire and the passion you already have. At Amgen, our shared mission—to serve patients—drives all that we do. It is key to our becoming one of the world’s leading biotechnology companies, reaching over 10 million patients worldwide. Become the professional you are meant to be in this relevant role.
  
  
**Role Description**
The Sr. Associate QA position will implement and oversee global product distribution and transportation from Amgen’s Global Supply Hubs to Amgen’s global markets and provide QA oversight of QA activities for Global Supply Chain operations. This role may require working in shifts or extended hours within the same shift.
  
  
Working independently, the individual will be responsible for, but not limited to the following:
  
  

* Perform QA Contact role on the Quality Events, Change Control records, Corrective and Preventive Actions, effectiveness verification and documentation, as well as QA triage of Distribution complaints.
* Work closely with all relevant collaborators for the end-to-end process and ensure compliance to GMP/GDP.
* Expertise in quality assessment associated with transport temperature excursion management.
* Expertise in assessing quality impacts of distribution deviations.
* Hands-on experience in internal audits or self-inspections.
* Demonstrated experience in batch disposition and release processes.
* Act as subject matter expert (SME) for transportation related Quality Processes.
* Prepare, review and approve SOPs and other GMP/GDP documentation in compliance with corporate and regulatory requirements, to ensure alignment with procedures, current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP), Good Distribution Practices (GDP) and other applicable regulations.
* Collaborate with the 3rd Parties to ensure adherence to service levels, identifying and implementing performance improvement
* Understand and incorporate risk management strategy into overall supply chain strategy
* Provide support for logistic service provider and transportation service provider oversight
* Support in tactical activities for internal/external audits and inspections as part of the audit/inspection team
* Provide quality expertise and guidance to operational staff and within cross functional Amgen teams
* Take part in operational improvement initiatives, programs, and projects
* Develop solutions that are thorough, practical, and consistent with functional objectives
* Ownership of supplier metrics, performance assessments, and other key documents to inform the health of supplier relationships.
* Work under minimal supervision in line with Amgen Values and Leadership Attributes

**Basic Qualifications:**

* We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The quality professional we seek is a strong leader with these qualifications:
* Bachelor’s degree in science or engineering and 7+ years of professional experience in related fields.
* Understanding of GMP/GDP requirements.
* Familiarity with logistics processes of parcel, transport, and warehousing providers.
* Experience in Validation/Qualification of processes, equipment, and facilities.
* Strong technical writing skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Global Supply Quality Background.
* Distribution Quality background.
* Strong continuous improvement attitude and lean practices experience.
* Understanding of end-to-end supply chain business processes.
* Experience in project management across multiple departments and geographies.
* Quick process understanding, insight and visualizing.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer L4
description:
**Who We Are**
Inovalon was founded in 1998 on the belief that technology, and data specifically, would empower the transformation of the entire healthcare ecosystem for the better, improving both outcomes and economics. At Inovalon, we believe that when our customers are successful in their missions, healthcare improves. Therefore, we focus on empowering them with data-driven solutions. And the momentum is building.
  
  
Together, as ONE Inovalon, we are a united force delivering solutions that address healthcare’s greatest needs. Through our mission-based culture of inclusion and innovation, our organization brings value not just to our customers, but to the millions of patients and members they serve.
  
  
**Who You Are**
As a Performance Automation Engineer, you help ensure our applications are scalable, reliable, and responsive under a wide range of user and system demands. You work closely with development, QA, and DevOps teams to evaluate system behavior, identify performance risks, and drive measurable improvements. You bring a strong foundation in performance testing and engineering, and you use data, observability, and collaboration to improve readiness for production. In this role, your work directly supports resilient systems and better outcomes for internal teams and clients.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design, develop, and maintain performance test scripts using JMeter to validate application scalability, reliability, and responsiveness.
* Execute load, stress, spike, and endurance tests to simulate real-world traffic patterns and assess production readiness.
* Analyze application behavior under load and identify performance bottlenecks across CPU, memory, database, network, and related system components.
* Partner with development, QA, and DevOps teams to troubleshoot issues, optimize application performance, and support performance tuning efforts.
* Integrate performance tests into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous validation and early detection of performance regressions.
* Monitor application and infrastructure performance using tools such as Datadog and correlate metrics, logs, and traces to support root cause analysis.
* Prepare detailed performance reports that summarize observations, trends, risks, and recommendations for stakeholders.
* Support capacity planning activities by evaluating system limits, usage patterns, and projected performance needs.

**What You'll Need**

* 4 to 7 years of experience in performance testing and performance engineering.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Information Technology, or equivalent combination of education and experience required.
* Strong hands-on experience with JMeter for performance and load testing.
* Solid understanding of performance testing concepts, including load, stress, spike, and endurance testing.
* Experience analyzing test results and identifying performance bottlenecks.
* Familiarity with web technologies, including HTTP/HTTPS and REST APIs.
* Ability to correlate application performance with infrastructure metrics.
* Hands-on experience with monitoring tools such as Datadog.
* Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and traces for root cause analysis.
* Understanding of Application Performance Monitoring concepts.
* Basic knowledge of Linux/Unix systems.
* Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins and Azure DevOps.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the ability to break down performance issues and use evidence to guide decisions.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills in a fast-paced, agile environment.
* Demonstrate growth potential and learning agility by quickly building knowledge in new tools, systems, and performance engineering practices as needs evolve.
* Demonstrate leadership by collaborating effectively with cross-functional partners, influencing performance-focused decisions, and working through differing perspectives constructively.
* Demonstrate adaptability by adjusting priorities and approach in response to changing project needs, system conditions, and business timelines.
* Demonstrate creative thinking by identifying practical, innovative ways to improve test coverage, performance visibility, and system efficiency.
* Demonstrate analytical skills by interpreting test data, identifying patterns, and drawing sound conclusions to support performance improvements.
* Nice to have: Experience with modern performance tools such as K6 or Gatling; knowledge of scripting languages such as JavaScript, Groovy, or similar; experience with distributed load testing; understanding of cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

**Our Shared Commitments**

* Maintain compliance with Inovalon’s policies, procedures and mission statement;
* Adhere to all confidentiality and HIPAA requirements as outlined within Inovalon’s Operating Policies and Procedures in all ways and at all times with respect to any aspect of the data handled or services rendered in the undertaking of the position; and
* Fulfill those responsibilities and/or duties that may be reasonably provided by Inovalon for the purpose of achieving operational and financial success of Employer.

**Work Environment**

* This is primarily a computer-based role performed in a remote, hybrid, or office environment. The role requires prolonged periods of computer use and frequent communication and interaction with others, either virtually and/or in person. The role may occasionally require transporting or moving work-related equipment weighing up to 10 pounds, such as a laptop and related materials. Some travel may be required, depending on the needs of the role. Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position, consistent with applicable law.

*This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship (e.g. H-1B, TN, or E-3). Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States as a condition of employment. (This is only applicable for US-based positions)*
*If you don’t meet every qualification listed but are excited about our mission and the work described, we encourage you to apply. Inovalon is most interested in finding the best candidate for the job, and you may be just the right person for this or other roles.*
*By embracing inclusion, we enhance our work environment and drive business success. Inovalon strives to provide equal opportunities to the communities where we operate and to our clients and everyone whom we serve. We endeavor to create a culture of inclusion in which our associates feel empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work and pursue their professional goals in an equitable setting. We understand that by fostering this type of culture, and welcoming different perspectives, we generate innovation and growth.*
*Inovalon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirement.*

title: Sr. Design Evaluation Engineer
description:
**About Analog Devices**
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
**Senior Design Evaluation Engineer**
– Automotive Networking
  
  
**Role Overview**
Analog Devices International is seeking an experienced Design Evaluation Engineer to join the Automotive Networking Evaluation team in Hyderabad, India. In this Senior technical role, you will lead the definition and execution of evaluation strategies for FPGA prototypes and automotive networking ASICs, from initial platform bring-up through system-level validation, characterisation, and release readiness. You will combine hands-on laboratory expertise with strong software development, test automation, data analysis, and technical leadership skills to deliver robust, repeatable, and high-quality evaluation solutions.
  
  
You will work closely with design, verification, applications, systems, software, and product engineering teams to identify technical risks, resolve complex issues, and ensure that silicon and supporting platforms meet product and system requirements. As a Senior Engineer, you will provide technical direction, mentor engineers, and drive improvements in evaluation methodologies, tools, and laboratory practices.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Execute comprehensive evaluation strategies, test plans, coverage goals, methodologies, and release criteria for FPGA prototypes and automotive networking ASICs.
* Translate product, architecture, and system requirements into measurable laboratory tests, including functional, performance, interoperability, robustness, and corner-case evaluation.
* Develop modular, maintainable test and automation software in C and Python, including instrument control, data acquisition, regression execution, result processing, and report generation.
* Execute and analyse complex silicon and FPGA test cases; debug failures across hardware, firmware, software, interfaces, and system boundaries.
* Perform electrical and functional measurements using oscilloscopes, logic analysers, protocol analysers, signal generators, power supplies, and other laboratory equipment.
* Lead structured root-cause investigations, clearly document findings, and work with cross-functional teams to drive issues to resolution.
* Evaluate automotive Ethernet and related networking functionality, including link behaviour, data-path performance, timing, error handling, diagnostics, and interoperability.
* Develop system-level hardware, embedded software, scripts, user guides, application examples, test procedures, and technical reports that enable internal and external product evaluation.
* Review evaluation results, identify coverage gaps and technical risks, and communicate evidence-based recommendations to engineering and programme stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Four or more years of relevant experience in design evaluation, silicon validation, product engineering, systems engineering, or a comparable role.
* Demonstrated experience evaluating FPGA prototypes and performing bench validation or characterisation of ASICs.
* Strong proficiency in C and Python, with experience developing reliable test, automation, or embedded software.
* Knowledge of embedded systems, digital hardware, laboratory measurement techniques, and hardware/software integration.
* Proven ability to diagnose complex problems using structured debugging, critical thinking, root-cause analysis, and evidence-based decision-making.
* Experience capturing, processing, interpreting, and presenting technical data, with a strong focus on accuracy, repeatability, and traceability.
* Working knowledge of Ethernet and networking concepts, together with experience using serial interfaces such as SPI, I²C, and UART.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear technical reports and present complex findings to varied audiences.
* Demonstrated collaboration, ownership, and the ability to influence outcomes across cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications And Experience**

* Familiarity with automotive networking architectures, zonal systems, software-defined vehicles, and relevant industry standards.
* Experience with Ethernet protocol analysis, network traffic generation, performance measurement, interoperability testing, or fault injection.
* Experience developing embedded firmware for microcontrollers and integrating host-side software with evaluation hardware.
* Experience with audio and video interfaces or data paths, including PDM and RGB8.
* Familiarity with source control, continuous integration, automated regression frameworks, requirements traceability, and issue-tracking systems.

*For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.*

We foster a culture where everyone has an opportunity to succeed regardless of their race, color, religion, age, ancestry, national origin, social or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, union membership, and political affiliation, or any other legally protected group.*

description:
**Introduction**
India Systems Development Lab (ISDL)
  
  
IBM Systems division builds Servers, Storage and Systems Software which are the building blocks for next-generation IT infrastructure of enterprise customers and data centers. IBM Servers provide best-in-class reliability, scalability, performance, and end-to-end security to handle mission-critical workloads and provide seamless extension to hybrid multicloud environments.
  
  
India Systems Development Lab (ISDL) is part of word-wide IBM Systems division. Established in 1996, the ISDL Lab is headquartered in Bengaluru, with presence in Pune and Hyderabad as well. ISDL teams work across the IBM Systems stack including Processor development, Firmware, Operating Systems, Systems Software, Storage Software, Cloud Software, Performance Engineering, System Test etc. The ISDL teams also ushered in new development models such as Agile, Design Thinking and DevOps.
  
  
****Your Role And Responsibilities****
As a Software Engineer at IBM India Systems Development Lab (IBM ISDL), you will get an opportunity to work on all the phases of product development (Design/Development, Test and Support) across core Systems technologies including Operating Systems, Firmware, Systems Software, Storage Software & Cloud Software.
  
  
**As a Software Developer At ISDL:**

* You will be focused on development of IBM Systems products interfacing with development & product management teams and end users, cutting across Geos.
* You would analyze product requirements, determine the best course of design, implement/code the solution and test across the entire product development life cycle. One could also work on Validation and Support of IBM Systems products.
* You get to work with a vibrant, culture driven and technically accomplished teams working to create world-class products and deployment environments, delivering an industry leading user experience for our customers
* You will be valued for your contributions in a growing organization with broader opportunities.

At ISDL, work is more than a job - it's a calling: To build. To design. To code. To invent. To collaborate. To think along with clients. To make new products/markets. Not just to do something better, but to attempt things you've never thought was possible. Are you ready to lead in this new era of technology and solve some of the most challenging problems in Systems Software technologies? If so, let's talk.
  
  
Regular Job opportunities across ISDL teams are in the following areas.
  
  
Systems and Cloud Software Engineer: As a Software Engineer with IBM Systems and Cloud Software teams, you will get the opportunity to get involved in all the phases of software development and work with technically accomplished teams. The responsibilities comprise of design new enhancements, coding (including test automation), problem determination and bug fixing, performance analysis, and solving client problems. You could also work on IBM Compute and Storage Systems including Virtualisation, I/O and Reliability Availability & Serviceability thereby, enabling the creation of a seamless software user experience across the stack delivering to IBM's Hybrid Cloud and AI clients. As an engineer you will be responsible for enhancing and maintaining the key components of the Software stack, Platform enablement and an opportunity to work on closed and Open source development communities.
  
  
AI Software Engineer: As a Software Engineer with IBM AI on Z Solutions teams, you will get the opportunity to get involved in delivering best-in class Enterprise AI Solutions on IBM Z and support IBM Customers while adopting AI technologies / Solutions into their businesses by building ethical, secure, trustworthy and sustainable AI solutions on IBM Z.You will be part of end to end solutions working along with technically accomplished teams. You will be working as a Full stack developer starting from understanding client challenges to providing solutions using AI.
  
  
**IBM Spectrum Fusion SW Engineer:**
IBM Spectrum Fusion container-native storage solution for OpenShift is designed for enterprise customers who need global hybrid cloud data access. As a Software Engineer with IBM Storage Spectrum Fusion team, you will work with the Dev/Test team to develop and support features for Spectrum Fusion product roadmap.
  
  
**Linux Developer:**
As a Linux developer, you would be involved in design and development of advanced features in the Linux OS for the next generation server platforms from IBM by collaboration with the Linux community. You collaborate with teams across the hardware, firmware, and upstream Linux kernel community to deliver these capabilities.
  
  
**Hardware Management Console (HMC) / Novalink Software Developer:**
As a Software Developer in HMC / Novalink team, you will work on design, development, and test of the Management Console for IBM Power Servers. You will be involved in user centric Graphical User Interface development and Backend for server and virtualization management solution development in Agile environment.
  
  
**AIX Developer:**
AIX is a proprietary Unix operating system which runs on IBM Power Servers. It's a secure, scalable, and robust open standards-based UNIX operating system which is designed to meet the needs of Enterprises class infrastructure. As an AIX developer, you would be involved in development, test or support of AIX OS features development or open source software porting/development for AIX OS
  
  
**Performance Engineer:**
As a performance Engineer , you will get an opportunity to conduct experiments and analysis to identify performance aspects for operating systems and Enterprise Servers. where you will be responsible for advancing the product roadmap by using your expertise in Linux operating system, building kernel , applying patches, performance characterization, optimization and hardware architecture to analyse performance of software/hardware combinations. You will be involved in conducting experiments and analysis to identify performance challenges and uncover optimization opportunities for IBM Power virtualization and cloud management software built on Open stack. The areas of work will be on characterization, analysis and fine-tune application software to help deliver optimal performance on IBM Power.
  
  
**Firmware Engineer:**
As a Firmware developer you will be responsible for designing and developing components and features independently in IBM India Systems Development Lab. ISDL works on end-to-end design, development across Power, Z and Storage portfolio. You would be a part of WW Firmware development organization and would be involved in designing & developing cutting edge features on the open source OpenBMC stack ([1] [1] [1] [1] [1] [1] https://github.com/openbmc/) and developing the open source embedded firmware code for bringing up the next generation enterprise Power, Z and LinuxONE Servers. You will get an opportunity work alongside with some of the best minds in the industry, forum and communities in the process of contributing to the portfolio.
  
  
**Job Description For Enterprise System Design Software Engineer**
The Enterprise Systems Design team is keen on hiring passionate Computer science and engineering graduates / Masters students, who can blend their architectural knowledge and programming skills to build the complex infrastructure geared to work for the Hybrid cloud and AI workloads. We have several opportunities in following areas of System & chip development team :
  
  

* Processor verification engineer
* Needs to develop the test infrastructure to verify the architecture and functionality of the IBM server processors/SOC or ASICs. Will be responsible to creatively think of all the scenarios to test and report the coverage. Work with design as well as other key stakeholders in identifying /debugging & Resolving logic design issues and deliver a quality design
* Processor Pre / Post silicon validation engineer ; Memory characterization and qualification.
* As a validation engineer you would design and develop algorithms for Post Silicon Validation of next generation IBM server processors, SOCs and ASICs.
* Electronic design automation - Front & BE tool development.

EDA tools development team is responsible for developing state of the art Front End verification , simulation , Formal verification tools , Place & Route, synthesis tools and Flows critical for designing & verifying high performance hardware design for IBM's next generation Systems (IBM P and Z Systems) which is used in Cognitive, ML, DL, and Data Center applications.

In this senior technical role, you will lead the definition and execution of evaluation strategies for FPGA prototypes and automotive networking ASICs, from initial platform bring-up through system-level validation, characterisation, and release readiness. You will combine hands-on laboratory expertise with strong software development, test automation, data analysis, and technical leadership skills to deliver robust, repeatable, and high-quality evaluation solutions.You will work closely with design, verification, applications, systems, software, and product engineering teams to identify technical risks, resolve complex issues, and ensure that silicon and supporting platforms meet product and system requirements. As a Staff Engineer, you will provide technical direction, mentor engineers, and drive improvements in evaluation methodologies, tools, and laboratory practices.Key ResponsibilitiesDefine and lead comprehensive evaluation strategies, test plans, coverage goals, methodologies, and release criteria for FPGA prototypes and automotive networking ASICs. Architect, develop, bring up, and maintain hardware and software evaluation platforms, test fixtures, reference systems, and supporting infrastructure. Perform electrical and functional measurements using oscilloscopes, logic analysers, protocol analysers, signal generators, power supplies, and other laboratory equipment. Evaluate Automotive Ethernet T1S and related networking functionality, including link behaviour, data-path performance, timing, error handling, diagnostics, and interoperability. Develop system-level hardware, embedded software, scripts, user guides, application examples, test procedures, and technical reports that enable internal and external product evaluation. Review evaluation results, identify coverage gaps and technical risks, and communicate evidence-based recommendations to engineering and programme stakeholders. Drive continuous improvement in test architecture, automation, data quality, traceability, repeatability, and laboratory efficiency. Provide technical leadership and mentoring, lead design and code reviews, and contribute to planning, estimation, and prioritisation activities. Required Qualifications And ExperienceBachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. Typically seven or more years of relevant experience in design evaluation, silicon validation, product engineering, systems engineering, or a comparable role. Demonstrated experience evaluating FPGA prototypes and performing bench validation or characterisation of ASICs. Strong proficiency in C and Python, with experience developing reliable test, automation, or embedded software. Strong knowledge of embedded systems, digital hardware, laboratory measurement techniques, and hardware/software integration. Proven ability to diagnose complex problems using structured debugging, critical thinking, root-cause analysis, and evidence-based decision-making. Experience capturing, processing, interpreting, and presenting technical data, with a strong focus on accuracy, repeatability, and traceability. Working knowledge of Ethernet and networking concepts, together with experience using serial interfaces such as SPI, I²C, and UART. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear technical reports and present complex findings to varied audiences. Demonstrated technical leadership, collaboration, ownership, and the ability to influence outcomes across cross-functional teams. Preferred Qualifications And ExperienceExperience with automotive Ethernet technologies, including 10BASE-T1S, single-pair Ethernet, MAC-PHY devices, Physical Layer Collision Avoidance, or related in-vehicle networking solutions. Familiarity with automotive networking architectures, zonal systems, software-defined vehicles, and relevant industry standards. Experience with Ethernet protocol analysis, network traffic generation, performance measurement, interoperability testing, or fault injection. Experience developing embedded firmware for microcontrollers and integrating host-side software with evaluation hardware. title: Quality Assurance Engineer (Platform Quality)
description:
**Most QA roles measure how many tests you write. This one measures the defect that never reached a client.**

Nyayasiddhi, an Indian legaltech company, is hiring a
**Quality Assurance Engineer (Platform Quality)**
in
**Hyderabad**
.

This is the
**first dedicated quality hire**
on our engineering team. You’ll work on software that professionals rely on for real matters, where a defect is a trust problem and not a cosmetic one.

You’ll test deeply, write clearly, and decline to sign off on anything you couldn’t verify.

**What you’ll own**

* Functional and regression coverage across web and mobile
* A regression pack that runs before every release, kept trustworthy enough that a green run means something
* Release verification evidence: a written record of what was tested, where, and with what result
* Defect quality, so every bug you file can be reproduced by a developer on first read
* A living permission matrix covering every role and action, with the expected allow and deny outcomes

**The engineering craft**

* Turn specifications, user flows and API contracts into test cases: happy path, negative path, boundaries and permission variants
* Run exploratory sessions on new modules before scripts exist, then turn what you find into permanent cases
* Test versioned REST APIs for contract correctness, including error handling, validation and safe retries
* Verify database state yourself with SQL. An API response alone is not proof
* Test authorisation, data isolation and audit integrity with the rigour of a system that will be reviewed later
* Check that background jobs complete, retry safely and never double-apply
* Extend the automated suite in Playwright and code-based API tests, starting with the highest-risk paths
* Test web across browsers and mobile on real Android and iOS devices
* Re-test every fix, and publish an honest release note, including what was not tested and why

**What we expect from you**

* 2–4 years in software QA on a web product, including at least one year on a product with real users in production
* Strong manual and exploratory discipline, with test cases someone else can follow without asking you questions
* Hands-on REST API testing (Postman, Bruno, Insomnia or code-based)
* Working SQL
* Ability to read TypeScript / JavaScript and to maintain automated UI tests in Playwright, Cypress or Selenium
* A practical understanding of authentication, roles and sessions, and of what a permission bug looks like in practice
* Clear written English, because your bug reports and sign-off notes may be read by auditors later
* Comfort with Git, a defect tracker, and a product that keeps changing
* A Bachelor’s degree in engineering or computer science, or equivalent practical experience

**An advantage if you have it**

* Playwright specifically, JMeter or k6, and CI experience (GitHub Actions or similar)
* Flutter or native mobile testing on real devices
* Multi-tenant B2B SaaS, or a product with approval workflows
* Regulated domains: legal, fintech, healthtech, govtech
* Interest in how AI-enabled features are tested and kept honest

**What you don’t need**

You don’t need legal-domain knowledge, compliance-framework expertise. We’d rather you say so honestly in the interview than over-claim.

**What success looks like**

* Escaped defects trending down, release over release
* Zero severity-1 regressions per release
* High-risk paths fully automated within two quarters
* Defects reproducible on first read, above 90% of the time
* A written test record for every release

We don’t reward volume. We don’t count test cases written or bugs filed.

**Where this goes**

QA Engineer, then Senior QA Engineer (typically 12–24 months), then QA Lead. We promote on demonstrated ownership, not tenure. In a team this size, the person who catches what nobody else catches becomes visible quickly.

**The terms**

* Type: Full-time.
* Location: Hyderabad, India.
* Compensation: Market Standard.

**How to apply**

Email your resume, plus a short note covering:

1. A defect you caught that others missed, and how you found it
2. How you’d verify that one user can never see another user’s data
3. A time you refused to sign off on a release, and what happened
4. Current CTC, Expected Joining date
5. What is your notice period?
6. Tell us about a time you refused to sign off on a release. What happened?
   *Long text, 500 characters.*

Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?
  
  
Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.
  
  
The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.
  
  
**Pay And Benefits**

* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
The Enterprise Test Engineering ("ETE") family is responsible for ensuring that all applications and systems meet defined quality standards. The ETE family encompasses three major areas including (a) functional testing, (b) non-functional testing, and (c) test architecture and enablement. Other key focuses include: regression testing, browser testing, performance testing, capacity and stress testing, resiliency testing, environment management services, and infrastructure testing. Develops, conducts, and evaluates testing processes, working closely with developers to remediate identified system defects. In-depth knowledge of automated testing tools, and quality control and assurance approaches including the creation of reusable foundational test automation framework for the entire organization. The Performance Test Engineering role is responsible for the validation of non-functional requirements for performance testing.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities**

* Develop understanding of the DTCC Software Delivery process, Performance Test Engineering framework, CoE (Center of Excellence) Engagement process as well as understanding of tech-stack (tools and technologies) to perform day-to-day job
* Prepare, maintain and execute performance test scenarios based on non-functional requirements and follow standard DTCC testing guidelines
* Automate performance test scenarios by leveraging current automated functional and performance test scripts
* Support traceability across Non-Functional Requirements, Performance Test Scenarios and Defects
* Support the review of performance test scenarios from both a technical and business perspective with stakeholders, such as development teams and business
* Track defects to closure, report test results, continuously execute plan and escalate as required
* Support integration of performance testing with Delivery Pipeline and produce results
* Create synthetic test data as per the data distribution and volume requirements
* Develop a understanding of the product being delivered
* Adhere to all process standards, guidelines and documented procedures
* Develop an understanding of the logical architecture and technical design of the supported application in relation to the performance and scalability
* Aligns risk and control processes into day to day responsibilities to monitor and mitigate risk; escalates appropriately

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 4 years of related experience
* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience

**Talents Needed For Success**

* Experience in performance engineering & resiliency testing (analysis, testing, and tuning)
* Experience developing n-tier, J2EE software applications
* Experience working in Unix or Linux environments
* Expertise in performance analysis of distributed platforms including Linux, Windows, AWS, Containers and VMware (tools: Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Splunk, CloudWatch, TeamQuest)
* Extensive knowledge of the functionality and performance aspects of the above computing platforms
* Experience in sophisticated statistical and analytical modeling
* Excellent analytical skills including:
* Data exploration, analysis and presentation applying descriptive statistics and graphical techniques
* Time series analysis and forecasting
* Key Performance and volume metrics relationship modeling
* Expertise in load & resiliency testing tools, such as JMeter, Gremlin etc.
* Experience in scripting (Perl, Unix shell, Python, Terraform, Chef, Jenkins)
* Experience using JMS/IBM-MQ messaging system and Kafka systems
* Understanding of RESTful web service, JSON, and XML
* Experience in Relational Databases, preferably Oracle
* Experience with AWS services (Kinesis, Elastic Beanstalk, CloudWatch, Lambda, etc)
* Experience with CI/CD pipeline implementations, including testing, using Jenkins or similar tool
* Expert MS Office skills. Effective use of Excel statistical functions and sophisticated Power Point presentation skills
* Experience working with Agile teams (preferably scrum)
* Experience in the financial services industry is good to have
* Fosters a culture where honesty and transparency are expected.
* Stays current on changes in his/her own specialist area and seeks out learning opportunities to ensure knowledge is up-to-date.
* Collaborates well within and across teams.
* Communicates openly with team members and others.
* Resolves disagreements between colleagues effectively, minimizing the impact on the wider team.

Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

title: Senior Specialist, Data Analysis
description:
**Job Description**
**Senior Specialist, Data Analysis**
**The Opportunity**
Join a global biopharma company with a 130-year legacy and mission to achieve new milestones in healthcare. Be part of a technology-driven, data-led organization supporting a diversified portfolio of medicines, vaccines, and animal health products. Work alongside passionate teams that use data, analytics, and insights to drive decisions and tackle some of the world’s greatest health threats.
  
  
Our Technology Centers are globally distributed hubs that enable our digital transformation and business outcomes across IT. They bring together diverse teams to collaborate, share best practices, and deliver solutions that save and improve lives.
  
  
This role is based at our Hyderabad Tech Center and follows a hybrid working model (3 days onsite, 2 days remote). Candidates are expected to reside within commuting distance of the Hyderabad office.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for Senior Specialist with strong Functional analysis, data analysis, functional testing, UAT coordination, stakeholder communication, and Scrum Master responsibilities for one or two squads. Understand business data needs and perform descriptive and investigative analysis across relevant solution-delivery phases. Query, explore, and validate data to identify patterns, anomalies, quality issues, business rules, and functional impacts. Work with Value Team Business Analysts and Product Managers to translate business needs into functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and validation requirements. Support functional testing and UAT to confirm delivered solutions and data outputs meet agreed business requirements. Serve as Scrum Master for one or two squads by enabling Agile ceremonies, backlog readiness, impediment removal, transparency, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**What Will You Do In This Role**

* Analyze and validate data from relevant databases and sources to identify trends, anomalies, data-quality issues, and business impacts.
* Write SQL queries for data extraction, validation, reconciliation, defect analysis, functional testing, and root-cause assessment.
* Triage data questions, defects, and functional issues; communicate findings clearly and coordinate with teams through resolution.
* Partner with Value Team Business Analysts and Product Managers to clarify business processes, requirements, and expected outcomes.
* Convert requirements into functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, business rules, test scenarios, and traceability artifacts.
* Ensure functional specifications are complete, testable, aligned to business priorities, and ready for squad implementation.
* Define and execute functional test scenarios using data analysis and SQL where appropriate.
* Coordinate functional testing across business, QA, and technology teams, including test-data readiness, execution tracking, defect clarification, and retesting.
* Support UAT planning, business-user coordination, execution guidance, defect management, evidence collection, and business sign-off.
* Validate delivered functionality and data outputs for quality, timeliness, compliance, and user experience.
* Act as Scrum Master for one or two squads; facilitate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Work with Product Owners and Product Managers to maintain a prioritized, ready backlog with clear acceptance criteria.
* Help squads remove impediments, manage dependencies, maintain delivery transparency, and achieve sprint goals.
* Track sprint progress, risks, actions, dependencies, and improvement commitments; provide concise updates to stakeholders.
* Build trusted stakeholder relationships and collaborate effectively across global teams and matrix organizations.

**What Should You Have**

* 8+ years of experience
* Data analysis and investigative problem solving
* SQL query writing for extraction, validation, reconciliation, testing, and root-cause analysis
* Data validation, reconciliation, and data-quality assessment
* Functional analysis and functional specification writing
* User story, acceptance criteria, business rule, and process-flow definition
* Functional testing and requirement-to-test traceability
* UAT planning, coordination, defect clarification, retesting, evidence collection, and sign-off support
* Scrum Mastery and Agile ceremony facilitation
* Backlog readiness, dependency tracking, impediment removal, and delivery transparency
* Stakeholder relationship management across business, product, QA, and technology teams
* Clear written and verbal communication for technical and non-technical audiences
* Global matrix collaboration and influencing without direct authority
* SQL and relational databases
* Data-analysis and data-validation techniques
* Agile work-management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Rally, or equivalent
* Testing, defect-management, and UAT coordination practices
* Demonstrated experience in data analysis, data validation, and issue investigation using SQL.
* Experience partnering with Business Analysts and Product Managers to create functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Hands-on experience with functional testing and UAT support or coordination, including defects, retesting, and sign-off readiness.
* Experience performing Scrum Master responsibilities for one or more Agile squads.
* Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, and written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams in a matrix organization.
* Scrum Master certification such as CSM, PSM, SAFe Scrum Master, or equivalent is preferred.

**Primary Skills**
Scrum Master, Functional analysis, data analysis, functional testing, UAT coordination, SQL
  
  
**Secondary Skills**
Data analyst
  
  
**Who We Are**
We are known as well-known org Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
  
  
**What We Look For**
Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.

**Required Skills**
Data Analysis, Functional Analysis, Functional Testing, Scrum, Structured Query Language (SQL), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), User Acceptance Testing Support

title: Data Quality Engineer
description:
**Company:**
Finarb Analytics Consulting Pvt. Ltd.

**Job Title:**
Data Quality Engineer – SQL / ETL / Microsoft Fabric

**Location:**
Hyderabad or Kolkata, India

**Experience:**
3–6 Years (Suggested)

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Application Link:**
https://zurl.to/KmZM?source=CareerSite

About Finarb

Finarb Analytics Consulting is a data, analytics, and technology consulting firm helping organizations transform complex data into actionable business insights through advanced analytics, business intelligence, artificial intelligence, and modern data platforms.

**Website:**
https://www.finarb.ai

About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented, technically strong
**Data Quality Engineer**
to ensure the accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability of enterprise data across multiple platforms.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with
**SQL, data validation, ETL testing, data reconciliation, and data quality automation**
, along with a good understanding of data warehousing and modern cloud data platforms.

This role will focus on validating data flowing through SQL Server, Azure Data Factory, and Microsoft Fabric environments, with particular emphasis on ensuring data integrity during platform migration and ongoing production operations.

The successful candidate will collaborate closely with data engineers, BI developers, senior data quality professionals, and data architects to identify data discrepancies, investigate root causes, automate validation processes, and establish reliable data quality controls.

We are looking for engineers who can independently analyze complex datasets, understand transformation logic, and develop scalable, repeatable data quality testing solutions.

Key Responsibilities1. Data Quality Validation and Testing

* Develop and execute comprehensive data quality checks across enterprise data platforms.
* Validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, uniqueness, and integrity.
* Perform source-to-target validation across ingestion, staging, transformation, and reporting layers.
* Identify missing records, duplicates, null values, invalid mappings, and inconsistent business calculations.
* Validate data against defined business rules and transformation specifications.
* Investigate discrepancies and collaborate with engineering teams to resolve issues.
* Develop reusable test cases and maintain data quality documentation.

2. SQL-Based Data Testing and Reconciliation

* Develop complex SQL queries to validate data across source and target systems.
* Perform record-count reconciliation, aggregate reconciliation, and detailed field-level comparisons.
* Validate joins, transformations, aggregations, and business calculations.
* Test stored procedures, SQL transformations, views, and data warehouse tables.
* Analyze large datasets to identify inconsistencies and anomalies.
* Investigate root causes of data mismatches and document findings.
* Optimize validation queries for performance and scalability.

3. ETL / ELT Pipeline Testing

* Test data ingestion and transformation pipelines built using Azure Data Factory and Microsoft Fabric.
* Validate pipeline execution results, data transformations, and target data structures.
* Verify incremental loads, full loads, upserts, and change data capture processes.
* Test data handling for missing values, duplicate records, invalid formats, and unexpected source changes.
* Validate pipeline error handling, retry mechanisms, and exception processing.
* Perform regression testing following ETL enhancements and production releases.
* Collaborate with data engineers to investigate and resolve pipeline-related data issues.

4. Microsoft Fabric Migration Validation

* Support data quality assurance during migration from SQL Server and Azure Data Factory to Microsoft Fabric.
* Develop source-to-target reconciliation processes for migrated datasets.
* Validate data transformations across Fabric Lakehouse, Warehouse, and data pipelines.
* Perform row-count, checksum, aggregate, and field-level reconciliation where appropriate.
* Verify historical data completeness and incremental data consistency.
* Identify discrepancies between legacy and Fabric-based processing.
* Support parallel-run validation and post-migration stabilization.
* Maintain migration validation reports and evidence of data quality checks.

5. Data Quality Automation

* Develop reusable SQL-based validation scripts and automated reconciliation processes.
* Build automated data quality checks using Python, SQL, or other appropriate tools.
* Integrate validation processes into ETL/ELT workflows where applicable.
* Automate recurring checks for data completeness, uniqueness, referential integrity, and business rule compliance.
* Implement exception reporting and automated identification of data quality failures.
* Support continuous improvement of testing efficiency and coverage.
* Reduce manual validation effort through repeatable and maintainable testing frameworks.

6. Production Data Quality Monitoring

* Monitor data quality across production data pipelines and reporting datasets.
* Investigate data-related incidents reported by business users or BI teams.
* Perform root cause analysis for recurring data quality defects.
* Track data quality issues and coordinate resolution with engineering teams.
* Validate corrective fixes and perform regression testing.
* Support production release validation and ongoing operational checks.
* Maintain traceability of data quality defects and their resolutions.

7. Collaboration and Documentation

* Work closely with data engineers, Power BI developers, and data architects.
* Understand business rules, data transformations, and reporting requirements.
* Translate data specifications into comprehensive validation scenarios.
* Document test cases, reconciliation logic, test results, and identified defects.
* Participate in requirement reviews, technical discussions, and defect triage.
* Contribute to establishing standardized data quality processes and best practices.

Required Technical Skills

Technology / SkillExpected ProficiencySQL / T-SQLAdvanced querying and validationData Quality TestingAccuracy, completeness, consistency, uniquenessETL / ELT TestingSource-to-target and transformation validationData ReconciliationRecord-level, aggregate, and field-level comparisonsSQL ServerStrong hands-on experienceData WarehousingFact/dimension tables and transformation logicAzure Data FactoryUnderstanding of pipelines and data flowsData Quality AutomationSQL scripts and automated validationDefect InvestigationRoot cause analysis and issue trackingMicrosoft FabricBasic knowledge or practical exposure

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 3–6 years of experience in data quality engineering, ETL testing, data validation, or data warehouse testing.
* Strong hands-on SQL skills, including complex joins, CTEs, aggregations, window functions, and subqueries.
* Proven experience performing source-to-target data validation and reconciliation.
* Experience testing ETL/ELT pipelines and complex data transformations.
* Good understanding of relational databases and data warehousing concepts.
* Experience identifying data discrepancies and independently investigating root causes.
* Familiarity with SQL Server and Azure-based data environments.
* Experience developing and maintaining test cases, validation scripts, and defect reports.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills

* Experience with Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake, and Fabric Data Factory.
* Knowledge of Python or PySpark for automated data validation.
* Familiarity with data quality frameworks such as Great Expectations, Soda, or equivalent tools.
* Experience with Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2.
* Understanding of Delta Lake and medallion architecture.
* Experience validating large-scale cloud data migration projects.
* Familiarity with Power BI reports and semantic model validation.
* Knowledge of Git, Azure DevOps, and CI/CD processes.
* Exposure to data profiling, data observability, and data governance concepts.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Purview or equivalent metadata management tools.

Key Competencies

* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Ability to independently investigate complex data discrepancies.
* Strong understanding of business rules and transformation logic.
* Ability to communicate technical defects clearly and effectively.
* Collaborative approach to working with engineering and BI teams.
* Ownership of testing deliverables and data quality outcomes.
* Ability to manage multiple testing priorities in a dynamic environment.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will be expected to:

1. Ensure high levels of data accuracy, completeness, and consistency across enterprise datasets.
2. Identify and resolve data quality issues before they impact downstream reporting.
3. Develop reusable SQL-based reconciliation and validation processes.
4. Automate recurring data quality checks to improve testing efficiency.
5. Validate data integrity throughout Microsoft Fabric migration activities.
6. Reduce production data discrepancies and recurring data quality defects.
7. Maintain clear documentation and traceability of data quality testing.
8. Contribute to establishing reliable, scalable data quality practices across the organization.

Why Join Finarb?

* Work on enterprise-scale data engineering and analytics initiatives.
* Gain exposure to Microsoft Fabric and modern cloud data platforms.
* Participate in complex data migration and modernization programs.
* Collaborate with experienced data engineers, architects, and BI professionals.
* Develop expertise in data quality automation and advanced data validation.
* Contribute to delivering reliable and trusted enterprise data solutions.

ZestIOT Technologies is looking for a Senior Automation Engineer to design, build, and scale test automation across our product suite. title: Medical Copy Quality Assurance Specialist
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
**Medical Copy Quality Assurance Specialist**
**Roche India - Roche Services & Solutions**
**Hyderabad**
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
  
  
That’s what makes us Roche.
  
  
Roche is a stable and innovative biotechnological company offering exceptional career paths and great benefits for fresh graduates and outstanding professionals. We are continuously expanding, looking for new talents to join our transforming Roche Services & Solutions Center. We offer a flexible working framework (2 office days/week on average).
  
  
The Global Digital Hub growing business line within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Content Creation, and Creative Design.
  
  
**Position Summary**
As a
**Medical Copy Quality Assurance Specialist**
in the growing medical copy and content team within Roche Services & Solutions, you will play a crucial role in reviewing and editing various forms of content, such as articles, blog posts, social media posts, website content, and promotional materials related to medical and healthcare topics. This specialized team focuses on generating commercial content intended for various digital formats (emails, videos, banners, infographics, websites, etc.). Their work plays a crucial role in supporting the communication strategies developed by Roche's global and local business teams.
  
  
**Your Opportunity:**
We are seeking a meticulous and detail-oriented Medical Copy Quality Assurance (QA) Specialist to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and compliance of digital medical / scientific materials designed for the US market. The primary responsibility of this role is to conduct comprehensive quality checks (QC) for various digital materials such as emails, banners, and advertisements, with a focus on medical and scientific accuracy. This position demands a keen eye for detail and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to maintain the highest standard of quality.
  
  
Day-to-Day Role Description:
  
  

* Review and QC of Medical/Scientific Digital Materials:

+ Examine emails, banners, ads, and other digital assets, checking:

- Foundational quality and fit to brief
- Language use, style, spelling, grammar, formatting, etc
- Scientific and medical accuracy
- Consistency with brand guidelines and technical specifications

* Collaborate with Teams:

+ Work closely with writers, designers, and project managers to address feedback and implement revisions
+ Provide constructive feedback to enhance the accuracy and quality of deliverables

* Maintain Documentation:

+ Keep thorough records of QC findings and suggestions
+ Track revisions and document outcomes for continuous improvement

Step-by-Step Checklist for Medical/Scientific QC of Digital Materials:
  
  

* Check the Accuracy of Content:

+ Verify that all scientific and medical claims are evidence-based and supported by reliable sources
+ Confirm that the content aligns with current medical guidelines and applicable regulatory standards

* Conduct a Thorough Language Check:

+ Review for grammar, punctuation, and spelling errors
+ Ensure clarity, conciseness, and readability, tailoring the language to the target audience

* Verify Consistency:

+ Confirm that terminology, branding, and tone are consistent throughout the material
+ Ensure completeness of all text elements, e.g., footnotes, references, abbreviations, special formatting, etc
+ Cross-check for any conflicting information
+ Check for copy formatting/layout issues

* Validate Visual Elements:

+ Review images, charts, or graphics for scientific accuracy and appropriate usage
+ Ensure visual elements enhance the overall message without introducing errors

* Check Compliance:

+ Ensure compliance with US regulations, industry standards, and client-specific guidelines
+ Flag any material that requires further legal or medical review

* Perform Final Review:

+ Reassess the material after all changes have been implemented
+ Give final approval, ensuring it is error-free and ready for distribution

**Who You Are**
We are looking for knowledgeable individuals who are highly involved and passionate about writing and language!
  
  

* 2-3 years of experience in similar position
* Strong medical or science background
* A higher degree in life sciences is highly preferred, but candidates with other relevant experience will also be considered
* Minimum C2 level proficiency in English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Proven experience in quality control processes, particularly in reviewing medical or scientific content
* Collaborative attitude - working effectively across our diverse resources and business stakeholders
* Ability to work within a team and in different time zones
* Excellent attention to detail, consistency, clarity, and scientific rigor
* Customer-service mentality & can-do attitude
* Experience with the standard IT applications, preferably including Google suite
* Continuous improvement and growth mindset
* Ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment, ability to prioritize tasks

Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
  
  
**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

**Technical Analyst, Specialist (R2\)**
**The Opportunity**
* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130\- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.

 Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our companys’ IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
   

  

 A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well\-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 Join a global Digital Manufacturing organization and contribute to digital capabilities supporting Maintenance, Engineering, Asset Reliability, and Environment, Health \& Safety.
   

  

 As an Application Configuration \& Support Specialist, you will support configurable enterprise applications used across engineering, maintenance, asset reliability, EHS, manufacturing, and capital\-project business processes. Depending on business priorities, you may initially focus on one or more applications and progressively expand your knowledge across the broader technology portfolio.
   

  

 The successful candidate will work with business stakeholders, product teams, technical resources, and external vendors to support application operations, system enhancements, data quality initiatives, issue resolution, release activities, and user enablement efforts. This role is expected to develop expertise across multiple platforms and technologies as the organization's digital application landscape evolves.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have experience supporting configurable enterprise applications, strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, and the ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies, platforms, and business capabilities.
   

  

 Location Hyderabad ( mandatory 3 days Work from office) with flexibility to support occasional meetings during CST overlap hours.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**Application Configuration Support**

* Assist with implementing approved enhancements and configuration changes.
* Perform application maintenance activities and support routine system administration tasks.
* Participate in testing and validation of new functionality before deployment.


**Incident \& Ticket Management**

* Perform initial troubleshooting and issue analysis before escalating complex issues to Vendor.

* Provide regular updates to stakeholders regarding ticket status and resolution progress.


**Data Management \& Quality Assurance**
* Support data imports, exports, and validation activities.
* Assist with data cleansing, reconciliation, and quality checks.
* Help maintain data integrity across Enablon modules.
* Participate in reporting and analysis activities as needed.


**Release \& Change Support**
