title: Staff Verification Applications Engineer
description:
Alternate Job Titles
   

  

* Staff Verification Applications Engineer
* Senior Applications Engineer, Simulation \& Debug
* Staff Field Applications Engineer, Verification
* Technical Applications Engineer, VCS/Verdi
* Staff Customer Solutions Engineer, Verification


 We Are
   

  

 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

 You Are
   

  

 You have spent years in the verification trenches and learned that the hardest part is not running the simulation, it is making sure the customer's entire flow actually works when the design is real, the schedules are tight, and the stakes are first\-pass silicon. You know the difference between a tool that demos well and one that holds up under a million\-gate SoC with Low Power intent and Gate Level Timing checks enabled. You have debugged enough waveforms to spot the issue in minutes, not hours, and you can explain what went wrong to an engineer in Taiwan and an R\&D lead in Mountain View without losing either of them.
   

  

 You do not wait for perfect documentation. You dig into the problem, write the Tcl script that reproduces it, and work backward from there. You are comfortable sitting with a customer who is frustrated because their regression is failing and walking out with a plan that gets them unblocked by end of week. You have a point of view on what makes a verification flow robust, and you are not afraid to push back when a deployment plan skips the hard questions. At Synopsys, you will work directly with customers running the most complex verification challenges in the industry, and what you solve will determine whether their tape\-out happens on time.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Drive customer deployments of VCS and Verdi simulation and debug technology, working directly with design and verification teams to integrate tools into their existing flows
* Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues across UVM testbenches, SVA assertions, Low Power UPF flows, and Gate Level Timing simulations
* Collaborate with global R\&D and product teams to gather customer requirements, reproduce issues, and influence the product roadmap based on real deployment feedback
* Lead competitive engagements by running benchmarks, demonstrating VCS/Verdi advantages, and helping customers evaluate simulation performance and debug efficiency
* Develop and optimize automation scripts in Perl, Tcl, Python, Shell, and Make to improve customer productivity and streamline verification workflows
* Interface directly with customers, product validation teams, and R\&D to propose solutions, suggest product improvements, and close the loop on deployment challenges
* Support customers adopting AI\-driven verification productivity tools and advanced simulation features as part of their methodology evolution


 The Impact You Will Have
   

  

* Enable customers to close verification faster and hit first\-pass silicon by deploying simulation technology that actually scales to their design complexity
* Reduce time\-to\-tapeout for semiconductor companies building everything from mobile SoCs to automotive safety\-critical designs
* Shape the VCS and Verdi product roadmap by surfacing real customer pain points and competitive gaps that R\&D needs to address
* Drive adoption of advanced verification methodologies including UVM, Low Power, and Gate Level Timing simulation across global customer accounts
* Build long\-term customer relationships that turn Synopsys tools into the backbone of their verification infrastructure
* Accelerate the industry's shift toward AI\-augmented verification by helping customers integrate and adopt new productivity capabilities
* Strengthen Synopsys' competitive position in simulation and debug by winning benchmarks and proving performance in head\-to\-head evaluations


 What You'll Need
   

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering or related field with 5\-12 years of hands\-on experience in verification or applications engineering
* Strong working knowledge of VCS simulation technology and Verdi debug platform, or equivalent simulation and waveform debug tools
* Deep expertise in SystemVerilog, UVM, SVA, and verification methodologies applied to real RTL designs
* Proven experience with Low Power UPF flows and Gate Level Timing simulations in customer or product validation environments
* Advanced scripting ability in Perl, Tcl, Python, Shell, and Make for automation and flow development
* Solid understanding of digital design fundamentals, Verilog, VHDL, and UNIX/Linux environments
* Exposure to DPI, C/C\+\+, SystemC, Functional Safety, or GenAI technologies is a plus


 Who You Are
   

  

* You can explain a complex UVM sequence issue to a customer in two sentences and then write the 50\-line reproducer that proves it
* Comfortable working across time zones with customers in Asia, Europe, and the US without losing momentum on open issues
* You manage multiple customer engagements at once, keeping track of what is blocking each one and what needs to escalate to R\&D
* Self\-directed enough to own a customer deployment from kickoff through production without waiting for someone to tell you what to do next
* You ask the questions that uncover the real problem, not just the symptoms the customer described in the ticket
* Open to travel for onsite customer engagements, competitive benchmarks, and team collaboration when it moves the work forward


 The Team You'll Be Part Of
   

  

 Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: POS & Retail (PaaS)- Lead Integration Analyst

* Define and configure REST APIs, Webhooks, and JSON data transformations aligned with regional data mapping requirements
* Troubleshoot and configure integration flows leveraging Azure services:
* Logic Apps
* Azure Functions
* Service Bus
* Data Factory
* Azure SQL
* Ensure all local configurations adhere to global cloud blueprints and architecture standards

* Execute SIT, UAT, and End\-to\-End testing for localized integrations to ensure data integrity
* Execute application deployments and manage releases using existing Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines
* Utilize monitoring and observability tools (Azure Monitor, Splunk) to track integration health and trace data flows
* Ensure local configurations adhere to enterprise\-grade security controls and data privacy standards
* Translate local market business requirements into technical configurations and data mappings
* Act as the primary technical liaison between global integration engineering teams, local business stakeholders, and vendors
* Participate in workshops to adapt global integration patterns to local markets without altering the core architecture
* Analyse and resolve complex integration issues, specifically focusing on data routing failures, payload mismatches, and transformation errors
* Identify performance bottlenecks in data flows and suggest optimizations to the core cloud engineering teams
* Ensure system stability during high\-pressure go\-live and rollout phases
* Drive deployment timelines and coordinate pilot rollouts in local markets
* Provide dedicated hyper\-care support during cutovers and production ramp\-u
* Communicate project progress, technical risks, and deployment blockers clearly to stakeholders


**Profile**
* Minimum Bachelors degree in IT/Computer Science or other relevant discipline
* Strong experience in troubleshooting Azure PaaS services (Logic Apps, Functions, Service Bus, Data Factory, Azure SQL)
* Hands\-on experience in API integrations, event\-driven architecture, and microservices
* Proficiency in REST APIs, JSON, Webhooks, data transformation
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps) and IaC (ARM, Bicep, Terraform)
* Knowledge of monitoring tools (Azure Monitor, Splunk, AppDynamics)
* Familiarity with enterprise security standards and SSO configurations
* Experience integrating POS systems with ERP (SAP S/4HANA) and CRM platforms
* Understanding of retail data flows and operations (sales, inventory, payments)
* Experience in retail and large\-scale POS transformation programs
* Exposure to multi\-country deployments and localization requirements
* Knowledge of event\-driven architecture patterns and enterprise integration frameworks
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities
* Ability to perform in fast\-paced, high\-stakes deployment environments
* Excellent stakeholder communication across global and local teams

* Knowledge of bench testing equipment (o\-scope, logic analyzer, Nextest Magnum, etc)
* Knowledge of statistical and data analysis tools

* Fundamental programming/scripting skills (C/C\+\+, Python, Perl, Verilog, Verilog\-AMS, WREAL).
* Knowledge of firmware and assembly level programming.
* Effective communication and presentation skills
* Self\-motivated and hardworking
* Validated ability to partner successfully with other groups to build strong multi\-functional relationships and meet customer needs

* Verify integrations and data flows across middleware and downstream systems (IDoc/EDI, BAPIs/OData/REST/SOAP, SAP CPI), including error handling, traces and reconciliation.
* Trace and validate configuration changes and behaviors across dependent SAP modules.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to own and drive requirement coverage, process definition and traceability.


**Required**
**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in software testing and quality assurance, including significant ERP application testing.

* Experience with both manual and automated testing.
* Deep expertise and hands\-on testing experience with SAP S/4HANA.
* Experience across SAP S/4HANA modules (SD, MM, FI/CO, QM, LO) and business processes (O2C, P2P, D2S).
* Knowledge of IDoc/EDI flows, pricing/tax engines, outputs/forms, batch jobs, and job monitoring.
* Exposure to performance testing (Neoload, JMeter, LoadRunner) and data validation using SQL or SAP reporting tools.
* Experience with data migration testing, cutover validation, and hypercare support.


**Preferred**
* Snowflake ELT data testing and validation experience
* Understanding of security/roles testing and basic IAM concepts.
* Familiarity with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines.
* Ability to read ABAP logs, CDS views, and BRFplus rules to support defect analysis

title: Complaint Analyst
description:
**Overview**
 The Complaint Analyst is responsible for the evaluation, investigation, documentation, and regulatory assessment of product complaints associated with medical devices. This role supports compliance with applicable global regulations and quality system requirements through complaint investigations, adverse event reportability assessments, complaint trending, risk escalation, and cross\-functional collaboration to identify and mitigate patient safety and product quality risks.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Independently conduct and document complaint investigations of moderate to high complexity by evaluating product performance concerns, gathering information from customers, users, field representatives, and internal stakeholders, reviewing service records and product analysis findings, and exercising sound judgment to determine complaint conclusions and appropriate escalation activities.
* Coordinate and review product analysis, service evaluations, engineering assessments, and event coding activities to support complaint investigations, facilitate product performance monitoring, and ensure consistent event categorization.
* Ensure complaint records are complete, accurate, and compliant with applicable procedures, regulatory requirements, and record retention requirements.
* Assess complaint events for regulatory reportability using established decision models and investigation findings, and support the preparation, review, and documentation of MDR, Vigilance, and other applicable adverse event reports.
* Review service records, service reports, and other post\-market information to assess whether events meet complaint criteria and verify appropriate complaint classification in accordance with applicable procedures and regulatory requirements.
* Analyze complaint, service, and performance data to identify emerging quality, safety, reliability, or compliance trends and appropriately escalate issues requiring CAPA, risk management review, regulatory assessment, or other corrective actions.
* Participate in the review, validation, and continuous improvement of regulatory decision trees, complaint evaluation processes, and related complaint handling procedures.
* Compose clear and concise written communications detailing complaint events, investigation activities, product analysis findings, conclusions, and corrective actions, as applicable, for both internal and external use.
* Uphold the company's core values of Integrity, Innovation, Accountability, and Teamwork.
* Demonstrate behavior consistent with the company's Code of Ethics and Conduct.
* Report quality problems, product defects, or compliance concerns to management to support appropriate corrective action and prevent recurrence.
* Perform other duties as assigned to meet business needs.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Regulatory Affairs, Life Sciences, Nursing, Biomedical Engineering, or related discipline preferred. Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will be considered.
* Demonstrated experience conducting complaint investigations, evaluating product performance issues, and documenting investigation conclusions in accordance with regulatory requirements.
* Fluency in English, with demonstrated ability to read, write, and communicate verbally at a professional level.
* Couple of hours of overlap with the snoqualmieteam who usually work between 7:30AM\-5:30PM PDT.
* Experience evaluating adverse events and determining regulatory reportability using established decision trees and applicable regulatory requirements preferred.
* Demonstrated knowledge and practical application of ISO 13485, FDA medical device regulations, and ISO 14971 risk management principles.
* Knowledge of global medical device regulations and reporting requirements (e.g., EU MDR, UK MDR, Health Canada, TGA).
* Experience working within electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS) and complaint management databases preferred.
* Must be able to perform critical thinking to identify and synthesize patterns from emerging trends and translate into actionable recommendations
* Strong technical written and verbal communication skills; ability to work effectively across all levels of a global organization and remain composed in urgent circumstances
* Must have ability to work in collaborative and independent work situations and environments with minimal supervision.
* Proficiency in multi\-tasking and working in a high\-paced, matrixed environment with an awareness of continued impact on compliance and operational performance
* Ability to effectively collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders including Regulatory Affairs, R\&D, Service, Quality, and Supply Chain to support complaint investigations and risk mitigation activities.
* Ability to learn how to use the Spacelabs Healthcare products that are supported (training provided)
* Organized and resourceful with excellent attention to detail and ability to execute on assigned project plans.


**Physical Requirements**
- Standing: 5%

 Bending:
 - Sitting: 80%

- Lifting: (0 – 25lbs)

title: Quality and Project Platform Lead
description:
Opella is the self\-care challenger with the purest and third\-largest portfolio in the Over\-The\-Counter (OTC) and Vitamins, Minerals and Supplements (VMS) market globally.
 



  





 Our mission is to bring health in people's hands by making self\-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide, and counting.
 



  





 At the core of this mission is our 100 loved brands, our 11,000\-strong global team, our 13 best\-in\-class manufacturing sites and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world's most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.
 



 B Corp certified in multiple markets, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com.
 



  





**About the role** 




  





 You will lead a team of 5 to 10 experts and platform owners covering three connected areas:
 



 Digital Quality, meaning GxP processes, computer system validation, and the Digital Control Framework.
 



  





 Testing and quality engineering, including test strategy, test management and automation on Xray and Tricentis Tosca.
 



  





 The Atlassian platform, where Jira and Confluence on Atlassian Cloud carry project delivery, documentation and compliance evidence for Opella Digital.
 



  





 The role is both platform owner and people manager. There is no intermediate management layer, so you lead senior specialists directly and stay close enough to the work to challenge a validation rationale, review a test automation approach, or settle a Jira workflow design.
 



 We are looking for someone with 12 to 15 years of experience who owns the outcome rather than the task, simplifies processes that have grown complicated, and works comfortably across Digital, Quality and the business functions.
 



  





**What you will do** 




  





**Lead the team** 




  





 Line manage 5 to 10 experts and platform owners, including internal staff and partner resources. Set direction and priorities across three areas at once. Give each platform owner clear accountability, decision rights and a roadmap they own, then hold them to it. Run objective setting, performance and development conversations, coaching, and skills, backup and succession planning. Shape resourcing, capacity and the balance between insourced and partner\-delivered work. Own the budget and vendor relationships for the platforms in scope. Build one team culture across quality, testing and platform engineering rather than three separate groups.
 



  





**Digital Quality, policy and validation governance** 




  





 You are the global owner for GxP\-relevant Digital Quality policies, standards, SOPs and work instructions, and for making them usable in practice. You own the Digital Control Framework: control design, control ownership, testing of control effectiveness, evidence retention and remediation tracking.
 



  





 The role covers controlled document management for CSV and CSA, data integrity under ALCOA\+, cloud and SaaS governance, and electronic records and electronic signatures under 21 CFR Part 11\. Digital solutions must meet GxP, ICH, HIPAA and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements, including how protected health and personal data is handled across regulated and commercial systems.
 



 You provide quality oversight for computer system validation using GAMP 5 and CSA principles, take risk\-based decisions and document the reasoning. You govern validation plans, risk assessments and test strategies, and you review and approve URS, functional specifications, UAT reports, validation summaries and Authorization for Use. You manage validation deviations and CAPAs, oversee change controls for validation impact, and run GxP periodic reviews. You also govern digital supplier management: vendor inventories, assessments, quality agreements and performance monitoring.
 



  





**Testing, strategy, tooling and delivery assurance** 




  





 Own the global test strategy and testing standards for Opella Digital across functional, integration, regression, performance and user acceptance testing, in both GxP and non\-GxP systems. You are accountable for Xray as the test management layer in Jira and for Tricentis Tosca as the automation platform, covering roadmap, licensing, environments, upgrades, integrations and adoption, working through the platform owners in your team.
 



  





 Grow automation coverage on the systems that matter most, such as ERP, supply chain, commercial and web, and make automated evidence usable for validation where the regulations allow it. Keep traceability intact from requirement to test case to execution to defect, which serves delivery quality and inspection readiness at the same time. Set testing metrics such as coverage, defect leakage, automation rate and cycle time, and use them to change how the teams work. Get involved early enough with project and product teams that testing is planned in from the start rather than added at the end.
 



  





**Atlassian platform** 




  





 Own Jira and Confluence on Atlassian Cloud, along with Jira Service Management, the Marketplace app portfolio and the integrations with the rest of the digital toolchain. Define and govern project templates, workflows, schemes, permissions and space structures so that they support agile delivery and the traceability a regulated environment needs.
 



  





 Cloud releases arrive continuously, so the platform roadmap has to cover release and change management, app rationalization, performance, cost and license optimization. Work with Cybersecurity, Identity and Internal Audit on security, privacy, access management, data residency and audit requirements, including the controls needed for Jira and Confluence to hold GxP\-relevant records. Drive adoption and standardization across Digital and the business so the standard way is also the easy way, and run platform operations to agreed service levels with a clear support model and incident and problem management.
 



  





**Collaboration, audit and inspection readiness** 




  





 Partner with Digital, Manufacturing, R\&D, Quality and Supply Chain teams to give GxP and testing guidance during system modernization. Work with Cybersecurity, Data Privacy and Internal Audit specialists so requirements are managed in one central framework rather than several. Build and deliver global training on digital and GxP policies, data integrity, validation, testing and Atlassian practices.
 



  





 Keep evidence packages and stakeholder coordination ready for audit at any time, not only when one is announced. Act as the subject matter expert during Health Authority inspections (FDA, EMA, MHRA and others) and internal or external audits covering digital systems, validation and data integrity, and lead CAPA development and effectiveness checks for findings related to digital quality governance.
 



  





**About you** 




  





 We look at potential, character and culture fit alongside experience.
 



  





 You have 12 to 15 years of experience across digital quality and compliance, software testing and platform ownership in a regulated industry such as pharma, healthcare or life sciences.
 



 You have managed people for at least 3 to 5 years, ideally senior specialists and platform owners in a flat structure, including hiring, coaching, performance management and leading work delivered through partners.
 



  





 You have owned an enterprise SaaS platform yourself, including its roadmap, budget, vendors, lifecycle, adoption and service levels.
 



  





 You know test strategy, test management, automation and the validation lifecycle for GxP digital systems.
 



  





 On tooling, you have worked hands on with Jira and Xray for test plans, executions, traceability matrices and dashboards. You understand how Tricentis Tosca automation is designed, maintained and scaled in a large system landscape. You can configure and govern Jira and Confluence Cloud, including workflows, permissions, apps and admin and security controls. You are familiar with ServiceNow, Veeva Vault or equivalent document management systems.
 



 On regulation, you know GxP, ICH guidelines, HIPAA and 21 CFR Part 11 for electronic records and signatures, together with GAMP 5, CSA, IT general controls and ALCOA\+ data integrity principles. You have run GxP supplier qualification activities.
 



 You are fluent in English and comfortable working with stakeholders across a global matrix organization.
 



  





**The Opella leadership behaviors we are looking for** 




 We assess every candidate against our four behaviors.
 



 Behavior What it looks like in this role All in. Together. You lead one team across quality, testing and platforms, and you partner across Digital, R\&D, Manufacturing and Supply Chain, asking for help and giving it freely. Courageous You challenge how validation and testing are done today, take considered risks on automation and platform change, and speak up during inspections. Outcome\-Obsessed You own the compliance and delivery result, not only the task, and follow through with integrity and speed. Radically Simple You make GxP frameworks and platform configurations simple enough for teams to understand and apply.
 



*Opella is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where every candidate feels respected.*

title: Technology lead
description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.
   

  

 We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Mainframe Developer with 7\-10\+ years of experience in IBM z/OS application development, maintenance, modernization, and production support. The ideal candidate should possess deep technical expertise in COBOL, CICS, DB2, SQL, JCL, VSAM, and batch processing, along with a strong understanding of enterprise\-scale transaction processing systems. Experience in troubleshooting complex production issues, performing root cause analysis, and ensuring application stability is essential. The role requires hands\-on involvement in application design, development, testing, performance tuning, deployment, and ongoing support of mission\-critical business applications.
   

  

 The successful candidate must demonstrate exceptional analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex technical issues, assess business impacts, and deliver effective solutions under tight timelines. Strong verbal and written communication skills are equally important, as the role involves regular interaction with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, QA teams, infrastructure teams, and senior management. The candidate should be capable of translating business requirements into technical solutions and presenting technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
   

  

 Experience with Agile methodologies, production support, incident management, performance optimization, code reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives is required. Exposure to MQ, web services, IMS (preferred), and mainframe integration technologies will be an added advantage. The ideal candidate will be a self\-driven professional who can lead technical initiatives, mentor junior developers, drive operational excellence, and contribute to the modernization and long\-term stability of enterprise mainframe platforms.
   

  

 We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective.
   

  

**Use of AI in Hiring**
 As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)\-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.

title: Technical Lead
description:
**Job Summary**
 This hybrid role seeks an experienced technical professional with eight to twelve years of hands on delivery experience in IBM mainframe technologies and merchandising domain solutions. The Technical Lead will drive complex merchandising applications using Cobol JCL DB2 IMS DB VSAM and IBM mainframe utilities to support scalable retail operations and enhance business value across global markets.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive design and implementation of complex merchandising applications using Cobol JCL IBM mainframe utilities DB2 IMS DB and VSAM to enable reliable and scalable retail processing solutions.
* Coordinate end to end technical analysis for merchandising batch and online processes to ensure accurate item pricing and inventory data flows across integrated enterprise systems.
* Optimize mainframe batch schedules and resource consumption to achieve stable day shift operations while meeting strict service level targets for merchandising business cycles.
* Review and refine Cobol and JCL components to enhance performance maintainability and compliance with internal coding standards while reducing production incident rates.
* Analyze DB2 and IMS DB data models underpinning merchandising functions to improve data integrity query efficiency and support for evolving retail assortment strategies.
* Perform detailed impact assessments for changes in merchandising logic including promotions and stock allocation rules to reduce risk and maintain consistent downstream reporting.
* Collaborate closely with product and merchandising domain experts to translate business requirements into precise technical specifications and mainframe solution designs.
* Guide defect analysis and root cause resolution across mainframe utilities VSAM files DB2 tables and IMS segments to strengthen platform resilience and operational continuity.
* Document technical solutions data flows and batch dependencies for merchandising systems to support audit readiness knowledge sharing and onboarding of new team members.
* Coordinate hybrid work model collaboration activities with distributed development testing and operations teams to ensure smooth deployment and steady day to day delivery.
* Support production monitoring activities for key merchandising jobs during day shift windows to proactively identify issues and trigger timely remediation actions.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on automating repetitive support tasks on the mainframe stack to free capacity for high value merchandising enhancements.
* Align technical solutions with enterprise sustainability and efficiency goals so mainframe merchandising capabilities contribute to reduced waste and better customer experiences.


**Qualifications**
* Bring extensive experience in IBM mainframe utilities combined with strong proficiency in JCL Cobol VSAM DB2 and IMS DB to handle complex merchandising workloads effectively.
* Demonstrate deep merchandising domain knowledge covering item setup pricing management allocation and inventory planning so technical decisions reflect real retail scenarios.
* Apply strong skills in performance tuning problem solving and incident analysis across mainframe environments to stabilize mission critical merchandising processes.
* Exhibit practical experience working in hybrid delivery models with global teams and day shift schedules ensuring predictable collaboration and reliable communication.
* Use solid understanding of relational and hierarchical data concepts in DB2 and IMS DB to model and maintain merchandising data structures that support analytical needs.
* Show capacity to write clear technical documentation for programs jobs and data mappings so complex merchandising solutions remain understandable and maintainable.
* Display familiarity with standard software development practices including requirement analysis unit testing integration testing and change control in mainframe contexts.
* Apply hands on experience in retail or merchandising technology transformations so enhancements support company objectives around customer satisfaction and market growth.


**Certifications Required**
 Preferred certifications include IBM Certified Application Developer mainframe and industry recognized retail or merchandising technology credentials.

title: System Development Engineer, Last Mile Prod DSP
description:
**Description**
 The DSP tech team in Hyderabad is looking for a System Dev Engineer who will work alongside Last mile technologies and product team in amazon transportation organization. SysDev Engineer will be specializing in Tech and OE frameworks used within last\-mile and DSP tech teams.
   

  

 Primary responsibilities include troubleshooting, diagnosing and fixing production software issues, developing monitoring solutions, performing software maintenance and scaling, implementing the fix for internally developed code, performing SQL queries, updating, tracking and resolving technical challenges. Responsibilities also include working alongside development on team's software projects, updating/enhancing our current software, automation of support processes and documentation of our systems.
   

  

 The ideal candidate must be detail oriented, have superior verbal and written communication skills, strong organizational skills, able to juggle multiple tasks at once, able to work independently and can maintain professionalism under pressure. You must be able to identify problems before they happen and implement solutions that detect and prevent outages. You must be able to accurately prioritize projects, make sound judgments, work to improve the customer experience, and get the right things done.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**As a System Development Engineer You Will**
* Play vital role in helping us leverage supporting and developing technologies on any platform to increase global collaboration, increase efficiency, and meet our controller ship requirements
* Directly work with development team to improve the applications built by conducting technical mitigations and deep dives on reported issues to find the cause and corrective actions
* Work on proactive detection mechanism to report dip in software performance by building efficient metrics/monitors/alarms using our in house tools
* Build tools and automation to optimize the system, simplify processes, etc.


 You design and deliver technology solutions which solve difficult business problems. You identify and solve ambiguous problems, architectural deficiencies, or areas where your team’s systems hinder the success or innovation of other teams.
   

  

 You work autonomously, but may seek direction at times from peers and your manager. Your solutions are pragmatic, efficient, and cost\-effective. You make appropriate trade\-offs and re\-use or extend prior work where possible. You thoroughly test your work. You consistently write clear, accurate, and concise documentation for your own solutions and improve your team’s existing documentation.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

* Work closely with Product Management to break down feature requirements into software deliverables
* Design, Develop and maintain secure and performant software features and systems for Last\-mile and DSP Tech customers
* Actively participate in software and system design reviews
* Participate in the team on\-call rotation where you will triage, communicate status, escalate, and remediate critical issues quickly


**About The Team**

 IT\&D Senior Analyst \- Control Assurance with 8\-12 Years of Experience.

* Responsible for managing testing efforts across multiple projects and teams.

title: Quality Analyst – Manual Testing
description:
**About The Role**
 We are looking for a detail\-oriented Quality Analyst to lead manual testing efforts for the Customer Portal, a React/AEM\-based web application integrated with SAP, Salesforce, and supporting middleware. The QA will validate end\-to\-end business scenarios spanning the web/AEM front end and SAP\-driven backend processes (orders, deliveries, invoices, documents), ensuring the portal meets functional, data\-accuracy, and customer\-experience requirements before release.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Test Planning \& Strategy: Define the manual test strategy and test plans for each Phase 1 module (Profile, Documents, Contact Us, Dashboard, Deliveries, Order Status), covering functional, regression, integration, and UAT\-support testing.
* Test Case Design: Author detailed test cases and test scripts derived from business requirement documents, including field\-level validations, business rules, and source\-system mappings (e.g., SAP, SFDC).
* SAP\-Integrated Scenario Testing: Validate portal behavior against SAP\-driven data and logic, including order status transitions, delivery commitment / delay logic, credit/pricing/compliance blocks, invoice and document availability, and output management triggers.
* Web/UI Testing: Perform functional, cross\-browser, responsive, and accessibility testing of the React/AEM front end, including forms, search/filter behavior, modals, file uploads/downloads, and navigation flows.
* Data Validation: Verify data accuracy and consistency across SAP, Salesforce (SFDC), and the portal UI, including account details, contact information, order/delivery data, and document metadata.
* Defect Management: Log, triage, and track defects to closure using the team's defect management tool, working closely with React developers, AEM SMEs, and SAP consultants on root cause and resolution.
* Requirement Traceability: Maintain requirements\-to\-test\-case traceability matrices to ensure full coverage of documented requirements and sign\-off criteria.
* Regression \& Release Testing: Execute regression test cycles ahead of each release, validate bug fixes, and provide go/no\-go quality input to the Project Lead.
* UAT Support: Support business stakeholders during User Acceptance Testing, including test data preparation, issue triage, and coordination of retesting.
* Documentation: Maintain clear test documentation, execution logs, and status reporting (pass/fail metrics, defect trends, coverage) for project stakeholders.


**Must\-Have Skills**
* Experience: 5\+ years of manual QA experience with at least 2\+ years testing applications integrated with SAP and modern web front ends.
* SAP Exposure: Working knowledge of SAP Sales \& Distribution (Order\-to\-Cash) processes – Sales Orders, Deliveries, Billing/Invoicing, Customer Master – sufficient to validate business rules and data displayed on the portal.
* Web Application Testing: Hands\-on experience testing React\-based or other modern JavaScript web applications, including responsive/cross\-browser testing; exposure to CMS/DXP platforms such as AEM is a plus.
* Test Management Tools: Proficiency with test management and defect tracking tools (e.g., JIRA/Xray, Azure DevOps, qTest, or similar).
* API/Integration Awareness: Ability to validate data flowing through REST/GraphQL APIs and integration layers (e.g., Apigee) at a functional level, using tools such as Postman.
* CRM Exposure: Familiarity with Salesforce (SFDC) data structures (Accounts, Contacts, Cases) as they relate to customer and case data shown on the portal.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to design test scenarios covering complex business/status logic (e.g., order and delivery lifecycle states).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for defect reporting and stakeholder coordination.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams, including participation in sprint ceremonies and Definition of Done reviews.


**Added Advantage (Highly Preferred)**
* Experience testing AEM (Sites/SPA Editor) authored pages and AEM Dispatcher\-cached content.
* Exposure to SAP transaction codes relevant to customer master and order data (e.g., XD03\) for cross\-verification during testing.
* Experience testing Salesforce Case creation/workflow integrations.
* Basic SQL knowledge for backend data verification.
* ISTQB Foundation Level certification.


**Qualifications**
* B.E / B.Tech / MCA or equivalent.
* ISTQB or equivalent QA certification is a plus.

title: Senior Salesforce Tester
description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high\-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late\-stage pipeline. The company’s patient\-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro\-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www.azurity.com.
   

  

 Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Our Digital team at Azurity is building new capabilities utilizing cutting\-edge Salesforce technologies. We are seeking a dynamic, self\-driven, hands\-on team member who thrives in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment.
   

  

 The Senior Salesforce Tester is responsible for testing and validating Salesforce applications to ensure quality, performance, security, and regulatory compliance across Azurity's commercial and medical business processes. This role focuses on Salesforce platforms supporting HCP/HCO engagement, sales operations, patient support programs, regulatory requirements, and commercial excellence initiatives.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will work closely with developers, business analysts, product owners, and QA teams to identify defects, improve functionality, and maintain compliance with HIPAA, GDPR, Sunshine Act, and FDA regulations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Test Planning \& Strategy**
* Develop and execute test plans, test cases, test scripts, and test data for Salesforce applications.
* Ensure comprehensive coverage for functional, integration, regression, performance, security, and user acceptance testing.
* Collaborate with business analysts, developers, and stakeholders to understand requirements and define testing strategies.
* Participate in test estimation, release planning, and risk assessment activities.


**Functional \& Regression Testing**
* Conduct manual and automated testing of Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Life Sciences Cloud functionalities.
* Validate HCP/HCO engagement processes, KOL management, consent management, patient support workflows, and compliance\-related business processes.
* Perform end\-to\-end validation of business workflows, data integrity, and system configurations.
* Verify territory alignment, call planning, sample management, omnichannel engagement, and commercial operations processes.
* Execute regression testing to ensure system stability across Salesforce releases and deployments.


**Integration \& Data Testing**
* Test integrations with third\-party pharmaceutical platforms including IQVIA, Veeva, MedPro, SAP, Snowflake, and MDM solutions.
* Validate Salesforce APIs (REST and SOAP) and perform API testing using Postman.
* Verify Data Cloud integrations, data ingestion, transformation, and synchronization processes.
* Ensure data accuracy, completeness, reconciliation, and security across integrated systems.
* Support testing of end\-to\-end data flows between Salesforce and enterprise applications.


**Compliance \& Security Testing**
* Ensure HIPAA, GDPR, FDA, and pharmaceutical compliance requirements are met across Salesforce solutions.
* Perform role\-based security testing, user access validation, permission testing, and audit trail verification.
* Validate electronic records controls, consent management processes, and sensitive data protection requirements.
* Support compliance documentation and validation activities as required for regulated systems.


**Performance \& Automation Testing**
* Use Copado Robotic Testing (CRT) or similar automation tools to automate Salesforce test cases.
* Design, develop, and maintain reusable automated test suites.
* Perform performance and scalability testing to assess system stability under peak workloads.
* Identify bottlenecks, optimize test execution, and validate Lightning Web Component (LWC) performance.
* Utilize basic Python scripting where applicable to support automation and data validation activities.


**Defect Tracking \& Collaboration**
* Document, manage, and track defects using JIRA, X\-Ray, or similar test management tools.
* Work closely with developers and business analysts to troubleshoot and resolve issues.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including daily standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and release readiness activities.


**Continuous Improvement \& Best Practices**
* Stay current with Salesforce releases, platform enhancements, testing tools, and industry best practices.
* Implement CI/CD testing methodologies leveraging Copado and Salesforce DevOps processes.
* Recommend improvements to test automation frameworks, testing methodologies, and quality processes.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, quality, and compliance.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* 7\+ years of experience in Salesforce testing, preferably within Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical, or Healthcare industries.
* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Life Sciences Cloud.
* Strong knowledge of manual and automated testing frameworks for Salesforce applications.
* Experience testing Salesforce integrations with pharmaceutical platforms such as IQVIA, Veeva, SAP, Sales Enablement tools, Snowflake, and MDM solutions.
* Proficiency in Salesforce Administration, Flows, Apex test classes, and Lightning Web Component (LWC) testing.
* Experience with Salesforce APIs (REST, SOAP), Postman, and Data Cloud validation.
* Hands\-on experience with Copado Robotic Testing and Salesforce DevOps release management practices.
* Understanding of HIPAA, GDPR, FDA, and pharmaceutical compliance requirements.
* Experience using JIRA, X\-Ray, or similar test management and defect\-tracking tools.
* Basic Python knowledge to support test automation and data validation activities.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills within a global offshore\-onshore delivery model.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Copado Robotic Testing and Salesforce DevOps release pipelines.
* Experience validating Snowflake, MDM, SAP, Veeva, IQVIA, MedPro, or other pharmaceutical data integrations.
* Basic Python skills for test utilities, data validation, or automation support.
* Knowledge of Agile/Scrum delivery, risk\-based testing, and software quality practices in a regulated environment.
* Knowledge of pharmaceutical commercial operations and HCP/HCO engagement processes.
* Experience with Data Cloud, AI\-enabled Salesforce capabilities, and advanced automation frameworks.

If you have any concerns or even the slightest disability that may affect your ability to perform the job, please inform HR in advance.

* Strong professional experience in software testing, with a focus on quality engineering and automation\-led delivery
  
* Proven ability to develop, execute and maintain automated test suites within a fast\-paced engineering environment

* Experience applying a programming language within automation frameworks
  
* Solid understanding of debugging principles
  
* Experience testing APIs and using relevant tooling
  
* Strong knowledge of version control workflows, such as Git, and collaborative development practices
  
* Experience with CI/CD workflows and pipelines
  
* Excellent understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle and the role QE plays in modern delivery teams
  
* Experience with issue\-tracking tools such as GitLab, Qase or Jira
  
* Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to debug issues across devices and environments
  
* Confident communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and operate effectively in client\-facing delivery contexts
  
* Comfortable managing priorities across multiple concurrent projects and service engagements
  
* Ability to collaborate in Agile ceremonies, including refinement, sprint planning, stand\-ups, reviews and retrospectives, providing test insights, estimating effort and influencing team decisions around quality
  

  


  


  




**Nice to Have** 
  

  
* TypeScript as the programming language used within automation frameworks
  
* Knowledge of Gherkin

title: Associate | QA Engineer [T500-29290]
description:
**About Deutsche Börse Group:** 




 Headquartered in Frankfurt, Germany, Deutsche Börse Group is a leading international exchange organization and market infrastructure provider. They empower investors, financial institutions, and companies by facilitating access to global capital markets.
 



 Their India centre is located in Hyderabad, serves as a key strategic hub and comprises India’s top\-tier tech talent. They focus on crafting advanced IT solutions that elevate market infrastructure and services. Deutsche Börse Group in India is composed of a team of capital market engineers forming the backbone of financial markets worldwide.
 



  





**Your area of work:** 




 For our new office in Hyderabad, we are looking for an experienced Test Engineer supporting the further development of our leading\-edge Trading System T7 offering order and quote management, on\- and off\-book trading services in simple and complex instruments. You will shape a motivated team, working in an international environment, driven to keep up the highest levels of service quality while constantly allowing for integration of functional and technical improvements in a fast\-changing domain.
 



 Functional System Test verifies that the Trading System T7 meets the specified functional requirements for both new and existing functionality. Your effective collaboration with the specification, build and acceptance teams working in our distributed environment is crucial and relies on clear communication, trust, and usage of digital tools. Functional System Test provides essential feedback for decision taking for installing software fixes, enhancements, changes, or new releases of the Trading System Software in the higher test environments, acceptance, simulation, and production.
 



  





**Your Responsibilities:** 



* Plan and perform functional system testing of the Deutsche Börse Group Trading System T7, with timely and high impact feedback.
* Closely align with the functional, build and acceptance teams for a streamlined efficient delivery process.
* Self\-organize software testing for your area of expertise with focus on responsibilities, contents, and schedule.
* Create and update test models and scripts for test automation.
* Constantly enhance (automated) smoke test and regression test portfolios to ensure high functional coverage.
* Ensure that the software deliveries fulfil the defined quality requirements for the installation in higher test environments and in production.
* Drive the continuous improvement of software testing activities / processes and test reporting.



  





**Your Profile:** 



* University degree in business studies or in Engineering or comparable qualification.
* Strong expertise in functionality of cash and derivatives trading systems is essential.
* Deep knowledge of test methodology, management, planning and execution. A professional tester certification, e.g., ISTQB is beneficial.
* Deep experience in iterative and agile development methods with dedicated expertise for testing of software from a functional perspective.
* Deep experience with creating, executing and analyzing automated functional tests.
* Solid user experience in Linux operating system, GitHub, Jira and continuous integration.
* Expertise in scripting for test and test automation; scripting in python is preferred.
* Inter\-personal skills are essential to successfully fill this position.
* Highly self\-motivated and self\-directed.
* Strong communication and analytical skills.
* Ability to organize work and drive results in our international team.
* Proficiency in written and spoken English

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
**Overview**
 The Sr. Quality Assurance Engineer shall provide leadership and support for QMS performance in many facets of business operations:
   

  

**Design Control**
 In this role, you will ensure that product development teams consistently apply strong critical thinking throughout the design and development process while maintaining deep expertise in Design Controls, Risk Management, Electrical Safety, and Usability Engineering. You will be responsible for ensuring all design\-related activities are properly executed, accurately documented, and fully compliant with internal procedures and global regulatory expectations. You will review Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) and proposed design modifications to confirm they reflect sound engineering practices and uphold device safety and effectiveness. You will also oversee the efficient progression of design changes, ensuring all documentation is complete, traceable, and compliant. As an active participant in cross\-functional design reviews, you will evaluate Design and Development Plans, Design Inputs and Outputs, verification and validation documentation, and design changes. Additionally, you will identify potential safety or performance risks and support appropriate risk management activities. Throughout the process, you will ensure that all design decisions are well justified, thoroughly documented, and aligned with regulatory and quality expectations.
   

  

**Risk Management**
 you will actively participate in risk management activities in alignment with ISO 14971, supporting hazard analyses, FMEAs, and the creation and maintenance of all related risk management documentation. You will ensure that risk control measures are properly implemented, thoroughly verified, and supported by objective evidence. You will apply structured, risk‑based decision‑making to ensure product safety and regulatory compliance, while also ensuring that all risk–benefit evaluations are clear, comprehensive, and aligned with global regulatory expectations.
   

  

**Material Review Board**
 The Sr. Quality Assurance Engineer shall facilitate efficient and effective processing of Nonconforming Material Reports and Rework Orders. Process performance metrics shall be captured, monitored, and reported to ensure timely and effective MRB throughput and minimized quarantine back log.
   

  

**Installation and Service**
 The Sr. Quality Assurance Engineer shall ensure that post\-market activities ensure intended device performance. Service and support activities must be adequately documented, attention escalated to facilitate defect handling, and product performance and performance trends assessed to understand and drive improvement opportunities
   

  

**QMS Administration**
 In addition, the Senior Quality Assurance Engineer will support key Quality Management System (QMS) administration activities related to design and development. This includes conducting internal quality audits to verify compliance with internal procedures and global regulatory expectations, as well as leading or supporting Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), including verifying effectiveness and ensuring all remediation activities are properly documented. The role will manage Process Change Control for design‑related processes, ensuring changes are appropriately evaluated, documented, reviewed, and approved. The Senior QA Engineer will also support external audits and inspections by providing documentation, explaining processes, and representing relevant quality activities. Further responsibilities include assisting functional teams in understanding their quality obligations and maintaining alignment with the Spacelabs Quality Policy, as well as maintaining and improving QMS procedures, work instructions, and templates to ensure practices remain risk‑based, efficient, and compliant.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The Sr. Quality Assurance Engineer shall follow the guidance of RA/QA Management and help other organizational functions understand and fulfill their obligations to meet quality objectives, systemic responsibilities, and customer requirements, as defined by Executive Management in the Spacelabs Quality Policy. As part of maintenance of the Spacelabs Quality Management System, Senior Quality Assurance Engineers shall partake in some or all of the following responsibilities:
   

  

* Ensure high quality of products and services, by implementing and maintaining the Quality Management System.
* Ensure that QMS activities are risk\-based.
* Perform, report, and drive remediation from Internal Quality Audits and participate in third party audit and inspection activities (MDR, MDSAP, etc.).
* Routinely pursue more efficient and effective operations (continual improvement).
* Support the development teams of all business areas, working within the project teams on new or sustaining product development projects.
* Support the maintenance of the Essential Requirements Checklists / General Safety, Essential Requirements checklist and Technical Documentation Files.
* Assist with the compliance to changes to standards such as EN 60601\-1, ROHS3, REACH, and Global regulatory requirements applicable to Spacelabs’ products.
* Provide Quality System guidance to his or her product design teams. He or she shall be well versed in all aspects of Design Controls, Risk Management, Electrical Safety and all associated processes, policies, procedures, and records.
* Collaborate with engineering to determine and execute engineering design and development planning in support of regulatory submissions.
* Review Engineering Change Requests and Engineering Change Orders to identify critical components, defects in drawings/schematics, effective and adequate design documentation, product safety, and Quality System compliance.
* Assist with the creation, maintenance, and performance of QMS change management tools: Corrective Action Reports (CAR’s), Preventive Action Reports (PAR’s), and Process Change Orders (PCO’s).
* Support the manufacturing teams of all business areas, working within the teams on new or sustaining product and process improvements.
* Shall review and approve Device History Record (DHR) deliverables to ensure that production activities comply with Mandatory Device Master Record (DMR) requirements.
* Perform Manufacturing floor walkthroughs based on 7S criteria to support improvements and collaboration.
* Facilitate efficient and effective processing of Nonconforming Material Reports and Rework Orders.
* Create and update quality system procedure to achieve continuous compliance to ISO13485, European MDD/MDR, and MDSAP.
* Assist in the preparation and submittal of registration applications. May assist in the preparation of IDE, 510(k), CE Mark, and other similar regulatory filings.
* Shall participate in cross\-functional design teams to review all Design and Development Plans, Design Inputs, Design Outputs, V\&V documents, and Design Changes including Defect Reports. Senior Quality Assurance Engineers shall recognize potential impacts to health or device efficacy (“Safety Issues”), support criticality assessment needed to ensure the application of reasonable and required Risk Management, Verification and Validation, and adequate record\-keeping practices.
* Uphold the company’s core values of Integrity, Innovation, Accountability, and Teamwork.
* Demonstrate behavior consistent with the company’s Code of Ethics and Conduct.
* It is the responsibility of every employee to report to their manager or a member of senior management any quality problems or defects in order for corrective action to be implemented and to avoid recurrence of the problem.
* Duties may be modified or assigned at any time to meet the needs of the business.


 This role will work with R\&D engineering 100% and therefore he/she has to have strong experience in following areas:
   

  

* Design Control, new product development
* Review and approve engineering changes representing Quality
* Working knowledge of ISO 13485
* Maintain Design History File (DHF), Technical Files, Risk Management
* Experience with ISO 14971 Risk Management.
* Knowledge of Software with a Device or Software as a Medical Device
* Experience in Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA)
* Experience in internal audits


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in a Quality, Engineering, or related discipline (Computer/Software, Biomedical, Mechanical, Electrical).
* 7\+ years related Quality / Engineering work experience.
* 5\+ years of experience with medical device regulatory and quality and Quality Management Systems
* Experience maintaining Technical Files, GSRPCs, Risk Management Files, Usability Engineering Files, Design History Files, MVP's, and Change Control documentation.
* Experience with statistical analysis
* Knowledge of Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) or Software within a device required.
* Experience working with teams under design controls and during new product development to follow the QMS and comply with current regulations and standards.
* Proven ability to communicate effectively with staff at all levels of the organization.
* Self\-motivated and organized.


**DESIRABLE**
* Experience acting as a Change Agent

title: Oracle Fusion QA Lead
description:
Job Description
 



 We are seeking an experienced QA lead to work on a Oracle Fusion transformation project involving multiple testing cycles
 



 This role requires collaboration with cross\-functional teams and key stakeholders to ensure successful conduct of test cycles that include but not limited to CRP's, SIT, UAT.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities
 
 :** 




 • Develop comprehensive test plans, test scripts, and test scenarios covering functional, integration, regression, performance, and user acceptance testing.
 



 • Coordinate with functional, technical, integration, and data migration teams to ensure aligned testing across PTP, OTC, RTR, and consolidation processes.
 



 • Establish and manage test cycles including SIT, UAT, regression, parallel testing, and cutover validation.
 



 • Validate end\-to\-end cross\-module business flows including Procure\-to\-Pay, Order\-to\-Cash, Record\-to\-Report, and EPM data integrations.
 



 • Review and validate data migration quality, reconciliation results, and transactional data accuracy across testing cycles.
 



 • Oversee creation of test data sets, ensuring availability and accuracy for each region and test cycle (Canada, EMEA, APAC).
 



 • Manage defect lifecycle including triage, prioritization, assignment, tracking, and resolution across all workstreams.
 



 • Ensure correct testing and validation of integrations built using OIC, ODI, FDI, ADW, and FBDI/ADFDI\-based data flows.
 



 • Validate BI Publisher, OTBI, Smart View, and EPM financial reports for accuracy, security, and consistency.
 



 • Define and enforce test governance, reporting standards, and quality metrics (pass/fail criteria, defect leakage, coverage scores).
 



 • Collaborate with release management teams to support quarterly Oracle updates, impact assessments, and regression certification.
 



 • Provide leadership to offshore/onshore testers, ensuring consistent execution and adherence to testing processes.
 



 • Support UAT readiness, business training, and pre\-go\-live user validation workshops.
 



  





**Required Qualifications
 
 :** 




 • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field.
 



 • 10–15\+ years of QA experience with 7\+ years focused on Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP testing.
 



 • Strong hands\-on experience testing Oracle Fusion Financials, Procurement, and FAH; working knowledge of EPM (FCCS/EPBCS).
 



 • Deep understanding of end\-to\-end ERP processes: PTP, OTC, RTR, financial consolidations, and reporting.
 



 • Experience with integration testing involving OIC, ODI, FDI, ADW, REST/SOAP APIs, and FBDI\-based processes.
 



 • Strong SQL skills for data validation, reconciliation, and test data preparation.
 



 • Experience managing SIT/UAT cycles, regression frameworks, and large multi\-region test programs.
 



 • Hands\-on familiarity with test automation tools and tracking tools like JIRA / Azure DevOps / SNOW for defect management, and traceability matrix development.
 



 • Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

title: Oracle Cloud ERP Analyst
description:
**Overview**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 At Peloton, we don't just implement technology. We transform the way organizations work, compete, and grow. Recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest\-growing companies in the US, Peloton is one of the most respected and fastest\-growing global Oracle consulting firms, delivering Advisory, Consulting, and Managed Services to leading organizations across many industries, including Retail, Financial Services, Manufacturing, Consumer Packaged Goods, and more.
   

  

 Peloton Consulting Group has the vision and connected global capabilities to help organizations envision, implement, and realize the benefits of digital transformation. Our team has the best practices, knowledge, industry expertise, and know\-how. We make digital transformation a reality by leveraging AI, Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Supply Chain Management (SCM), Human Capital Management (HCM), Customer Experience (CX), Analytics, and Data Management for the cloud. Through connected capabilities, we bring people, processes, and technology together. We help organizations go further faster. That is the Peloton way!
   

  

 What truly sets us apart is our people. We are team players. We are energetic and entrepreneurial. We are problem solvers and innovative thinkers who believe the best outcomes are built together. We believe in quality, appreciate creativity, recognize individual contributions, and place trust in every member of our team. If you bring strong business or technical expertise and want to do meaningful work alongside people who are equally passionate about getting it right, we think you'll feel right at home here.
   

  

 This role requires a balance of client relationship management, operational oversight, and strategic thinking to ensure services are delivered efficiently and aligned with evolving client business needs.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Defining business requirements and providing recommendations to resolve client pain points
* Contributing to team brainstorms and effectively communicating information
* Designing, prototyping, and building technical solutions in Oracle Cloud
* Conducting system integration testing and user acceptance testing
* Delivering end\-user training and conducting knowledge transfer sessions with the client
* Developing Peloton knowledge assets and intellectual property


**Required Experience And Skills**
* Qualified candidates must have a Bachelor/master’s degree in finance, Accounting or equivalent
* Minimum 1\-3 years of experience in Oracle ERP Cloud Financials implementations.
* Candidates with CA or CMA qualifications would be an added advantage.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Proficiency in MS Office and Access
* Basic understanding of SQL
* Comfortable working in a dynamic team environment where projects and deadlines often require multi\-tasking and flexible work schedules
* Self\-starter with solid analytical and problem\-solving skills and an eye for detail
* High level of attention to detail, ability to execute and deliver project deliverables on budget and on time, and multi\-task in a dynamic environment
* Ability to integrate rapidly with existing team
* Good personal organizational and planning skills
* Ability to interact with individuals at all levels of the organization
* Strong commitment to customer service


**Additional Desired Skills**
* Domain experience – Finance \& Accounting.


**Compensation**
 Peloton provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to skills, experience, qualifications, business needs, and geographic location. Peloton also offers bonus opportunities and a comprehensive benefits package including:
   

  

* Competitive base salary with performance\-based bonus
* Vacation, Leave, and Holiday pay
* Annual Health Wallet
* Group Medical Insurance
* Group Term Accident \& Life Insurance
* Paid holidays and PTO


*Peloton Group is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.*

title: SF QA CRT
description:
We are looking for a Salesforce QA Automation Architect with strong expertise in automation testing, Coupado\-based CI/CD, and Salesforce platform architecture. The role will be responsible for defining and governing the end\-to\-end QA automation strategy, ensuring high\-quality releases through Continuous Regression Testing (CRT) and robust test frameworks across Salesforce environments.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Define and own the Salesforce QA automation architecture, including framework selection, standards, and governance.
* Design and implement Continuous Regression Testing (CRT) strategies to support frequent Salesforce releases.
* Architect and govern Coupado\-based deployment pipelines with integrated automated testing and quality gates.
* Lead automation testing across Salesforce clouds (Sales, Service, Experience, Marketing if applicable).
* Ensure end\-to\-end test coverage including functional, regression, integration, and UAT support.
* Integrate automation frameworks (Provar, Selenium, Tricentis, or equivalent) with Coupado CI/CD pipelines.
* Establish best practices for test data management, environment strategy, and data masking.
* Collaborate with developers, release managers, and business stakeholders to ensure release readiness and quality sign\-off.
* Review and optimize test execution performance and reporting dashboards.
* Act as the QA authority for Salesforce releases, providing architectural guidance and risk assessment
